entries.desc_zh: 通过 92 项自动化检查扫描 AWS 和 Azure 中的成本浪费，包括闲置 NAT 网关、gp2 卷和过度预配置的实例。在只读、开发者优先的 CLI 中获取节省估算。免费层覆盖单个 AWS 账户每次扫描最多 5,000 个资源。付费层增加资源 ID 和确切的修复步骤。

entries.name: deployment.io
entries.desc_en: Deployment.io helps developers automate deployments on AWS. On our free tier, a developer (single user) can deploy unlimited static sites, web services, and environments. We provide 10 job executions free per month with previews and auto-deploys included in the free tier.
entries.desc_zh: Deployment.io 帮助开发者在 AWS 上自动执行部署。在我们的免费层中，开发者（单用户）可以部署无限数量的静态站点、Web 服务和环境。我们每月免费提供 10 次作业执行，预览和自动部署也包含在免费层中。

entries.name: Parsivex
entries.desc_en: Parsivex scans your AWS account for idle EC2, unattached EBS, oversized RDS, stale snapshots, NAT gateway overuse etc. Free tier provides a monthly scan for one AWS account and returns total monthly waste plus a category breakdown. Paid plans give access to itemized findings and scheduled re-scans.
entries.desc_zh: Parsivex 扫描您的 AWS 账户以查找空闲的 EC2、未附加的 EBS、过大的 RDS、过期的快照、NAT 网关过度使用等。免费层级每月对一个 AWS 账户进行一次扫描，并返回总月度浪费和分类明细。付费计划提供项目化发现结果和计划重新扫描的访问权限。

entries.name: Pulumi
entries.desc_en: Modern infrastructure as a code platform that allows you to use familiar programming languages and tools to build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure.
entries.desc_zh: 现代化的基础设施即代码平台，让你可以使用熟悉的编程语言和工具来构建、部署和管理云基础设施。

entries.name: scalr.com
entries.desc_en: Scalr is a Terraform Automation and COllaboration (TACO) product used to better collaboration and automation on infrastructure and configurations managed by Terraform. Full Terraform CLI support, OPA integration, and a hierarchical configuration model. No SSO tax. All features are included. Use up to 50 runs/month for free.
entries.desc_zh: Scalr 是一款 Terraform Automation and COllaboration（TACO）产品，用于更好地协作和自动化管理由 Terraform 管理的基础设施和配置。完整支持 Terraform CLI，集成 OPA，并提供分层配置模型。无 SSO 附加费用。所有功能均包含。每月可免费使用最多 50 次运行。

entries.name: Bitbucket
entries.desc_en: Unlimited public and private Git repos for up to 5 users with Pipelines for CI/CD
entries.desc_zh: 最多支持 5 名用户的无限公共和私有 Git 仓库，附带用于 CI/CD 的 Pipelines

entries.name: Codeberg
entries.desc_en: Unlimited public and private Git repos for free and open-source projects (with unlimited collaborators). Powered by [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/). Static website hosting with [Codeberg Pages](https://codeberg.page/). CI/CD hosting with [Codeberg's CI](https://docs.codeberg.org/ci/). Translating hosting with [Codeberg Translate](https://translate.codeberg.org/). Includes Package and Container hosting, Project management, and Issue Tracking
entries.desc_zh: 为自由开源项目提供不限数量的公共和私有 Git 仓库（协作者数量不限）。基于 [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/) 构建。通过 [Codeberg Pages](https://codeberg.page/) 提供静态网站托管。通过 [Codeberg's CI](https://docs.codeberg.org/ci/) 提供 CI/CD 托管。通过 [Codeberg Translate](https://translate.codeberg.org/) 提供翻译托管。包含软件包与容器托管、项目管理和问题跟踪

entries.name: framagit.org
entries.desc_en: Framagit is the software forge of Framasoft based on the Gitlab software includes CI, Static Pages, Project pages and Issue tracking.
entries.desc_zh: Framagit 是 Framasoft 基于 Gitlab 软件的软件锻造平台，包含 CI、静态页面、项目页面和问题跟踪。

entries.name: GitGud
entries.desc_en: Unlimited private and public repositories. Free forever. Powered by GitLab & Sapphire. Includes CI/CD, Static Hosting, Container Registry, Project Management and Issue Tracking.
entries.desc_zh: 无限私有和公共仓库。永久免费。基于 GitLab 和 Sapphire 构建。包含 CI/CD、静态托管、容器镜像库、项目管理和问题跟踪。

entries.name: GitHub
entries.desc_en: Unlimited public repositories and unlimited private repositories (with unlimited collaborators). Includes CI/CD, Development Environment, Static Hosting, Package and Container hosting, Project management and AI Copilot
entries.desc_zh: 无限公共仓库和无限私有仓库（协作者数量不限）。包含 CI/CD、开发环境、静态托管、软件包与容器托管、项目管理和 AI Copilot

entries.name: gitlab.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited public and private Git repos with up to 5 collaborators. Includes CI/CD, Static Hosting, Container Registry, Project Management and Issue Tracking
entries.desc_zh: 无限公共和私有 Git 仓库，最多 5 名协作者。包含 CI/CD、静态托管、容器镜像库、项目管理和问题跟踪

entries.name: heptapod.net
entries.desc_en: Heptapod is a friendly fork of GitLab Community Edition providing support for Mercurial
entries.desc_zh: Heptapod 是 GitLab Community Edition 的一个友好分支，提供对 Mercurial 的支持

entries.name: pijul.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited free and open source distributed version control system. Its distinctive feature is based on a sound theory of patches, which makes it easy to learn, use, and distribute. Solves many problems of git/hg/svn/darcs.
entries.desc_zh: 免费开源的分布式版本控制系统。其独特之处基于一套完善的补丁理论，使其易于学习、使用和分发。解决了 git/hg/svn/darcs 的许多问题。

entries.name: projectlocker.com
entries.desc_en: One free private project (Git and Subversion) with 50 MB of space
entries.desc_zh: 一个免费私有项目（Git 和 Subversion），50 MB 空间

entries.name: RocketGit
entries.desc_en: Repository Hosting based on Git. Unlimited Public and private repositories.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 Git 的仓库托管。无限公共和私有仓库。

entries.name: savannah.gnu.org
entries.desc_en: Serves as a collaborative software development management system for free Software projects (for GNU Projects)
entries.desc_zh: 作为面向自由软件项目的协作式软件开发管理系统（针对 GNU 项目）

entries.name: savannah.nongnu.org
entries.desc_en: Serves as a collaborative software development management system for free Software projects (for non-GNU projects)
entries.desc_zh: 作为面向自由软件项目的协作式软件开发管理系统（针对非 GNU 项目）

entries.name: Abstract API
entries.desc_en: API suite for various use cases, including IP geolocation, phone number validation, or email validation.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于多种用例的 API 套件，包括 IP 地理定位、电话号码验证或邮箱验证。

entries.name: AlphaAI
entries.desc_en: Financial news API and MCP server. Every article gets per-ticker impact analysis, a category, and a 1-10 relevance score, and SEC Form 4 insider filings are turned into scored events. The free tier includes 20 requests per minute and 100 requests per day on both REST and MCP, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 财经新闻 API 和 MCP 服务器。每篇文章都会获得按股票代码的影响分析、一个类别和 1-10 的相关性评分，SEC Form 4 内部人申报文件会被转换为评分事件。免费层在 REST 和 MCP 上均包含每分钟 20 次请求和每天 100 次请求，无需绑卡。

entries.name: AnyHook
entries.desc_en: Inbound webhook relay: point a Stripe, GitHub or LINE bot webhook at it and it stores each event before delivering to your handler, retries automatically when your endpoint is down, and keeps a log you can replay from. Endpoints can be created from the API with no account. Free plan includes 3,000 events/month, 1 app, 3 retries and 3 days of retention, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 入站 webhook 中继：将 Stripe、GitHub 或 LINE 机器人的 webhook 指向它，它会在交付给你的处理程序之前存储每个事件，当你的端点宕机时自动重试，并保留可从中重放的日志。可通过 API 创建端点，无需账户。免费计划包含每月 3,000 个事件、1 个应用、3 次重试和 3 天保留期，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Apify
entries.desc_en: Web scraping and automation platform to create an API for any website and extract data. Ready-made scrapers, integrated proxies, and custom solutions. Free plan with $5 platform credits included every month.
entries.desc_zh: 网页抓取和自动化平台，可为任意网站创建 API 并提取数据。提供现成的爬虫、集成代理和定制解决方案。免费计划每月包含 $5 平台额度。

entries.name: APITemplate.io
entries.desc_en: Auto-generate images and PDF documents with a simple API or automation tools like Zapier & Airtable. No CSS/HTML is required. The free plan comes with 50 images/month and three templates.
entries.desc_zh: 通过简单的 API 或 Zapier 和 Airtable 等自动化工具自动生成图片和 PDF 文档。无需 CSS/HTML。免费计划包含每月 50 张图片和三个模板。

entries.name: APIVerve
entries.desc_en: Get instant access to over 120+ APIs for free, built with quality, consistency, and reliability in mind. The free plan covers up to 50 API Tokens per month. (Possibly taken down, 2025-06-25)
entries.desc_zh: 即时免费访问 120+ 个 API，以质量、一致性和可靠性为设计理念。免费计划每月最多覆盖 50 个 API Token。（可能已下线，2025-06-25）

entries.name: App AI Gateway
entries.desc_en: Gateway/proxy for calling AI providers from iOS applications without shipping provider keys or building your own backend. Only allows requests from your real app via App Attest, with rate limits and budgets per user and per app. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per month, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 用于从 iOS 应用程序调用 AI 提供商的网关/代理，无需发送提供商密钥或自行构建后端。仅通过 App Attest 允许来自您真实应用的请求，并对每个用户和每个应用设置速率限制和预算。免费计划每月包含 1,000 次请求，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Beeceptor
entries.desc_en: No-code, cloud-based platform for mocking and debugging multi-protocol APIs (REST, SOAP, gRPC & GraphQL), providing instant servers with rules-based logic, CRUD & stateful mocking, proxying, and CORS management for faster integration and testing. The free plan includes 50 requests per day and provides a public dashboard/endpoint where anyone with the dashboard URL can view submitted requests and responses.
entries.desc_zh: 基于云的无代码平台，用于模拟和调试多协议 API（REST、SOAP、gRPC 和 GraphQL），提供即时可用的服务器，支持基于规则的逻辑、CRUD 和有状态模拟、代理以及 CORS 管理，加快集成和测试。免费计划包含每天 50 次请求，并提供公共仪表板/端点，任何拥有仪表板 URL 的人都可以查看提交的请求和响应。

entries.name: BigDataCloud
entries.desc_en: Provides fast, accurate, and free (Unlimited or up to 10K-50K/month) APIs for modern web like IP Geolocation, Reverse Geocoding, Networking Insights, Email and Phone Validation, Client Info and more.
entries.desc_zh: 为现代 Web 提供快速、准确且免费（不限量或每月最多 10K-50K 次）的 API，包括 IP 地理定位、逆地理编码、网络洞察、邮箱和电话验证、客户端信息等。

entries.name: Brave Search API
entries.desc_en: Independent web, news, image, video search and AI/LLM context API, suitable for RAG pipelines and AI agents. Free tier includes $5 in monthly credits (credit card required for verification).
entries.desc_zh: 独立的网页、新闻、图片、视频搜索和 AI/LLM 上下文 API，适用于 RAG 管道和 AI 代理。免费层包含每月 $5 额度（验证需信用卡）。

entries.name: Browse AI
entries.desc_en: Extracting and monitoring data on the web. 1k credits per month for free, equals 1k concurrent requests.
entries.desc_zh: 提取和监控网络数据。每月免费 1k 额度，相当于 1k 个并发请求。

entries.name: Calendarific
entries.desc_en: Enterprise-grade Public holiday API service for over 200 countries. The free plan includes 500 calls per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 200 多个国家/地区的企业级公共假日 API 服务。免费计划包含每月 500 次调用。

entries.name: Canopy
entries.desc_en: GraphQL API for Amazon.com product, search, and category data. The free plan includes 100 calls per month.
entries.desc_zh: 用于 Amazon.com 商品、搜索和类别数据的 GraphQL API。免费计划包含每月 100 次调用。

entries.name: CarAPI.dev
entries.desc_en: Comprehensive automotive data API with VIN decoding, stolen vehicle checks, vehicle valuation, inspection data, and more. Free tier includes 100 requests/month across all 9 endpoints.
entries.desc_zh: 全面的汽车数据 API，包含 VIN 解码、被盗车辆查询、车辆估值、检测数据等。免费层包含每月 100 次请求，涵盖全部 9 个端点。

entries.name: CatchDoms
entries.desc_en: Aggregator of expired and dropping domain listings from 16 marketplaces, with SEO enrichment (backlinks, Trust Flow, Wayback history) and a quality score. Free plan: 10 unlocked listings, 5 favorites, 3 saved searches. 7-day Pro trial on signup includes full REST API and MCP server access.
entries.desc_zh: 聚合来自 16 个市场的过期和即将过期域名列表，提供 SEO 增强（外链、Trust Flow、Wayback 历史）和质量评分。免费计划：10 个解锁列表、5 个收藏、3 个保存的搜索。注册即享 7 天 Pro 试用，包含完整的 REST API 和 MCP 服务器访问。

entries.name: Cloudmersive
entries.desc_en: Utility API platform with full access to expansive API Library including Document Conversion, Virus Scanning, and more with 600 calls/month, North America AZ only, 2.5MB maximum file size.
entries.desc_zh: 实用工具 API 平台，可完全访问庞大的 API 库，包括文档转换、病毒扫描等，每月 600 次调用，仅限北美可用区，最大文件大小 2.5MB。

entries.name: CometML
entries.desc_en: The MLOps platform for experiment tracking, model production management, model registry, and complete data lineage, covering your workflow from training to production. Free for individuals and academics.
entries.desc_zh: MLOps 平台，用于实验跟踪、模型生产管理、模型注册表和完整的数据谱系，覆盖从训练到生产的工作流程。对个人和学术界免费。

entries.name: Commerce Layer
entries.desc_en: Composable commerce API that can build, place, and manage orders from any front end. The developer plan allows 100 orders per month and up to 1,000 SKUs for free.
entries.desc_zh: 可组合式电商 API，可从任意前端构建、下单和管理订单。开发者计划免费提供每月 100 笔订单和最多 1,000 个 SKU。

entries.name: Composio
entries.desc_en: Integration platform for AI Agents and LLMs. Integrate over 200+ tools across the agentic internet.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 AI 代理和 LLM 的集成平台。集成 200+ 个覆盖代理式互联网的工具。

entries.name: Conversion Tools
entries.desc_en: Online File Converter for documents, images, video, audio, and eBooks. REST API is available. Libraries for Node.js, PHP, Python. Support files up to 50 GB (for paid plans). The free tier is limited by file size (20MB) and number of conversions (30/Day, 300/Month).
entries.desc_zh: 在线文件转换器，支持文档、图片、视频、音频和电子书。提供 REST API。提供 Node.js、PHP、Python 的库。支持最大 50 GB 的文件（付费计划）。免费层受文件大小（20MB）和转换次数（每天 30 次、每月 300 次）限制。

entries.name: cors.dev
entries.desc_en: CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with `https://proxy.cors.dev/`. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.
entries.desc_zh: 用于从前端代码调用第三方 API 的 CORS 代理：在任意 HTTPS URL 前加上 `https://proxy.cors.dev/`。GET 和 HEAD 请求免费，无需注册或 API 密钥，每 IP 每分钟 600 次请求，响应大小最高 1 MiB，无月度配额。

entries.name: Country-State-City Microservice API
entries.desc_en: API and Microservice to provides a wide range of information including countries, regions, provinces, cities, postal codes, and much more. The free tier includes up to 100 requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: 提供广泛信息的 API 和微服务，包括国家、地区、省份、城市、邮政编码等。免费层每天最多 100 次请求。

entries.name: Coupler
entries.desc_en: Data integration tool that syncs between apps. It can create live dashboards and reports, transform and manipulate values, and collect and back up insights. The free plan is limited to one user, data connection, data source, and data destination. Also requires manual data refresh.
entries.desc_zh: 在应用之间同步的数据集成工具。可创建实时仪表盘和报告、转换和处理数值，以及收集和备份洞察。免费计划仅限一名用户、一个数据连接、一个数据源和一个数据目标。还需要手动刷新数据。

entries.name: CraftMyPDF
entries.desc_en: Auto-Generate PDF documents from reusable templates with a drop-and-drop editor and a simple API. The free plan comes with 100 PDFs/month and three templates.
entries.desc_zh: 通过拖放编辑器和简单的 API 从可复用模板自动生成 PDF 文档。免费计划包含每月 100 份 PDF 和三个模板。

entries.name: Cube
entries.desc_en: Cube helps data engineers and application developers access data from modern data stores, organize it into consistent definitions, and deliver it to every application. The fastest way to use Cube is with Cube Cloud, which has a free tier limited to 1,000 queries per day.
entries.desc_zh: Cube 帮助数据工程师和应用开发人员从现代数据存储中访问数据，将其组织为一致的定义，并交付到每个应用。使用 Cube 最快的方式是 Cube Cloud，其免费层限制为每天 1,000 次查询。

entries.name: CurlHub
entries.desc_en: Proxy service for inspecting and debugging API calls. The free plan includes 10,000 requests per month.
entries.desc_zh: 用于检查和调试 API 调用的代理服务。免费计划包含每月 10,000 次请求。

entries.name: CurrencyScoop
entries.desc_en: Realtime currency data API for fintech apps. The free plan includes 5,000 calls per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向金融科技应用的实时货币数据 API。免费计划包含每月 5,000 次调用。

entries.name: CustomJS
entries.desc_en: HTML to PDF or PDF to PNG/Text & PDF merging/extraction/merging APIs. Free tier has 600 calls a month.
entries.desc_zh: HTML 转 PDF、PDF 转 PNG/文本，以及 PDF 合并/提取/合并 API。免费层每月 600 次调用。

entries.name: Data Fetcher
entries.desc_en: Connect Airtable to any application or API with no code. Postman-like interface for running API requests in Airtable. Pre-built integrations with dozens of apps. The free plan includes 100 runs per month.
entries.desc_zh: 无需代码即可将 Airtable 连接到任何应用或 API。提供类似 Postman 的界面，用于在 Airtable 中运行 API 请求。内置与数十款应用的集成。免费计划包含每月 100 次运行。

entries.name: Dataimporter.io
entries.desc_en: Tool for connecting, cleaning, and importing data into Salesforce. Free Plan includes up to 20,000 records per month.
entries.desc_zh: 用于连接、清理数据并导入 Salesforce 的工具。免费计划包含每月最多 20,000 条记录。

entries.name: Datalore
entries.desc_en: Python notebooks by Jetbrains. Includes 10 GB of storage and 120 hours of runtime each month.
entries.desc_zh: Jetbrains 出品的 Python 笔记本。包含每月 10 GB 存储空间和 120 小时运行时长。

entries.name: DB Designer
entries.desc_en: Cloud-based Database schema design and modeling tool with a free starter plan of 2 Database models and ten tables per model.
entries.desc_zh: 基于云的数据库 schema 设计与建模工具，免费入门套餐提供 2 个数据库模型，每个模型 10 张表。

entries.name: DB-IP
entries.desc_en: Free IP geolocation API with 1k request per IP per day.lite database under the CC-BY 4.0 License is free too.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 IP 地理定位 API，每个 IP 每天 1k 次请求。CC-BY 4.0 许可下的 lite 数据库也免费。

entries.name: DeepAR
entries.desc_en: Augmented reality face filters for any platform with one SDK. The free plan provides up to 10 monthly active users (MAU) and tracks up to 4 faces
entries.desc_zh: 通过一个 SDK 为任何平台提供增强现实面部滤镜。免费计划支持最多 10 个月度活跃用户（MAU），最多可追踪 4 张人脸

entries.name: Deepnote
entries.desc_en: A new data science notebook. Jupyter is compatible with real-time collaboration and running in the cloud. The free tier includes unlimited personal projects, unlimited basic machines with 5GB RAM and 2vCPU, and teams with up to 3 editors.
entries.desc_zh: 全新的数据科学笔记本。兼容 Jupyter，支持实时协作和云端运行。免费层包含无限个人项目、配备 5GB 内存和 2vCPU 的无限基础机器，以及最多 3 名编辑者的团队。

entries.name: Compare JSON
entries.desc_en: An online tool for comparing differences between two JSON data structures, helping you quickly locate the differences in JSON data.
entries.desc_zh: 一款在线比较两个 JSON 数据结构差异的工具，帮助你快速定位 JSON 数据中的差异。

entries.name: Disease.sh
entries.desc_en: A free API providing accurate data for building the Covid-19 related useful Apps.
entries.desc_zh: 一款免费 API，为构建 Covid-19 相关的实用应用提供准确数据。

entries.name: Doczilla
entries.desc_en: SaaS API empowering the generation of screenshots or PDFs directly from HTML/CSS/JS code. The free plan allows 250 documents month.
entries.desc_zh: SaaS API，可直接从 HTML/CSS/JS 代码生成截图或 PDF。免费计划每月允许 250 份文档。

entries.name: Doppio
entries.desc_en: Managed API to generate and privately store PDFs and Screenshots using top rendering technology. The free plan allows 400 PDFs and Screenshots per month.
entries.desc_zh: 托管 API，使用顶级渲染技术生成并私密存储 PDF 和截图。免费计划每月允许 400 份 PDF 和截图。

entries.name: Doqlo
entries.desc_en: Bulk fill and mail merge PDF forms from CSV using the web app or Public API. The free plan includes 100 output PDFs/month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 Web 应用或公开 API 从 CSV 批量填充 PDF 表单并进行邮件合并。免费计划包含每月 100 份输出 PDF。

entries.name: Dynamic Document API
entries.desc_en: Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.
entries.desc_zh: 将数据转换为像素完美的 PDF 和图片。免费计划包含每月 50 次渲染，以及访问模板库中的 2 个模板或您自己的模板。

entries.name: DynamicDocs
entries.desc_en: Generate PDF documents with JSON to PDF API based on LaTeX templates. The free plan allows 50 API calls per month and access to a library of templates.
entries.desc_zh: 使用基于 LaTeX 模板的 JSON 转 PDF API 生成 PDF 文档。免费计划每月允许 50 次 API 调用，并可访问模板库。

entries.name: Earnings Feed
entries.desc_en: Real-time SEC filings, insider trades, and institutional holdings API. Free tier includes 15 requests per minute.
entries.desc_zh: 实时 SEC 文件、内部人交易和机构持仓 API。免费层包含每分钟 15 次请求。

entries.name: Estuary
entries.desc_en: Real-time data integration platform for CDC, streaming, and batch data integration with 200+ managed connectors. Free plan includes 10 GB/month of data movement and up to 2 connector instances, with no time limit and no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 CDC、流式和批处理数据集成的实时数据集成平台，拥有 200+ 托管连接器。免费计划包含每月 10 GB 数据移动量和最多 2 个连接器实例，无时间限制，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Export SDK
entries.desc_en: PDF generator API with drag-and-drop template editor that provides an SDK and no-code integrations. The free plan has 250 monthly pages, unlimited users, and three templates.
entries.desc_zh: 带有拖放模板编辑器的 PDF 生成 API，提供 SDK 和无代码集成。免费计划包含每月 250 页、不限用户数和三个模板。

entries.name: Financial Data
entries.desc_en: Stock market and financial data API. Free plan allows 300 requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: 股票市场和金融数据 API。免费套餐每天允许 300 次请求。

entries.name: finlight
entries.desc_en: Real-time financial news API with entity resolution (tickers, ISIN) and sentiment tagging, available over REST, WebSocket, webhooks and an MCP server. Free tier: 5,000 requests/month on both REST and MCP, 12-hour delayed articles, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 实时财经新闻 API，具备实体解析（股票代码、ISIN）和情绪标注功能，可通过 REST、WebSocket、webhooks 和 MCP 服务器使用。免费层：REST 和 MCP 均为每月 5,000 次请求，文章延迟 12 小时，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.desc_en: API that crawls websites and converts them into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data, handling JavaScript rendering, proxies, and rate limits. The free plan includes 1,000 credits per month with no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 抓取网站并将其转换为干净、适合 LLM 使用的 markdown 或结构化数据的 API，可处理 JavaScript 渲染、代理和速率限制。免费计划包含每月 1,000 个额度，无需信用卡。

entries.name: flaky
entries.desc_en: A mock API where you can paste your JSON and simulate API problems like delays, errors, failed requests, and malformed responses. 1,000 requests per day without a key, or 10,000 requests per day with a free key. There is no paid tier.
entries.desc_zh: 一个模拟 API，你可以粘贴自己的 JSON 并模拟 API 问题，如延迟、错误、失败请求和格式错误的响应。无密钥时每天 1,000 次请求，使用免费密钥则每天 10,000 次请求。没有付费层。

entries.name: Formfeed
entries.desc_en: API for PDF and image generation from JSON with a simple API or automation tools like Zapier & Make. The free plan includes 100 free PDF conversions per month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过简单 API 或 Zapier & Make 等自动化工具从 JSON 生成 PDF 和图像的 API。免费计划包含每月 100 次免费 PDF 转换。

entries.name: FraudLabs Pro
entries.desc_en: Screen an order transaction for credit card payment fraud. This REST API will detect all possible fraud traits based on the input parameters of an order. The Free Micro plan has 500 transactions per month.
entries.desc_zh: 筛查订单交易中的信用卡支付欺诈。此 REST API 会根据订单的输入参数检测所有可能的欺诈特征。免费 Micro 计划每月 500 笔交易。

entries.name: FreeIPAPI
entries.desc_en: Free, Fast and Reliable IP Geolocation API for commercial and non-commercial users available in JSON
entries.desc_zh: 面向商业和非商业用户的免费、快速、可靠的 IP 地理定位 API，以 JSON 格式提供

entries.name: Geolocated.io
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API with multi-continent servers, offering a free plan with 2,000 requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: 拥有多洲服务器的 IP 地理定位 API，提供每天 2,000 次请求的免费计划。

entries.name: Hex
entries.desc_en: a collaborative data platform for notebooks, data apps, and knowledge libraries. Free community tier with up to five projects.
entries.desc_zh: 一个用于笔记本、数据应用和知识库的协作数据平台。免费社区层级最多支持五个项目。

entries.name: Hook0
entries.desc_en: Hook0 is an open-source Webhooks-as-a-service (WaaS) that makes it easy for online products to provide webhooks. Dispatch up to 100 events/day with seven days of history retention for free.
entries.desc_zh: Hook0 是一个开源的 Webhooks 即服务 (WaaS)，使在线产品能够轻松提供 webhooks。免费计划可每天分发最多 100 个事件，保留七天历史记录。

entries.name: Hoppscotch
entries.desc_en: A free, fast, and beautiful API request builder.
entries.desc_zh: 一款免费、快速、美观的 API 请求构建工具。

entries.name: HS Ping
entries.desc_en: A multi-country HS (Harmonized System) and HTS (Harmonized Tariff System) code lookup API, with a free plan offering 100 lookups/day.
entries.desc_zh: 多国 HS（协调制度）和 HTS（协调关税制度）编码查询 API，免费计划提供每天 100 次查询。

entries.name: huggingface.co
entries.desc_en: Build, train, and deploy NLP models for Pytorch, TensorFlow, and JAX. Free up to 30k input characters/mo.
entries.desc_zh: 为 Pytorch、TensorFlow 和 JAX 构建、训练和部署 NLP 模型。免费额度为每月最多 30k 输入字符。

entries.name: Insomnia
entries.desc_en: Open-source API client for designing and testing APIs, it supports REST and GraphQL
entries.desc_zh: 用于设计和测试 API 的开源 API 客户端，支持 REST 和 GraphQL

entries.name: Inngest
entries.desc_en: Durable execution and event-driven workflows for TypeScript, Python, and Go. Hobby plan is free with 50k executions/month, 5 concurrent steps, 500k events ingested, and no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 TypeScript、Python 和 Go 的持久化执行与事件驱动工作流。Hobby 计划免费，包含每月 50k 次执行、5 个并发步骤、50 万条摄入事件，且无需信用卡。

entries.name: Invantive Cloud
entries.desc_en: Access over 70 (cloud)platforms such as Exact Online, Twinfield, ActiveCampaign or Visma using Invantive SQL or OData4 (typically Power BI or Power Query). Includes data replication and exchange. Free plan for developers and implementation consultants. Free for specific platforms with limitations in data volumes.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 Invantive SQL 或 OData4（通常配合 Power BI 或 Power Query）访问 Exact Online、Twinfield、ActiveCampaign 或 Visma 等 70 多个（云）平台。包含数据复制与交换。面向开发者和实施顾问提供免费计划。特定平台免费，但数据量有限制。

entries.name: IP Geolocation API by ipwho.org
entries.desc_en: 2,000 free requests per day. Fast, enterprise grade API at non-enterprise prices. Trusted by developers, corporate, government and education clients. Servers in 12+ regions.
entries.desc_zh: 每天 2,000 次免费请求。以非企业级价格提供快速的企业级 API。深受开发者、企业、政府和教育客户信赖。服务器遍布 12+ 个地区。

entries.name: IP Geolocation API
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API from Abstract - Allows 1,000 free requests.
entries.desc_zh: 来自 Abstract 的 IP Geolocation API - 允许 1,000 次免费请求。

entries.name: IP Geolocation
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API - Forever free plan for developers with a 1,000 requests per day limit.
entries.desc_zh: IP Geolocation API - 面向开发者的永久免费计划，每天限 1,000 次请求。

entries.name: ip-api
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API, Free for non-commercial use, no API key required, limited to 45 req/minute from the same IP address for the free plan.
entries.desc_zh: IP Geolocation API，非商业用途免费，无需 API key，免费计划限同一 IP 地址每分钟 45 次请求。

entries.name: IP.City
entries.desc_en: 100 Free IP geolocation requests per day
entries.desc_zh: 每天 100 次免费 IP 地理位置查询

entries.name: IP2Location.io
entries.desc_en: Freemium, fast, and reliable IP geolocation API. Get data like city, coordinates, ISP, ASN, AS data and more. The free plan includes 50k credits per month. IP2Location.io also offers 500 free WHOIS and hosted domain lookups per month. See domain registration details and find domains hosted on a specific IP. Upgrade to a paid plan for more features.
entries.desc_zh: 免费增值、快速且可靠的 IP 地理定位 API。可获取城市、坐标、ISP、ASN、AS 数据等信息。免费计划每月包含 5 万 credits。IP2Location.io 还提供每月 500 次免费 WHOIS 和托管域名查询。查看域名注册详情，并查找托管在特定 IP 上的域名。升级到付费计划可获得更多功能。

entries.name: Proxmint GeoIP
entries.desc_en: Free IP → country/city/ASN JSON API, no key, CORS-open. MaxMind GeoLite2.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 IP → 国家/城市/ASN JSON API，无需 key，开放 CORS。MaxMind GeoLite2。

entries.name: ip2geo.dev
entries.desc_en: IP geolocation API to convert IP addresses into location data including city, country, timezone, ASN, and currency. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per month.
entries.desc_zh: IP 地理定位 API，将 IP 地址转换为包含城市、国家、时区、ASN 和货币在内的位置数据。免费计划每月包含 1,000 次请求。

entries.name: IP99
entries.desc_en: IP risk and geolocation API with passive DNS and certificate transparency. Free without a key: 500 IP lookups/day; 10 domain/cert trial lookups/day.
entries.desc_zh: 带有被动 DNS 和证书透明度的 IP 风险与地理定位 API。无需 key 即可免费使用：每天 500 次 IP 查询；每天 10 次域名/证书试用查询。

entries.name: ipaddress.sh
entries.desc_en: Simple service to get a public IP address in different [formats](https://about.ipaddress.sh/).
entries.desc_zh: 简单的服务，以不同的 [formats](https://about.ipaddress.sh/) 获取公网 IP 地址。

entries.name: ipapi.is
entries.desc_en: A reliable IP Address API from Developers for Developers with the best Hosting Detection capabilities that exist. The free plan offers 1000 lookups without signup.
entries.desc_zh: 由开发者打造、为开发者服务的可靠 IP 地址 API，拥有目前最出色的托管检测能力。免费计划无需注册即可提供 1000 次查询。

entries.name: ipapi
entries.desc_en: IP Address Location API by Kloudend, Inc - A reliable geolocation API built on AWS, trusted by Fortune 500. The free tier offers 30k lookups/month (1k/day) without signup.
entries.desc_zh: Kloudend, Inc 出品的 IP 地址定位 API - 基于 AWS 构建的可靠地理定位 API，深受 Fortune 500 信赖。免费层无需注册即可提供每月 3 万次查询（每天 1,000 次）。

entries.name: ipbase.com
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API - Forever free plan that spans 150 monthly requests.
entries.desc_zh: IP Geolocation API - 永久免费计划，包含每月 150 次请求。

entries.name: IPinfo
entries.desc_en: Fast, accurate, and free (up to 50k/month) IP address data API. Offers APIs with details on geolocation, companies, carriers, IP ranges, domains, abuse contacts, and more. All paid APIs can be trialed for free.
entries.desc_zh: 快速、准确且免费（每月最多 5 万次）的 IP 地址数据 API。提供包含地理位置、公司、运营商、IP 段、域名、滥用联系人等详情的 API。所有付费 API 均可免费试用。

entries.name: IPLocate
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API, free up to 1,000 requests/day. Includes proxy/VPN/hosting detection, ASN data, IP to Company, and more. IPLocate also offers free downloadable IP to Country and IP to ASN databases in CSV or GeoIP-compatible MMDB formats.
entries.desc_zh: IP Geolocation API，每天最多 1,000 次请求免费。包括代理/VPN/托管检测、ASN 数据、IP to Company 等。IPLocate 还提供可免费下载的 IP to Country 和 IP to ASN 数据库，格式为 CSV 或兼容 GeoIP 的 MMDB。

entries.name: IPTrace
entries.desc_en: An embarrassingly simple API that provides your business with reliable and helpful IP geolocation data with 50,000 free lookups per month.
entries.desc_zh: 一个简单得出奇的 API，为你的企业提供可靠且实用的 IP 地理位置数据，每月 50,000 次免费查询。

entries.name: JSON IP
entries.desc_en: Returns the Public IP address of the client it is requested from. No registration is required for the free tier. Using CORS, data can be requested using client-side JS directly from the browser. Useful for services monitoring change in client and server IPs. Unlimited Requests.
entries.desc_zh: 返回发起请求的客户端的公网 IP 地址。免费层无需注册。借助 CORS，可以使用客户端 JS 直接从浏览器请求数据。适用于监控客户端和服务器 IP 变化的服务。请求数量不限。

entries.name: JSON to Table
entries.desc_en: Convert JSON into an interactive table for quick viewing, editing, and sharing online.
entries.desc_zh: 将 JSON 转换为交互式表格，便于在线快速查看、编辑和分享。

entries.name: JSON2Video
entries.desc_en: A video editing API to automate video marketing and social media videos, programmatically or with no code.
entries.desc_zh: 一个视频编辑 API，可通过编程或无代码方式自动制作视频营销和社交媒体视频。

entries.name: JSONing
entries.desc_en: Create a fake REST API from a JSON object, and customize HTTP status codes, headers, and response bodies.
entries.desc_zh: 从 JSON 对象创建假的 REST API，并可自定义 HTTP 状态码、响应头和响应体。

entries.name: Jsonpage
entries.desc_en: Company data API for France and 13 other countries (SIREN, SIRET, VAT check). Free plan: 1,000 requests per day, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 面向法国及其他 13 个国家的公司数据 API（SIREN、SIRET、VAT 校验）。免费计划：每天 1,000 次请求，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Labelixa
entries.desc_en: Zebra ZPL label rendering and validation API and browser viewer. Free tier includes an anonymous rendering quota and barcode generation with no watermark, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: Zebra ZPL 标签渲染与校验 API 及浏览器查看器。免费层包含匿名渲染配额以及无水印的条形码生成，无需绑卡。

entries.name: LayerCall
entries.desc_en: Fraud and trust scoring for an IP, email, phone, domain or device in one call, plus authorization and Web Bot Auth verification for AI agents. 1,000 lookups/month free, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 一次调用即可对 IP、邮箱、电话、域名或设备进行欺诈与信任评分，并为 AI agents 提供授权和 Web Bot Auth 验证。每月 1,000 次查询免费，无需绑卡。

entries.name: LoginLlama
entries.desc_en: A login security API to detect fraudulent and suspicious logins and notify your customers. Free for 1,000 logins per month.
entries.desc_zh: 一个登录安全 API，用于检测欺诈性和可疑登录并通知你的客户。每月 1,000 次登录免费。

entries.name: Market Data API
entries.desc_en: Provides real-time and historical financial data for stocks, options, mutual funds, and more. The Free Forever API tier allows for 100 daily API requests at no charge.
entries.desc_zh: 提供股票、期权、共同基金等的实时和历史金融数据。Free Forever API 层级每天免费提供 100 次 API 请求。

entries.name: Maxim AI
entries.desc_en: Simulate, evaluate, and observe your AI agents. Maxim is an end-to-end evaluation and observability platform, helping teams ship their AI agents reliably and >5x faster. Free forever for indie developers and small teams (3 seats).
entries.desc_zh: 模拟、评估和观测你的 AI agents。Maxim 是一个端到端的评估与可观测性平台，帮助团队更可靠、速度提升 5 倍以上地发布其 AI agents。独立开发者和小团队（3 个席位）永久免费。

entries.name: microlink.io
entries.desc_en: It turns any website into data such as metatags normalization, beauty link previews, scraping capabilities, or screenshots as a service. 50 requests per day, every day free.
entries.desc_zh: 它将任何网站转化为数据，例如 metatags 规范化、美观的链接预览、抓取功能或截图即服务。每天 50 次请求，天天免费。

entries.name: Mintlify
entries.desc_en: Modern standard for API documentation. Beautiful and easy-to-maintain UI components, in-app search, and interactive playground. Free for 1 editor.
entries.desc_zh: API 文档的现代标准。美观且易于维护的 UI 组件、应用内搜索和交互式 playground。1 名编辑者免费。

entries.name: MockAPI
entries.desc_en: MockAPI is a simple tool that lets you quickly mock up APIs, generate custom data, and perform operations using a RESTful interface. MockAPI is meant to be a prototyping/testing/learning tool. One project/2 resources per project for free.
entries.desc_zh: MockAPI 是一款简单工具，可让你快速模拟 API、生成自定义数据，并通过 RESTful 接口执行操作。MockAPI 旨在用作原型设计/测试/学习工具。免费提供 1 个项目，每个项目 2 个资源。

entries.name: Mockerito
entries.desc_en: Free mock REST API service providing realistic data across 9 domains (e-commerce, finance, healthcare, education, recruitment, social media, stock markets, weather, and aviation). No mandatory signup, no API keys, unlimited requests. Perfect for frontend prototyping, API testing, learning and teaching web development.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的模拟 REST API 服务，提供涵盖 9 个领域（电商、金融、医疗、教育、招聘、社交媒体、股市、天气和航空）的真实数据。无需强制注册，无需 API key，请求数量不限。非常适合前端原型设计、API 测试以及学习和教授 Web 开发。

entries.name: Mockfly
entries.desc_en: Mockfly is a trusted development tool for API mocking and feature flag management. Quickly generate and control mock APIs with an intuitive interface. The free tier offers 500 requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: Mockfly 是一款值得信赖的 API 模拟与 feature flag 管理开发工具。通过直观的界面快速生成和控制 mock API。免费层每天提供 500 次请求。

entries.name: Mocko.dev
entries.desc_en: Proxy your API, choose which endpoints to mock in the cloud and inspect traffic, for free. Speed up your development and integration tests.
entries.desc_zh: 免费代理你的 API，选择在云端 mock 哪些端点并检查流量。加速你的开发和集成测试。

entries.name: Multi-Exit IP Address Checker
entries.desc_en: A free and simple tool to check your exit IP address across multiple nodes and understand how your IP appears to different global regions and services. Useful for testing rule-based DNS splitting tools such as Control D.
entries.desc_zh: 一个免费且简单的工具，用于在多个节点上检查你的出口 IP 地址，了解你的 IP 在不同全球区域和服务面前的呈现方式。适用于测试基于规则的 DNS 分流工具，如 Control D。

entries.name: NASdisks Drive Data API
entries.desc_en: Free, no-key, CORS-enabled API for NAS HDD/SSD specifications, per-model CMR/SMR classification, and annualized failure rates derived from Backblaze Drive Stats. Returns JSON or CSV, CC BY 4.0, no signup.
entries.desc_zh: 免费、无需 key、支持 CORS 的 API，提供 NAS HDD/SSD 规格、各型号的 CMR/SMR 分类，以及源自 Backblaze Drive Stats 的年化故障率。返回 JSON 或 CSV，采用 CC BY 4.0 协议，无需注册。

entries.name: Network Data Labs
entries.desc_en: An IP geolocation API with accuracy radius and confidence level, ASN, and Tor, known VPN, privacy relay and hosting signals. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: 一个 IP 地理定位 API，提供精度半径与置信度、ASN，以及 Tor、已知 VPN、隐私中继和托管信号。免费计划每天包含 1,000 次请求。

entries.name: News API
entries.desc_en: Search news on the web with code, and get JSON results. Developers get 100 queries free each day. Articles have a 24 hour delay.
entries.desc_zh: 用代码搜索网络上的新闻，并获取 JSON 结果。开发者每天可免费查询 100 次。文章有 24 小时延迟。

entries.name: OCR.Space
entries.desc_en: An OCR API parses image and pdf files that return the text results in JSON format. 25,000 requests per month are free and a 1MB file size limit.
entries.desc_zh: 一个 OCR API，解析图像和 PDF 文件并以 JSON 格式返回文本结果。每月 25,000 次请求免费，文件大小限制 1MB。

entries.name: OpenAPI3 Designer
entries.desc_en: Visually create Open API 3 definitions for free.
entries.desc_zh: 免费以可视化方式创建 Open API 3 定义。

entries.name: Orshot
entries.desc_en: Automate Videos, PDFs and Images from templates via API, n8n, Zapier and AI Agents. Design templates in a visual editor (or import from Canva or Figma), then automate bulk generation from your data source. The free plan includes 100 render credits every month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 API、n8n、Zapier 和 AI Agents，从模板自动生成视频、PDF 和图像。在可视化编辑器中设计模板（或从 Canva 或 Figma 导入），然后从你的数据源自动批量生成。免费计划每月包含 100 个 render credits。

entries.name: Parseur
entries.desc_en: 20 free pages/month: Extract data from PDFs, emails. AI powered. Full API access.
entries.desc_zh: 每月 20 页免费：从 PDF 和电子邮件中提取数据。AI 驱动。完整的 API 访问。

entries.name: PDF-API.io
entries.desc_en: PDF Automation API, visual template editor or HTML to PDF, dynamic data integration, and PDF rendering with an API. The free plan comes with one template, 100 PDFs/month.
entries.desc_zh: PDF 自动化 API，可视化模板编辑器或 HTML 转 PDF，动态数据集成，以及通过 API 进行 PDF 渲染。免费版包含一个模板，每月 100 个 PDF。

entries.name: PDFBolt
entries.desc_en: Developer-focused PDF generation API designed with privacy in mind. It offers Stripe-inspired documentation and includes 500 free PDF conversions per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者、注重隐私设计的 PDF 生成 API。它提供受 Stripe 启发的文档，并包含每月 500 次免费 PDF 转换。

entries.name: Pexafy
entries.desc_en: Semantic image search API across 9 free photo sources (Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics & more), 9M+ photos under one JSON schema instead of one integration per source. Plain-language queries, reverse image search, filters on color, orientation and license. CORS is open on read endpoints, so it runs from the browser. The free plan includes 5,000 API requests/month and 1 key, no app review.
entries.desc_zh: 跨 9 个免费图片来源（Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay、Kaboompics 等）的语义图像搜索 API，超过 900 万张照片统一在一个 JSON schema 下，无需对每个来源单独集成。支持自然语言查询、反向图搜索，以及按颜色、方向和许可过滤。读取端点开放 CORS，可直接从浏览器运行。免费套餐包含每月 5,000 次 API 请求和 1 个密钥，无需应用审核。

entries.name: Pixela
entries.desc_en: Free daystream database service. All operations are performed by API. Visualization with heat maps and line graphs is also possible.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 daystream 数据库服务。所有操作均通过 API 执行。还支持通过热力图和折线图进行可视化。

entries.name: Posthook
entries.desc_en: Schedule webhooks to fire at a future time with automatic retries, delivery tracking, and failure alerting. Free plan includes 1,000 webhooks per month.
entries.desc_zh: 安排 webhooks 在未来指定时间触发，支持自动重试、送达跟踪和失败告警。免费套餐包含每月 1,000 个 webhooks。

entries.name: Postman
entries.desc_en: Simplify workflows and create better APIs - faster - with Postman, a collaboration platform for API development. Use the Postman App for free forever. Postman cloud features are also free forever with certain limits.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 API 开发协作平台 Postman 简化工作流，更快地创建更好的 API。永久免费使用 Postman App。Postman 云端功能也永久免费，但有一定的限制。

entries.name: PrefectCloud
entries.desc_en: A complete platform for dataflow automation. Free plan includes 5 deployed workflows and 500 minutes of serverless compute credits per month.
entries.desc_zh: 一个完整的数据流自动化平台。免费套餐包含每月 5 个已部署的工作流和 500 分钟的无服务器计算额度。

entries.name: Preset Cloud
entries.desc_en: A hosted Apache Superset service. Forever free for teams of up to 5 users, featuring unlimited dashboards and charts, a no-code chart builder, and a collaborative SQL editor.
entries.desc_zh: 一个托管的 Apache Superset 服务。对最多 5 名用户的团队永久免费，提供无限制的仪表板和图表、无代码图表构建器以及协作式 SQL 编辑器。

entries.name: ProxySentry
entries.desc_en: IP API that detects residential proxies and VPNs. ProxySentry.io offers a free tier with 10k requests per month on rapidapi.com.
entries.desc_zh: 检测住宅代理和 VPN 的 IP API。ProxySentry.io 在 rapidapi.com 上提供每月 10k 次请求的免费层。

entries.name: Publora
entries.desc_en: Publishing API: post or schedule to 10 social networks with one HTTPS call, or from an AI agent over MCP. Free forever: 15 posts/month, 3 connected accounts, all networks except X.
entries.desc_zh: 发布 API：通过一次 HTTPS 调用即可向 10 个社交网络发布或定时发布内容，也可通过 MCP 由 AI 代理发布。永久免费：每月 15 条帖子、3 个关联账户，支持除 X 外的所有网络。

entries.name: Reducto
entries.desc_en: Turn any unstructured documents (PDF, XLSX, JPG, PPTX, etc.) into structured JSON data. Parse, extract data, and edit PDF forms. Free tier with 15k free credits and pay-as-you-go.
entries.desc_zh: 将任何非结构化文档（PDF、XLSX、JPG、PPTX 等）转换为结构化 JSON 数据。可解析、提取数据并编辑 PDF 表单。免费层提供 15k 免费额度，并支持按量付费。

entries.name: Rendi
entries.desc_en: FFmpeg API - A REST API for FFmpeg, run FFmpeg online without handling the infrastructure. Free tier with monthly processing quota and 4 vCPUs available.
entries.desc_zh: FFmpeg API - 一个用于 FFmpeg 的 REST API，可在线运行 FFmpeg，无需处理底层基础设施。免费层包含每月处理配额，并提供 4 个 vCPU。

entries.name: RequestBin.com
entries.desc_en: Create a free endpoint to which you can send HTTP requests. Any HTTP requests sent to that endpoint will be recorded with the associated payload and headers so you can observe recommendations from webhooks and other services.
entries.desc_zh: 创建一个免费的端点，你可以向其发送 HTTP 请求。发送到该端点的任何 HTTP 请求都会连同相关的 payload 和 headers 一起被记录下来，以便你查看来自 webhooks 和其他服务的建议。

entries.name: ROIC.ai
entries.desc_en: Financial Data API: income statements, balance sheets and cash flows, and earnings call transcripts (with audio and slides) for 68k+ companies. Free tier: 5 requests/minute, 2 years of history, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 金融数据 API：涵盖 68k+ 家公司的利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表以及财报电话会议记录（含音频和幻灯片）。免费层：每分钟 5 次请求、2 年历史数据，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Simplescraper
entries.desc_en: Trigger your webhook after each operation. The free plan includes 100 cloud scrape credits.
entries.desc_zh: 在每次操作后触发你的 webhook。免费套餐包含 100 个云端抓取额度。

entries.name: Geekflare API
entries.desc_en: Geekflare API lets you scrape websites into Markdown, take screenshots, perform TLS scans and DNS lookups, test load times, and more. The free plan offers 500 API credits per month (e.g., 500 DNS lookups, 250 web scrapes, or 100 screenshots). See [credit mapping](https://docs.geekflare.com/api/api-credit-mapping).
entries.desc_zh: Geekflare API 可将网站抓取为 Markdown、截图、执行 TLS 扫描和 DNS 查询、测试加载时间等。免费套餐每月提供 500 个 API 额度（例如 500 次 DNS 查询、250 次网页抓取或 100 次截图）。参见 [credit mapping](https://docs.geekflare.com/api/api-credit-mapping)。

entries.name: SmartParse
entries.desc_en: SmartParse is a data migration and CSV to API platform that offers time- and cost-saving developer tools. The Free tier includes 300 Processing Units per month, Browser uploads, Data quarantining, Circuit breakers, and Job Alerts.
entries.desc_zh: SmartParse 是一个数据迁移和 CSV 转 API 平台，提供节省时间和成本的开发者工具。免费层包含每月 300 个 Processing Units、浏览器上传、数据隔离、熔断器和任务警报。

entries.name: Sofodata
entries.desc_en: Create secure RESTful APIs from CSV files. Upload a CSV file and instantly access the data via its API allowing faster application development. The free plan includes 2 APIs and 2,500 API calls per month. You don't need a credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 从 CSV 文件创建安全的 RESTful API。上传 CSV 文件即可立即通过其 API 访问数据，加快应用开发。免费套餐包含 2 个 API 和每月 2,500 次 API 调用。无需信用卡。

entries.name: Svix
entries.desc_en: Webhooks as a Service. Send up to 50,000 messages/month for free.
entries.desc_zh: Webhooks 即服务。免费每月发送最多 50,000 条消息。

entries.name: Tavily AI
entries.desc_en: API for online search and rapid insights and comprehensive research, with the capability of organization of research results. 1000 request/month for the Free tier with No credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 用于在线搜索、快速洞察和全面研究的 API，具备组织研究结果的功能。免费套餐每月提供 1000 次请求，无需信用卡。

entries.name: TemplateFox
entries.desc_en: PDF generation API with a visual template editor, dynamic data merging, and SDKs for 7 languages. Free plan includes 60 PDFs/month and 3 templates.
entries.desc_zh: PDF 生成 API，带可视化模板编辑器、动态数据合并以及 7 种语言的 SDK。免费套餐包含每月 60 个 PDF 和 3 个模板。

entries.name: The IP API
entries.desc_en: IP Geolocation API with 1000 free requests / day. Provides information about the location of an IP address, including country, city, region, and more.
entries.desc_zh: IP 地理定位 API，每天 1000 次免费请求。提供 IP 地址的位置信息，包括国家、城市、地区等。

entries.name: timezone.io
entries.desc_en: Current time, UTC offset and DST for any time zone or IP address, compatible with the shut-down WorldTimeAPI (clients only change the host). Free with no API key or sign-up, 60 requests/minute per IP, over HTTPS or plain HTTP.
entries.desc_zh: 提供任何时区或 IP 地址的当前时间、UTC 偏移量和夏令时信息，与已停运的 WorldTimeAPI 兼容（客户端只需更改主机）。免费且无需 API 密钥或注册，每 IP 每分钟 60 次请求，支持 HTTPS 或纯 HTTP。

entries.name: TinyMCE
entries.desc_en: rich text editing API. Core features are free for unlimited usage.
entries.desc_zh: 富文本编辑 API。核心功能免费且不限使用量。

entries.name: Tomorrow.io Weather API
entries.desc_en: Offers free plan of weather API. Provides accurate and up-to-date weather forecasting with global coverage, historical data and weather monitoring solutions.
entries.desc_zh: 提供天气 API 的免费套餐。提供准确、最新的天气预报，覆盖全球，包含历史数据和天气监测解决方案。

entries.name: Treblle
entries.desc_en: Treblle helps teams build, ship, and govern APIs. With advanced API log aggregation, observability, docs, and debugging. You get all features for free, but there is a limit of up to 250k requests per month on the free tier.
entries.desc_zh: Treblle 帮助团队构建、发布和治理 API，具备高级 API 日志聚合、可观测性、文档和调试功能。所有功能均可免费使用，但免费层每月最多限制 250k 次请求。

entries.name: Trophy
entries.desc_en: Trophy is the gamification layer for consumer apps. Use pre-built APIs and open-source UI components to ship achievements, streaks, points, leaderboards and more. Free for up to 1,000 monthly active users.
entries.desc_zh: Trophy 是面向消费级应用的游戏化层。使用预构建的 API 和开源 UI 组件实现成就、连续记录、积分、排行榜等功能。最多 1,000 个月活跃用户可免费使用。

entries.name: UniRateAPI
entries.desc_en: Real-time exchange rates for 590+ currencies and crypto. Unlimited API calls on the free plan, perfect for developers and finance apps.
entries.desc_zh: 590+ 种货币和加密货币的实时汇率。免费套餐提供不限量 API 调用，非常适合开发者和金融应用。

entries.name: URLpipe
entries.desc_en: Read any page after its JavaScript runs: Markdown, screenshots, metadata, console errors and Lighthouse audits. Free 1000 credits per month.
entries.desc_zh: 读取任何页面在 JavaScript 运行后的内容：Markdown、截图、元数据、控制台错误和 Lighthouse 审计。每月免费 1000 个额度。

entries.name: vatcheckapi.com
entries.desc_en: Simple and free VAT number validation API. 150 free validations per month.
entries.desc_zh: 简单免费的 VAT 号码验证 API。每月 150 次免费验证。

entries.name: vatnode
entries.desc_en: EU VAT number validation REST API with VIES and national tax-registry fallback, returning the official VIES consultation number for audit records. Free tier of 100 validations/month, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 欧盟 VAT 号码验证 REST API，支持 VIES 及国家税务登记库备用查询，返回官方 VIES 咨询编号以供审计记录。免费层为每月 100 次验证，无需信用卡。

entries.name: WeatherXu
entries.desc_en: Global weather data including current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, and weather alerts via our API. Integrating AI models and ML systems to analyze and combine multiple weather models to deliver improved forecast accuracy. Free tier includes 10,000 API calls/month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过我们的 API 提供全球天气数据，包括当前状况、逐小时和逐日预报以及天气警报。集成 AI 模型和 ML 系统来分析并组合多个天气模型，以提供更高的预报准确性。免费层包含每月 10,000 次 API 调用。

entries.name: Webhooker
entries.desc_en: Webhook gateway hosted in Germany. Signature verification, retries, dead letter queue and replay. Free plan: 10,000 events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 托管在德国的 webhook 网关。支持签名验证、重试、死信队列和重放。免费套餐：每月 10,000 个事件。

entries.name: WebScraping.AI
entries.desc_en: Simple Web Scraping API with built-in parsing, Chrome rendering, and proxies. Two thousand free API calls per month.
entries.desc_zh: 简单的网页抓取 API，内置解析功能、Chrome 渲染和代理。每月提供两千次免费 API 调用。

entries.name: Weights & Biases
entries.desc_en: The developer-first MLOps platform. Build better models faster with experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and model management. Free tier for personal projects only, with 100 GB of storage included.
entries.desc_zh: 开发者优先的 MLOps 平台。通过实验跟踪、数据集版本管理和模型管理更快地构建更好的模型。免费层仅限个人项目，包含 100 GB 存储空间。

entries.name: What Is My IP
entries.desc_en: A free service to check your public IPv4 and IPv6 address and related request data through an API with different output formats for automation, scripts, and network troubleshooting.
entries.desc_zh: 一项免费服务，可通过 API 以不同的输出格式查询你的公网 IPv4 和 IPv6 地址及相关请求数据，适用于自动化、脚本和网络故障排查。

entries.name: What The Diff
entries.desc_en: AI-powered code review assistant. The free plan has a limit of 25,000 monthly tokens (~10 PRs).
entries.desc_zh: AI 驱动的代码审查助手。免费套餐限制为每月 25,000 个 token（约 10 个 PR）。

entries.name: XFlux
entries.desc_en: X/Twitter read REST API (profiles, search, timelines) plus account monitors. Free tier: 1,000 API calls/month, 1 monitor, instant API key. HTTP webhooks on paid plans from $19/mo.
entries.desc_zh: X/Twitter 读取 REST API（个人资料、搜索、时间线）以及账户监控。免费层：每月 1,000 次 API 调用、1 个监控器、即时获取 API 密钥。付费计划提供 HTTP webhooks，起价每月 $19。

entries.name: wolfram.com
entries.desc_en: Built-in knowledge-based algorithms in the cloud.
entries.desc_zh: 云端内置的基于知识的算法。

entries.name: wrapapi.com
entries.desc_en: Turn any website into a parameterized API. 30k API calls per month.
entries.desc_zh: 将任何网站变成参数化 API。每月 30k 次 API 调用。

entries.name: Zipcodebase
entries.desc_en: Free Zip Code API, access to Worldwide Postal Code Data. 5,000 free requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 Zip Code API，可访问全球邮政编码数据。每月 5,000 次免费请求。

entries.name: Zuplo
entries.desc_en: Free API Management platform to design, build, and deploy APIs to the Edge. Add API Key authentication, rate limiting, developer documentation and Monetization to any API in minutes. OpenAPI-native and fully-programmable with web standard apis & Typescript. The free plan offers up to 10 projects, unlimited production edge environments, 1M monthly requests, and 10GB egress.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 API 管理平台，用于设计、构建 API 并将其部署到边缘。可在几分钟内为任何 API 添加 API Key 身份验证、速率限制、开发者文档和变现功能。OpenAPI 原生，并可通过 Web 标准 API 和 Typescript 完全编程。免费套餐提供最多 10 个项目、不限量的生产边缘环境、每月 100 万次请求和 10GB 出站流量。

entries.name: Metashot
entries.desc_en: Open Graph (OG) social preview image generation API. Generate dynamic 1200×630 images for Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook via URL params, edge-cached on Cloudflare Workers. Free tier: 1,000 renders/month. Paid plans from $12/month.
entries.desc_zh: Open Graph (OG) 社交预览图生成 API。通过 URL 参数为 Twitter、LinkedIn 和 Facebook 生成动态 1200×630 图片，在 Cloudflare Workers 上进行边缘缓存。免费层：每月 1,000 次渲染。付费计划每月 12 美元起。

entries.name: Tinyfish
entries.desc_en: Free web search and fetch API with rate limits.
entries.desc_zh: 提供速率限制的免费网页搜索与抓取 API。

entries.name: Gemfury
entries.desc_en: Private and public artifact repos for Maven, PyPi, NPM, Go Module, Nuget, APT, and RPM repositories. Free for public projects.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Maven、PyPi、NPM、Go Module、Nuget、APT 和 RPM 仓库的私有及公共制品仓库。对公共项目免费。

entries.name: jitpack.io
entries.desc_en: Maven repository for JVM and Android projects on GitHub, free for public projects.
entries.desc_zh: GitHub 上面向 JVM 和 Android 项目的 Maven 仓库，对公共项目免费。

entries.name: paperspace
entries.desc_en: Build & scale AI models, Develop, train, and deploy AI applications, free plan: public projects, 5Gb storage, basic instances.
entries.desc_zh: 构建与扩展 AI 模型，开发、训练和部署 AI 应用。免费计划：公共项目、5Gb 存储、基础实例。

entries.name: RepoFlow
entries.desc_en: RepoFlow Simplifies package management with support for npm, PyPI, Docker, Go, Helm, and more. Try it for free with 10GB storage, 10GB bandwidth, 100 packages, and unlimited users in the cloud, or self-hosted for personal use only.
entries.desc_zh: RepoFlow 简化包管理，支持 npm、PyPI、Docker、Go、Helm 等。可免费试用：云端版提供 10GB 存储、10GB 带宽、100 个包和无限用户，或选择仅限个人使用的自托管版本。

entries.name: RepoForge
entries.desc_en: Private cloud-hosted repository for Python, Debian, NPM packages and Docker registries. Free plan for open source/public projects.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Python、Debian、NPM 包和 Docker 镜像仓库的私有云端托管仓库。对开源/公共项目提供免费计划。

entries.name: repsy.io
entries.desc_en: 1 GB Free private/public Maven Repository.
entries.desc_zh: 1 GB 免费私有/公共 Maven 仓库。

entries.name: 3Cols
entries.desc_en: A free cloud-based code snippet manager for personal and collaborative code.
entries.desc_zh: 一款免费的云端代码片段管理器，适用于个人及协作代码。

entries.name: BookmarkOS.com
entries.desc_en: Free all-on-one bookmark manager, tab manager, and task manager in a customizable online desktop with folder collaboration.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的一体化书签管理器、标签页管理器和任务管理器，位于可自定义的在线桌面中，支持文件夹协作。

entries.name: Braid
entries.desc_en: Chat app designed for teams. Free for public access group, unlimited users, history, and integrations. also, it provides a self-hostable open-source version.
entries.desc_zh: 专为团队设计的聊天应用。对公开访问群组免费，用户、历史记录和集成均无限制。此外还提供可自托管的开源版本。

entries.name: Calendly
entries.desc_en: Calendly is the tool for connecting and scheduling meetings. The free plan provides 1 Calendar connection per user and Unlimited sessions. Desktop and Mobile apps are also offered.
entries.desc_zh: Calendly 是用于连接和安排会议的工具。免费计划为每位用户提供 1 个日历连接和无限会议场次。同时提供桌面版和移动端应用。

entries.name: cally.com
entries.desc_en: Find the perfect time and date for a meeting. Simple to use, works great for small and large groups.
entries.desc_zh: 为会议找到最合适的时间和日期。简单易用，无论小型还是大型团体都非常好用。

entries.name: cDox
entries.desc_en: Private document editor hosted in Canada. Write, format, collaborate, and publish documents with clean public links. Data is never used for AI training. Free plan includes 50 MB storage, up to 3 public links, and export to PDF, Word, and Markdown.
entries.desc_zh: 托管在加拿大的私有文档编辑器。撰写、排版、协作并发布文档，生成简洁的公开链接。数据绝不会用于 AI 训练。免费计划包含 50 MB 存储、最多 3 个公开链接，以及导出为 PDF、Word 和 Markdown。

entries.name: Chanty.com
entries.desc_en: Chanty is another alternative to Slack. It has a free forever plan for small teams (up to 10) with unlimited public and private conversations, searchable history, unlimited 1:1 audio calls, unlimited voice messages, ten integrations, and 20 GB storage per team.
entries.desc_zh: Chanty 是 Slack 的另一款替代品。它为小型团队（最多 10 人）提供永久免费计划，包含无限公共和私人对话、可搜索的历史记录、无限 1:1 语音通话、无限语音消息、十项集成，以及每个团队 20 GB 存储。

entries.name: DevToolLab
entries.desc_en: Online developer tools offering free access to all basic tools, with the ability to auto save one entry per tool, standard processing speed, and community support.
entries.desc_zh: 在线开发者工具，免费访问所有基本工具，每个工具可以自动保存一个条目，标准处理速度，以及社区支持。

entries.name: Dexio
entries.desc_en: Shared wiki that all your AI agents read and write, so each one starts with the same context and you can see what they know. Unlimited pages and agents, free for one user.
entries.desc_zh: 供你所有 AI 智能体读写的共享 wiki，让每个智能体都从相同的上下文开始，你可以查看它们知道些什么。页面和智能体数量不限，单用户免费。

entries.name: Discord
entries.desc_en: Chat with public/private rooms. Markdown text, voice, video, and screen sharing capabilities. Free for unlimited users.
entries.desc_zh: 支持公共/私人房间的聊天。具备 Markdown 文本、语音、视频和屏幕共享功能。不限用户数量，免费。

entries.name: Dubble
entries.desc_en: Free Step-by-Step Guide creator. Take screenshots, document processes and collaborate with your team. Also supports async screen recording.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的分步指南创建工具。可截取屏幕截图、记录流程并与你的团队协作。还支持异步屏幕录制。

entries.name: Duckly
entries.desc_en: Talk and collaborate in real time with your team. Pair programming with IDE, terminal sharing, voice, video, and screen sharing. Free for small teams.
entries.desc_zh: 与团队实时交流协作。支持 IDE 结对编程、终端共享、语音、视频和屏幕共享。小型团队免费。

entries.name: element.io
entries.desc_en: A decentralized and open-source communication tool built on Matrix. Group chats, direct messaging, encrypted file transfers, voice and video chats, and easy integration with other services.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 Matrix 构建的去中心化开源通信工具。支持群聊、私信、加密文件传输、语音和视频聊天，并易于与其他服务集成。

entries.name: Enchant
entries.desc_en: Omnichannel customer communication platform. Free tier includes chat widgets, email newsletters, link-in-bio hub & more.
entries.desc_zh: 全渠道客户沟通平台。免费套餐包含聊天小部件、电子邮件通讯、链接在个人资料页中心 & 更多。

entries.name: evernote.com
entries.desc_en: Tool for organizing information. Share your notes and work together with others
entries.desc_zh: 组织信息的工具。分享您的笔记并与他人协作

entries.name: Fibery
entries.desc_en: Connected workspace platform. Free for single users, up to 2 GB disk space.
entries.desc_zh: 互联式工作区平台。单用户免费，最多 2 GB 磁盘空间。

entries.name: Fibo
entries.desc_en: A free online realtime scrum poker tool for agile teams that lets unlimited members estimate story points for faster planning.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向敏捷团队的免费在线实时 scrum poker 工具，允许无限成员估算故事点，加快规划速度。

entries.name: Fizzy
entries.desc_en: Kanban-based platform for project management and issue tracking. Create public boards, set up webhooks, use card stamping, and track unlimited users - free for up to 1000 items.
entries.desc_zh: 基于看板的项目管理和问题跟踪平台。创建公共看板、设置 webhook、使用卡片盖章，并跟踪无限用户——最多 1000 个条目免费。

entries.name: flat.social
entries.desc_en: Interactive customizable spaces for team meetings & happy hours socials. Unlimited meetings, free up to 8 concurrent users.
entries.desc_zh: 用于团队会议与休闲社交的互动式可定制空间。会议次数不限，最多 8 个并发用户免费。

entries.name: flock.com
entries.desc_en: A faster way for your team to communicate. Free Unlimited Messages, Channels, Users, Apps & Integrations
entries.desc_zh: 让你的团队更快地进行沟通。免费享受无限的消息、频道、用户、应用和集成

entries.name: GhostChat
entries.desc_en: Privacy-first live chat widget for websites (~15KB, no cookies, no tracking). Free plan includes 1 site, unlimited messages, a built-in AI chatbot (25 replies/mo), 30-day history, Gmail threading, canned responses and push notifications. No credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 隐私优先的网站在线聊天组件（约 15KB，无 cookie，无跟踪）。免费计划包含 1 个站点、无限消息、内置 AI 聊天机器人（每月 25 条回复）、30 天历史记录、Gmail 邮件线程、预设回复和推送通知。无需信用卡。

entries.name: GitBook
entries.desc_en: Platform for capturing and documenting technical knowledge - from product docs to internal knowledge bases and APIs. Free plan for individual developers.
entries.desc_zh: 用于捕捉和记录技术知识的平台——从产品文档到内部知识库和 API。个人开发者可使用免费计划。

entries.name: GitDailies
entries.desc_en: Daily reports of your team's Commit and Pull Request activity on GitHub. Includes Push visualizer, peer recognition system, and custom alert builder. The free tier has unlimited users, three repos, and 3 alert configs.
entries.desc_zh: 关于团队在 GitHub 上的提交和拉取请求活动的每日报告。包括推送可视化器、同行认可系统和自定义警报构建器。免费层级支持无限用户，三个仓库，和 3 个警报配置。

entries.name: gitter.im
entries.desc_en: Chat, for GitHub. Unlimited public and private rooms, free for teams of up to 25
entries.desc_zh: 为 GitHub 打造的聊天工具。无限公共和私人房间，最多 25 人的团队免费

entries.name: gokanban.io
entries.desc_en: Syntax-based, no registration Kanban Board for fast use. Free with no limitations.
entries.desc_zh: 基于语法、无需注册的看板，可快速上手使用。免费且无任何限制。

entries.name: Hackmd.io
entries.desc_en: Real time collaboration & writing tool for markdown format docs/files. Like Google Docs but for markdown files. Free unlimited number of "notes", but the number of collaborators (invitee) for private notes & template [will be limited](https://hackmd.io/pricing).
entries.desc_zh: 面向 markdown 格式文档/文件的实时协作与写作工具。类似于 Google Docs，但面向 markdown 文件。免费提供数量不限的 "notes"，但私有 notes 和模板的协作者（被邀请者）数量[will be limited](https://hackmd.io/pricing)。

entries.name: HeySpace
entries.desc_en: Task management tool with chat, calendar, timeline and video calls. Free for up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 带聊天、日历、时间线和视频通话的任务管理工具。最多 5 名用户免费。

entries.name: Huly
entries.desc_en: All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion) - unlimited users, 10GB storage per workspace, 10GB video(audio) traffic.
entries.desc_zh: 一体化项目管理平台（Linear、Jira、Slack、Notion、Motion 的替代品）——无限用户，每个工作区 10GB 存储，10GB 视频（音频）流量。

entries.name: Keybase
entries.desc_en: Keybase is a FOSS alternative to Slack; it keeps everyone's chats and files safe, from families to communities to companies.
entries.desc_zh: Keybase 是 Slack 的 FOSS 替代品；无论是家庭、社区还是公司，它都能保护每个人的聊天和文件安全。

entries.name: Knocket
entries.desc_en: Free-forever contact layer for indie developers and small teams: live chat widget for websites and mobile apps (iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native via WebView), a shareable contact page (Linktree-style with socials, booking links, and blog), and a unified Telegram/email inbox. Reply from Telegram directly (no dashboard needed). Meeting scheduler, multi-language, light/dark themes. Companion open-source AI auto-reply agent. No ads, no seat limits.
entries.desc_zh: 面向独立开发者和小型团队的永久免费联系层：适用于网站和移动应用的在线聊天组件（通过 WebView 支持 iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native）、可分享的联系页面（Linktree 风格，包含社交媒体、预约链接和博客），以及统一的 Telegram/邮件收件箱。可直接通过 Telegram 回复（无需仪表板）。支持会议排程、多语言、浅色/深色主题。附带开源 AI 自动回复智能体。无广告，无席位限制。

entries.name: Linkinize
entries.desc_en: Bookmark manager for teams with tagging, multi-workspaces, and collaboration. Free plan includes 4 workspaces and 10 team members.
entries.desc_zh: 面向团队的书签管理器，支持标签、多工作区和协作。免费计划包含 4 个工作区和 10 名团队成员。

entries.name: Lockitbot
entries.desc_en: Reserve and lock shared resources within Slack like Rooms, Dev environments , servers etc. Free for upto 2 resources
entries.desc_zh: 在 Slack 内预订并锁定共享资源，例如房间、开发环境、服务器等。最多 2 个资源免费

entries.name: meet.jit.si
entries.desc_en: One-click video conversations, and screen sharing, for free
entries.desc_zh: 一键式视频对话和屏幕共享，免费

entries.name: MergeMe
entries.desc_en: MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.
entries.desc_zh: MergeMe 将 GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs 直接带入 Slack，显示为一张持续更新的卡片。它添加了 CI 状态、镜像评论、@提及、提醒等功能。免费适用于最多 5 名开发者和 1 个频道映射。

entries.name: Miro
entries.desc_en: Scalable, secure, cross-device, and enterprise-ready collaboration whiteboard for distributed teams. With a freemium plan.
entries.desc_zh: 可扩展、安全、跨设备且企业就绪的协作白板，适用于分布式团队。提供免费增值计划。

entries.name: Notion
entries.desc_en: Notion is a note-taking and collaboration application with markdown support that integrates tasks, wikis, and databases. The company describes the app as an all-in-one workspace for note-taking, project management and task management. In addition to cross-platform apps, it can be accessed via most web browsers.
entries.desc_zh: Notion 是一款支持 markdown 的笔记与协作应用，集任务、wiki 和数据库于一体。该公司将这款应用描述为用于笔记、项目管理和任务管理的一体化工作区。除了跨平台应用外，它还可以通过大多数网页浏览器访问。

entries.name: Nuclino
entries.desc_en: A lightweight and collaborative wiki for all your team's knowledge, docs, and notes. Free plan with all essential features, up to 50 items, and 5GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 一款轻量级的协作 wiki，可容纳团队的所有知识、文档和笔记。免费计划包含所有核心功能、最多 50 个条目和 5GB 存储空间。

entries.name: OnlineInterview.io
entries.desc_en: Free code interview platform with embedded video chat, drawing board, and online code editor where you can compile and run your code on the browser. You can create a remote interview room with just one click.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的代码面试平台，内置视频聊天、画板和在线代码编辑器，可在浏览器中编译并运行你的代码。只需一键即可创建远程面试房间。

entries.name: paste.sh
entries.desc_en: This is a JavaScript and the Crypto based simple paste site.
entries.desc_zh: 这是一个基于 JavaScript 和 Crypto 的简单粘贴网站。

entries.name: Pastefy
entries.desc_en: Beautiful and simple Pastebin with optional Client-Encryption, Multitab-Pastes, an API, a highlighted Editor and more.
entries.desc_zh: 美观简洁的 Pastebin，支持可选的 Client-Encryption（客户端加密）、Multitab-Pastes（多标签粘贴）、API、语法高亮编辑器等更多功能。

entries.name: Pendulums
entries.desc_en: Pendulums is a free time tracking tool that helps you manage your time in a better manner with an easy-to-use interface and valuable statistics.
entries.desc_zh: Pendulums 是一款免费的时间跟踪工具，凭借易用的界面和有价值的统计数据，帮助你更好地管理时间。

entries.name: Pin Feed
entries.desc_en: Pin Feed is a website feedback tool to comment on live client website. Free for up to 3 projects with 500 MB storage. Clients can leave feedback without an account.
entries.desc_zh: Pin Feed 是一款网站反馈工具，可直接在客户在线运行的网站上评论。最多 3 个项目免费，并提供 500 MB 存储空间。客户无需账号即可留下反馈。

entries.name: Proton Pass
entries.desc_en: Password manager with built-in email aliases, 2FA authenticator, sharing and passkeys. Available on web, browser extension, and mobile app and desktop.
entries.desc_zh: 密码管理器，内置邮箱别名、2FA 身份验证器、共享和通行密钥（passkey）功能。可通过网页、浏览器扩展、移动应用和桌面端使用。

entries.name: Pullflow
entries.desc_en: Pullflow offers an AI-enhanced platform for code review collaboration across GitHub, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.desc_zh: Pullflow 提供一个 AI 增强平台，用于跨 GitHub、Slack 和 VS Code 的代码审查协作。

entries.name: Pumble
entries.desc_en: Free team chat app. Unlimited users and message history, free forever.
entries.desc_zh: 免费团队聊天应用。用户数量和消息历史不限量，永久免费。

entries.name: Quidlo Timesheets
entries.desc_en: A simple timesheet and time tracking app for teams. The free plan has time tracking and generating reports features for up to 10 users.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向团队的简易工时表和时间跟踪应用。免费计划提供时间跟踪和报告生成功能，最多支持 10 名用户。

entries.name: Raindrop.io
entries.desc_en: Private and secure bookmarking app for macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, and Web. Free Unlimited Bookmarks and Collaboration.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于 macOS、Windows、Android、iOS 和 Web 的私密安全书签应用。免费提供无限书签和协作功能。

entries.name: Reezn.io
entries.desc_en: Spec-driven development workflow for teams: shifts review left so problems get caught before code is written, instead of piling up in code review. Builds a knowledge graph of your business as you go, which the AI agents use for later features. Free plan: 3 seats, 1 project, 5 features/month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向团队的规格驱动（spec-driven）开发工作流：将审查左移，在编写代码之前就捕获问题，而不是让问题堆积在代码审查环节。在开发过程中逐步构建你业务的知识图谱，供 AI 智能体在后续功能开发中使用。免费计划：3 个席位、1 个项目、每月 5 个功能。

entries.name: Revolt.chat
entries.desc_en: An OpenSource alternative for[Discord](https://discord.com/), that respects your privacy. It also have most proprietary features from discord for free. Revolt is a all in one application that is secure and fast, while being 100% free. every features are free. They also have (official & unofficial) plugins support unlike most main-stream chatting applications.
entries.desc_zh: 一个尊重你隐私的 [Discord](https://discord.com/) OpenSource 替代品。它还免费提供 Discord 的大多数专有功能。Revolt 是一款安全且快速的一体化应用，同时 100% 免费，每项功能都免费。与大多数主流聊天应用不同，它们还提供（官方与非官方）插件支持。

entries.name: Rocket.Chat
entries.desc_en: Open-source communication platform with Omnichannel features, Matrix Federation, Bridge with others apps, Unlimited messaging, and Full messaging history.
entries.desc_zh: 开源通信平台，具备全渠道（Omnichannel）功能、Matrix Federation、与其他应用的桥接（Bridge）、不限量消息和完整消息历史。

entries.name: ruttl.com
entries.desc_en: The best all-in-one feedback tool to collect digital feedback and review websites, PDFs, and images.
entries.desc_zh: 收集数字化反馈并审查网站、PDF 和图片的最佳一体化反馈工具。

entries.name: Screen Sharing via Browser
entries.desc_en: Free screen sharing tool, share your screen with collabrators right from your browser, no download or registration needed. For free.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的屏幕共享工具，直接从浏览器与协作者共享您的屏幕，无需下载或注册。完全免费。

entries.name: seafile.com
entries.desc_en: Private or cloud storage, file sharing, sync, discussions. The cloud version has just 1 GB
entries.desc_zh: 私有或云端存储、文件共享、同步、讨论。云端版本仅有 1 GB

entries.name: Sharry
entries.desc_en: Screen sharing via the browser, no downloads, no installs. Useful for pair programming, presentations or remote support. Free tier: no account, 5-minute sessions, 1 viewer.
entries.desc_zh: 通过浏览器进行屏幕共享，无需下载、无需安装。适用于结对编程、演示或远程支持。免费层：无需账号、5 分钟会话、1 位观看者。

entries.name: SiteDots
entries.desc_en: Share feedback for website projects directly on your website, no emulation, canvas or workarounds. Completely functional free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 直接在网站上分享网站项目的反馈，无需仿真、canvas 或其他变通方法。免费层功能完全可用。

entries.name: Slab
entries.desc_en: A modern knowledge management service for teams. Free for up to 10 users.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向团队的现代知识管理服务。最多 10 名用户免费。

entries.name: slack.com
entries.desc_en: Free for unlimited users with some feature limitations
entries.desc_zh: 不限用户数量免费，但存在部分功能限制

entries.name: StatusPile
entries.desc_en: A status page of status pages. Could you track the status pages of your upstream providers?
entries.desc_zh: 状态页的状态页。你能追踪上游服务提供商的状态页吗？

entries.name: Stickies
entries.desc_en: Visual collaboration app used for brainstorming, content curation, and notes. Free for up to 3 Walls, unlimited users, and 1 GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 用于头脑风暴、内容整理和笔记的可视化协作应用。最多 3 个 Walls、不限用户数、1 GB 存储空间免费。

entries.name: MeetBackdrops
entries.desc_en: Free HD virtual backgrounds for video calls on Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. 1,000+ studio-designed environments with no signup required.
entries.desc_zh: 用于 Zoom、Microsoft Teams 和 Google Meet 视频通话的免费高清虚拟背景。1,000+ 个工作室设计的场景，无需注册。

entries.name: talky.io
entries.desc_en: Free group video chat. Anonymous. Peer‑to‑peer. No plugins, signup, or payment required
entries.desc_zh: 免费群组视频聊天。匿名的。点对点的。无需插件、注册或付费。

entries.name: Teamcamp
entries.desc_en: All-in-one project management application for software development companies.
entries.desc_zh: 面向软件开发公司的全方位项目管理应用程序。

entries.name: Teamhood
entries.desc_en: Free Project, Task, and Issue-tracking software. Supports Kanban with Swimlanes and full Scrum implementation. Has integrated time tracking. Free for five users and three project portfolios.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的项目、任务和问题跟踪软件。支持带泳道的看板和完整的 Scrum 实施。具有集成的时间跟踪功能。免费支持五个用户和三个项目组合。

entries.name: Teamplify
entries.desc_en: improve team development processes with Team Analytics and Smart Daily Standup. Includes full-featured Time Off management for remote-first teams. Free for small groups of up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 借助 Team Analytics 和 Smart Daily Standup 改进团队开发流程。为远程优先团队提供功能齐全的 Time Off（请假）管理。最多 5 名用户的小团队免费。

entries.name: TeamSort
entries.desc_en: Free tool to vote on a shared list and rank items together. Create a ranked-choice poll in seconds - no signup.
entries.desc_zh: 免费工具，可对共享列表投票并共同对条目进行排序。几秒钟即可创建排名选择投票（ranked-choice poll）- 无需注册。

entries.name: Telegram
entries.desc_en: Telegram is for everyone who wants fast, reliable messaging and calls. Business users and small teams may like the large groups, usernames, desktop apps, and powerful file-sharing options.
entries.desc_zh: Telegram 适合所有想要快速、可靠消息与通话的人。商业用户和小团队可能会喜欢其大型群组、用户名、桌面应用和强大的文件共享选项。

entries.name: Tencent RTC
entries.desc_en: Tencent Real-Time Communication (TRTC) offers solutions for group audio/video calls.10,000 free minutes/month for the first year.
entries.desc_zh: Tencent Real-Time Communication (TRTC) 提供群组音视频通话解决方案。第一年每月免费 10,000 分钟。

entries.name: TimeCamp
entries.desc_en: Free time tracking software for unlimited users. Easily integrates with PM tools like Jira, Trello, Asana, etc.
entries.desc_zh: 面向不限量用户的免费时间跟踪软件。可与 Jira、Trello、Asana 等 PM 工具轻松集成。

entries.name: tldraw.com
entries.desc_en: Free open-source white-boarding and diagramming tool with intelligent arrows, snapping, sticky notes, and SVG export features. Multiplayer mode for collaborative editing. Free official VS Code extension available as well.
entries.desc_zh: 免费开源的白板与图表绘制工具，具备智能箭头、吸附、便签和 SVG 导出功能。支持多人协作编辑模式。还提供免费的官方 VS Code 扩展。

entries.name: transfernow
entries.desc_en: simplest, fastest and safest interface to transfer and share files. Send photos, videos and other large files without a mandatory subscription.
entries.desc_zh: 最简单、最快、最安全的文件传输与共享界面。无需强制订阅即可发送照片、视频和其他大文件。

entries.name: Tugboat
entries.desc_en: Preview every pull request, automated and on-demand. Free for all, complimentary Nano tier for non-profits.
entries.desc_zh: 预览每个 pull request，支持自动化和按需预览。对所有人免费，非营利组织可免费获赠 Nano 套餐。

entries.name: twist.com
entries.desc_en: An asynchronous-friendly team communication app where conversations stay organized and on-topic. Free and Unlimited plans are available. Discounts are provided for eligible teams.
entries.desc_zh: 一款对异步协作友好的团队沟通应用，对话保持有条理且切合主题。提供 Free 和 Unlimited 两种计划。符合条件的团队可享受折扣。

entries.name: userforge.com
entries.desc_en: Interconnected online personas, user stories and context mapping.  Helps keep design and dev in sync free for up to 3 personas and two collaborators.
entries.desc_zh: 相互关联的在线角色、用户故事和上下文映射。帮助保持设计和开发同步，免费支持最多 3 个角色和两个协作者。

entries.name: Visual Debug
entries.desc_en: A Visual feedback tool for better client-dev communication
entries.desc_zh: 一款可视化反馈工具，助力客户与开发人员之间更好的沟通

entries.name: Webex
entries.desc_en: Video meetings with a free plan offering 40 minutes per meeting with 100 attendees.
entries.desc_zh: 视频会议服务，免费计划每次会议时长 40 分钟，最多支持 100 名参会者。

entries.name: Webvizio
entries.desc_en: Website feedback tool, website review software, and bug reporting tool for streamlining web development collaboration on tasks directly on live websites and web apps, images, PDFs, and design files.
entries.desc_zh: 网站反馈工具、网站评审软件和错误报告工具，可直接在线上网站、Web 应用、图片、PDF 和设计文件上简化 Web 开发协作任务。

entries.name: whereby.com
entries.desc_en: One-click video conversations, for free (formerly known as appear.in)
entries.desc_zh: 一键开启视频通话，免费（前身为 appear.in）

entries.name: windmill.dev
entries.desc_en: Windmill is an open-source developer platform to quickly build production-grade multi-step automation and internal apps from minimal Python and Typescript scripts. As a free user, you can create and be a member of at most three non-premium workspaces.
entries.desc_zh: Windmill 是一个开源开发者平台，可通过极简的 Python 和 Typescript 脚本快速构建生产级多步骤自动化流程和内部应用。作为免费用户，你最多可以创建并加入三个非高级工作区。

entries.name: wistia.com
entries.desc_en: Video hosting with viewer analytics, HD video delivery, and marketing tools to help understand your visitors, 25 videos, and Wistia branded player
entries.desc_zh: 视频托管服务，提供观众分析、高清视频分发和营销工具，帮助你了解访客；免费版包含 25 个视频，并带有 Wistia 品牌播放器。

entries.name: wormhol.org
entries.desc_en: Straightforward file sharing service. Share unlimited files up to 5GB with as many peers as you want.
entries.desc_zh: 简单直接的文件共享服务。可与任意数量的对象共享无限数量的文件，单个文件最大 5GB。

entries.name: Wormhole
entries.desc_en: Share files up to 5GB with end-to-end encryption for up to 24hours. For files larger than 5 GB, it uses peer-to-peer transfer to send your files directly.
entries.desc_zh: 以端到端加密方式共享最大 5GB 的文件，有效期最长 24 小时。对于大于 5 GB 的文件，它会使用点对点传输直接发送。

entries.name: zoom.us
entries.desc_en: Secure Video and Web conferencing add-ons available. The free plan is limited to 40 minutes.
entries.desc_zh: 提供安全的视频和 Web 会议附加组件。免费计划限 40 分钟。

entries.name: Zulip
entries.desc_en: Real-time chat with a unique email-like threading model. The free plan includes 10,000 messages of search history and File storage up to 5 GB. also, it provides a self-hostable open-source version.
entries.desc_zh: 采用类似电子邮件的独特线程模型的实时聊天工具。免费计划包含 10,000 条消息的搜索历史和最高 5 GB 的文件存储。此外，它还提供可自托管的开源版本。

entries.name: RightFeature
entries.desc_en: Easily collect feedback from your customers, turn customer feedback into your product roadmap. Collect, prioritize, and ship features that actually matter to your users.
entries.desc_zh: 轻松收集客户反馈，将客户反馈转化为你的产品路线图。收集、排定优先级并交付真正对用户重要的功能。

entries.name: Zeitio
entries.desc_en: Time tracking and invoicing for freelancers and small teams. Free plan includes 1 user, 3 active projects and 3 invoices per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向自由职业者和小团队的时间跟踪与开票工具。免费计划包含 1 名用户、3 个活跃项目和每月 3 张发票。

entries.name: Contentful
entries.desc_en: Headless CMS. Content management and delivery APIs in the cloud. Comes with one free Community space that includes five users, 25K records, 48 Content Types, 2 locales.
entries.desc_zh: 无头 CMS。云中的内容管理和交付 API。包含一个免费的社区空间，包括五个用户、25K 条记录、48 种内容类型、2 个区域设置。

entries.name: Cosmic
entries.desc_en: Headless CMS and API toolkit. Free personal plans for developers.
entries.desc_zh: Headless CMS 和 API 工具包。为开发者提供免费的个人计划。

entries.name: Crystallize
entries.desc_en: Headless PIM with ecommerce support. Built-in GraphQL API. The free version includes unlimited users, 1000 catalog items, 5 GB/month bandwidth, and 25k/month API calls.
entries.desc_zh: 支持电商的 Headless PIM。内置 GraphQL API。免费版包含无限用户、1000 个目录条目、每月 5 GB 带宽和每月 25k 次 API 调用。

entries.name: DatoCMS
entries.desc_en: Offers free tier for small projects. DatoCMS is a GraphQL-based CMS. On the lower tier, you have 100k/month calls.
entries.desc_zh: 为小型项目提供免费层。DatoCMS 是一个基于 GraphQL 的 CMS。在较低层级，你每月可进行 100k 次调用。

entries.name: Hygraph
entries.desc_en: Offers free tier for small projects. GraphQL first API. Move away from legacy solutions to the GraphQL native Headless CMS - and deliver omnichannel content API first.
entries.desc_zh: 为小型项目提供免费层。GraphQL 优先的 API。告别传统解决方案，采用 GraphQL 原生的 Headless CMS——以 API 优先的方式交付全渠道内容。

entries.name: Prismic
entries.desc_en: Headless CMS. Content management interface with fully hosted and scalable API. The Community Plan provides unlimited API calls, documents, custom types, assets, and locales to one user. Everything that you need for your next project. Bigger free plans are available for Open Content/Open Source projects.
entries.desc_zh: Headless CMS。内容管理界面，配备完全托管且可扩展的 API。Community 计划为一名用户提供无限的 API 调用、文档、自定义类型、资产和区域设置。满足你的下一个项目所需的一切。Open Content/Open Source 项目可获得更大的免费计划。

entries.name: Sanity.io
entries.desc_en: Platform for structured content with an open-source editing environment and a real-time hosted data store. Unlimited projects. Unlimited admin users, three non-admin users, two datasets, 500K API CDN requests, 10GB bandwidth, and 5GB assets included for free per project.
entries.desc_zh: 结构化内容平台，配备开源编辑环境和实时托管数据存储。无限项目。无限管理员用户，三个非管理员用户，两个数据集，50 万 API CDN 请求，10GB 带宽，以及每个项目免费包含 5GB 资产。

entries.name: Solo
entries.desc_en: Free AI website creator from Mozilla, create a beautiful website for your business from a few simple inputs. Free custom domain, no credit card needed.
entries.desc_zh: 来自 Mozilla 的免费 AI 网站创建工具，只需几个简单的输入即可为你的业务创建漂亮的网站。免费自定义域名，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Squidex
entries.desc_en: Offers free tier for small projects. API / GraphQL first. Open source and based on event sourcing (versing every change automatically).
entries.desc_zh: 为小型项目提供免费层。API / GraphQL 优先。开源，基于事件溯源（自动为每次变更创建版本）。

entries.name: Storyblok
entries.desc_en: A Headless CMS for developers and marketers that works with all modern frameworks. The Community (free) tier offers Management API, Visual Editor, ten sources, Custom Field Types, Internationalization (unlimited languages/locales), Asset Manager (up to 2500 assets), Image Optimizing Service, Search Query, Webhook + 250GB Traffic/month included.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发人员和营销人员的无头 CMS，可与所有现代框架配合使用。社区（免费）层级提供管理 API、可视化编辑器、十个数据源、自定义字段类型、国际化（无限语言/区域设置）、资产管理器（最多 2500 个资产）、图像优化服务、搜索查询、Webhook + 每月包含 250GB 流量。

entries.name: TinaCMS
entries.desc_en: Replacing Forestry.io. Open source Git-backed headless CMS that supports Markdown, MDX, and JSON. The basic offer is free with two users available.
entries.desc_zh: Forestry.io 的替代品。开源的基于 Git 的 headless CMS，支持 Markdown、MDX 和 JSON。基础方案免费，支持两名用户。

entries.name: WPJack
entries.desc_en: Set up WordPress on any cloud in less than 5 minutes! The free tier includes 1 server, 2 sites, free SSL certificates, and unlimited cron jobs. No time limits or expirations-your website, your way.
entries.desc_zh: 在任何云上 5 分钟内部署好 WordPress！免费层包含 1 台服务器、2 个站点、免费 SSL 证书和无限 cron 任务。没有时间限制或到期——你的网站，由你做主。

entries.name: Appinvento
entries.desc_en: A free no-code app builder. It provides complete access to the automatically generated backend source code and allows for unlimited APIs and routes. The free plan includes three projects and five tables.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的无需编码的应用构建器。它提供对自动生成的后端源代码的完全访问权限，并允许无限 API 和路由。免费计划包括三个项目和五个表格。

entries.name: DhiWise
entries.desc_en: Converts Figma designs into dynamic Flutter and React applications. Its code generation technology is designed to optimize workflows for building production-ready mobile and web experiences.
entries.desc_zh: 将 Figma 设计转换为动态的 Flutter 和 React 应用。其代码生成技术旨在优化构建可用于生产环境的移动端和 Web 体验的工作流程。

entries.name: Metalama
entries.desc_en: A C#-specific tool that generates boilerplate code on the fly during compilation to keep source code clean. It is free for open-source projects; its commercial-friendly free tier includes up to three aspects.
entries.desc_zh: 一个 C# 特定工具，在编译过程中即时生成样板代码以保持源代码清洁。它对开源项目免费；其商业友好的免费层级包括最多三个方面。

entries.name: Supermaven
entries.desc_en: A high-speed AI code completion plugin for VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim. The free tier provides unlimited inline completions with a focus on ultra-low latency.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向 VS Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim 的高速 AI 代码补全插件。免费层提供无限的行内补全，主打超低延迟。

entries.name: v0.dev
entries.desc_en: Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. It uses a credit system, providing 1,200 starting credits and 200 free credits monthly.
entries.desc_zh: 由 Vercel 打造的 v0 使用 shadcn/ui 和 Tailwind CSS 生成便于复制粘贴的 React 代码。它采用积分系统，提供 1,200 个初始积分和每月 200 个免费积分。

entries.name: beanstalkapp.com
entries.desc_en: A complete workflow to write, review, and deploy code), a free account for one user, and one repository with 100 MB of storage
entries.desc_zh: 完整的代码编写、审查和部署工作流），为单个用户提供免费账户，以及一个拥有 100 MB 存储空间的代码仓库。

entries.name: codacy.com
entries.desc_en: Automated code reviews for PHP, Python, Ruby, Java, JavaScript, Scala, CSS, and CoffeeScript, free for unlimited public and private repositories
entries.desc_zh: 针对 PHP、Python、Ruby、Java、JavaScript、Scala、CSS 和 CoffeeScript 的自动代码审查，对无限数量的公开和私有仓库免费。

entries.name: Codeac.io
