entries.desc_en: Automated Infrastructure as Code review tool for DevOps integrates with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab (even self-hosted). In addition to standard languages, it also analyzes Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and more. (open-source free)
entries.desc_zh: 面向 DevOps 的自动化基础设施即代码审查工具，可与 GitHub、Bitbucket 和 GitLab（甚至自托管版本）集成。除标准语言外，它还能分析 Ansible、Terraform、CloudFormation、Kubernetes 等。（开源免费）

entries.name: codecov.io
entries.desc_en: Code coverage tool (SaaS), free for Open Source and one free private repo
entries.desc_zh: 代码覆盖率工具（SaaS），对开源免费，并提供一个免费私有仓库。

entries.name: CodeFactor
entries.desc_en: Automated Code Review for Git. The free version includes unlimited users, public repositories, and one private repo.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Git 的自动代码审查。免费版包含无限用户、公开仓库和一个私有仓库。

entries.name: coderabbit.ai
entries.desc_en: AI-powered code review tool that integrates with GitHub/GitLab. Free tier includes 200 files/hour, 3 reviews per hour, and 50 conversations/hour. Free forever for open source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 与 GitHub/GitLab 集成的 AI 驱动代码审查工具。免费层包含每小时 200 个文件、每小时 3 次审查和每小时 50 次对话。对开源项目永久免费。

entries.name: CodSpeed
entries.desc_en: Automate performance tracking in your CI pipelines. Catch performance regressions before deployment, thanks to precise and consistent metrics. Free forever for Open Source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 在 CI 管道中自动执行性能追踪。凭借精准且一致的指标，在部署前发现性能回退。对 Open Source 项目永久免费。

entries.name: coveralls.io
entries.desc_en: Display test coverage reports, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 展示测试覆盖率报告，对开源免费。

entries.name: deepscan.io
entries.desc_en: Advanced static analysis for automatically finding runtime errors in JavaScript code, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 高级静态分析，自动发现 JavaScript 代码中的运行时错误，对开源免费。

entries.name: DeepSource
entries.desc_en: DeepSource continuously analyzes source code changes, finding and fixing issues categorized under security, performance, anti-patterns, bug-risks, documentation, and style. Native integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
entries.desc_zh: DeepSource 持续分析源代码变更，发现并修复安全、性能、反模式、Bug 风险、文档和风格等类别的问题。与 GitHub、GitLab 和 Bitbucket 原生集成。

entries.name: DiffText
entries.desc_en: Instantly find the differences between two blocks of code. Completely free to use.
entries.desc_zh: 即时找出两段代码之间的差异。完全免费使用。

entries.name: eversql.com
entries.desc_en: EverSQL - The #1 platform for database optimization. Gain critical insights into your database and SQL queries automatically.
entries.desc_zh: EverSQL - 数据库优化领域的 #1 平台。自动获取关于您的数据库和 SQL 查询的关键洞察。

entries.name: gerrithub.io
entries.desc_en: Gerrit code review for GitHub repositories for free
entries.desc_zh: 为 GitHub 仓库提供免费的 Gerrit 代码审查

entries.name: goreportcard.com
entries.desc_en: Code Quality for Go projects, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Go 项目的代码质量工具，开源免费

entries.name: gtmetrix.com
entries.desc_en: Reports and thorough recommendations to optimize websites
entries.desc_zh: 提供报告和详尽建议，帮助优化网站

entries.name: HeyDeer
entries.desc_en: AI code review for GitHub pull requests. Free plan includes 1,000 credits in the first month and 300 credits monthly after that, including private repositories. Public repository reviews are free within fair-use limits. No credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 针对 GitHub pull request 的 AI 代码审查。免费计划首月包含 1,000 积分，之后每月 300 积分，包括私有仓库。公有仓库审查在合理使用范围内免费。无需信用卡。

entries.name: holistic.dev
entries.desc_en: The #1 static code analyzer for Postgresql optimization. Performance, security, and architect database issues automatic detection service
entries.desc_zh: PostgreSQL 优化的 #1 静态代码分析器。性能、安全和架构问题的自动检测服务。

entries.name: houndci.com
entries.desc_en: Comments on GitHub commits about code quality, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 在 GitHub commit 上评论代码质量，开源免费

entries.name: prquorum.com
entries.desc_en: ai code review github app, free 50 reviews/month on 2 repos
entries.desc_zh: GitHub AI 代码审查应用，2 个仓库每月免费 50 次审查

entries.name: reviewable.io
entries.desc_en: Code review for GitHub repositories, free for public or personal repos.
entries.desc_zh: 为 GitHub 仓库提供代码审查，公有或个人仓库免费。

entries.name: scan.coverity.com
entries.desc_en: Static code analysis for Java, C/C++, C# and JavaScript, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 针对 Java、C/C++、C# 和 JavaScript 的静态代码分析，开源免费

entries.name: scrutinizer-ci.com
entries.desc_en: Continuous inspection platform, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 持续检查平台，对 Open Source 免费

entries.name: semanticdiff.com
entries.desc_en: Programming language aware diff for GitHub pull requests and commits, free for public repositories
entries.desc_zh: 感知编程语言的 diff 工具，适用于 GitHub pull request 和 commit，公有仓库免费

entries.name: shields.io
entries.desc_en: Quality metadata badges for open source projects
entries.desc_zh: 面向开源项目的质量元数据徽章

entries.name: sonarcloud.io
entries.desc_en: Automated source code analysis for Java, JavaScript, C/C++, C#, VB.NET, PHP, Objective-C, Swift, Python, Groovy and even more languages, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 自动源代码分析，支持 Java、JavaScript、C/C++、C#、VB.NET、PHP、Objective-C、Swift、Python、Groovy 及更多语言，开源免费

entries.name: tomosu.ai
entries.desc_en: Scores a repository or pull request with a 0-100 Production Reliability Index, plus fix suggestions and a merge verdict. Free for one repository (public or private) through the VS Code/Cursor plugin, web scan, and GitHub App PR comments.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 0-100 生产可靠性指数对仓库或拉取请求进行评分，并提供修复建议和合并判决。通过 VS Code/Cursor 插件、网络扫描和 GitHub App PR 评论，对一个仓库（公共或私有）免费

entries.name: CodeKeep
entries.desc_en: Google Keep for Code Snippets. Organize, Discover, and share code snippets, featuring a powerful code screenshot tool with preset templates and a linking feature.
entries.desc_zh: 代码片段版 Google Keep。组织、发现和分享代码片段，配备强大的代码截图工具，具有预设模板和链接功能。

entries.name: libraries.io
entries.desc_en: Search and dependency update notifications for 32 different package managers, free for open source
entries.desc_zh: 为 32 种不同的包管理器提供搜索和依赖更新通知，对开源免费

entries.name: Namae
entries.desc_en: Search various websites like GitHub, Gitlab, Heroku, Netlify, and many more for the availability of your project name.
entries.desc_zh: 在 GitHub、Gitlab、Heroku、Netlify 等众多网站上搜索你的项目名称是否可用。

entries.name: tickgit.com
entries.desc_en: Surfaces `TODO` comments (and other markers) to identify areas of code worth returning to for improvement.
entries.desc_zh: 呈现 `TODO` 注释（及其他标记），帮助识别值得回头改进的代码区域。

entries.name: appcircle.io
entries.desc_en: An enterprise-grade mobile DevOps platform that automates the build, test, and publish store of mobile apps for faster, efficient release cycle. Free for 30 minutes max build time per build, 20 monthly builds and 1 concurrent build.
entries.desc_zh: 企业级移动 DevOps 平台，自动化移动应用的构建、测试和商店发布，实现更快速高效的发布周期。免费提供每次构建最长 30 分钟构建时间、每月 20 次构建和 1 个并发构建。

entries.name: appveyor.com
entries.desc_en: CD service for Windows, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Windows 的 CD 服务，开源免费

entries.name: bitrise.io
entries.desc_en: A CI/CD for mobile apps, native or hybrid. With 200 free builds/month 10 min build time and two team members. OSS projects get 45 min build time, +1 concurrency and unlimited team size.
entries.desc_zh: 移动应用的 CI/CD，原生或混合。每月 200 次免费构建，10 分钟构建时间和两个团队成员。开源项目获得 45 分钟构建时间，+1 并发和无限制团队规模

entries.name: buddy.works
entries.desc_en: A CI/CD with five free projects and one concurrent run (120 executions/month)
entries.desc_zh: CI/CD 服务，包含五个免费项目和一次并发运行（每月 120 次执行）

entries.name: Buildkite
entries.desc_en: CI Pipelines free for 3 users and 5k job minutes/month. Test Analytics free
entries.desc_zh: CI 流水线对 3 名用户免费，每月 5,000 作业分钟。测试分析免费

entries.name: bytebase.com
entries.desc_en: Database CI/CD and DevOps. Free under 20 users and ten database instances
entries.desc_zh: 数据库 CI/CD 和 DevOps。20 个用户和十个数据库实例以下免费

entries.name: CircleCI
entries.desc_en: Comprehensive free plan with all features included in a hosted CI/CD service for GitHub, GitLab, and BitBucket repositories. Multiple resource classes, Docker, Windows, Mac OS, ARM executors, local runners, test splitting, Docker Layer Caching, and other advanced CI/CD features. Free for up to 6000 minutes/month execution time, unlimited collaborators, 30 parallel jobs in private projects, and up to 80,000 free build minutes for Open Source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 为 GitHub、GitLab 和 BitBucket 仓库提供托管 CI/CD 服务的全面免费计划，包含所有功能。支持多种资源类别、Docker、Windows、Mac OS、ARM 执行器、本地 runner、测试拆分、Docker Layer Caching 及其他高级 CI/CD 功能。免费提供每月最多 6000 分钟执行时间、不限协作者数量、私有项目 30 个并行作业，以及开源项目最多 80,000 分钟免费构建时间。

entries.name: cirun.io
entries.desc_en: Free for public GitHub repositories
entries.desc_zh: 对公有 GitHub 仓库免费

entries.name: codemagic.io
entries.desc_en: Free 500 build minutes/month
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费 500 分钟构建时间

entries.name: deployhq.com
entries.desc_en: 1 project with ten daily deployments (30 build minutes/month)
entries.desc_zh: 1 个项目，包含十次每日部署（每月 30 分钟构建时间）

entries.name: LocalOps
entries.desc_en: Deploy your app on AWS/GCP/Azure in under 30 minutes. Setup standardised app environments on any cloud, which come with in-built continuous deployment automation and advanced observability. The free plan allows 1 user and 1 app environment.
entries.desc_zh: 在 30 分钟内将你的应用部署到 AWS/GCP/Azure。在任何云上搭建标准化的应用环境，内置持续部署自动化和高级可观测性。免费计划允许 1 名用户和 1 个应用环境。

entries.name: Make
entries.desc_en: The workflow automation tool lets you connect apps and automate workflows using UI. It supports many apps and the most popular APIs. Free for public GitHub repositories, and free tier with 100 Mb, 1000 Operations, and 15 minutes of minimum interval.
entries.desc_zh: 这款工作流自动化工具让你通过 UI 连接应用并自动化工作流。它支持众多应用和最流行的 API。对公有 GitHub 仓库免费，免费层包含 100 Mb、1000 次操作和 15 分钟最小间隔。

entries.name: Mergify
entries.desc_en: workflow automation and merge queue for GitHub - Free for public GitHub repositories
entries.desc_zh: 面向 GitHub 的工作流自动化和合并队列 - 对公有 GitHub 仓库免费

entries.name: Nx Cloud
entries.desc_en: Nx Cloud speeds up your monorepos on CI with features such as remote caching, distribution of tasks across machines and even automated splitting of your e2e test runs. It comes with a free plan for up to 30 contributors with generous 150k credits included.
entries.desc_zh: Nx Cloud 通过远程缓存、跨机器分发任务，甚至自动拆分 e2e 测试运行等功能，加速 CI 上的 monorepo。它提供最多 30 名贡献者的免费计划，并包含慷慨的 150k 积分。

entries.name: RunMyJob
entries.desc_en: Run GitHub Actions and GitLab CI pipelines smarter with real-time scaling Spike Instances. Free tier includes 400 vCPU-minutes, 800 GB-minutes, and 10 concurrent jobs with high-performance runners (12 vCPU and 32 GB RAM per job).
entries.desc_zh: 借助实时扩缩容的 Spike Instances 更智能地运行 GitHub Actions 和 GitLab CI 流水线。免费层包含 400 vCPU 分钟、800 GB 分钟和 10 个并发作业，配备高性能 runner（每个作业 12 vCPU 和 32 GB 内存）。

entries.name: Shipfox
entries.desc_en: Run your GitHub actions 2x faster, 3.000 build minutes free each month.
entries.desc_zh: 让你的 GitHub Actions 运行速度提升 2 倍，每月 3,000 分钟免费构建时长。

entries.name: Spacelift
entries.desc_en: Management platform for Infrastructure as Code. Free plan features: IaC collaboration, Terraform module registry, ChatOps integration, Continuous resource compliance with Open Policy Agent, SSO with SAML 2.0, and access to public worker pools: up to 200 minutes/month
entries.desc_zh: Infrastructure as Code 管理平台。免费计划功能包括：IaC 协作、Terraform 模块注册表、ChatOps 集成、基于 Open Policy Agent 的持续资源合规、SAML 2.0 SSO，以及访问公共 worker 池：每月最多 200 分钟

entries.name: Terramate
entries.desc_en: Terramate is an orchestration and management platform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, and Terragrunt. Free up to 2 users including all features.
entries.desc_zh: Terramate 是面向 Terraform、OpenTofu、Terragrunt 等 Infrastructure as Code (IaC) 工具的编排和管理平台。最多 2 名用户免费，包含所有功能。

entries.name: Terrateam
entries.desc_en: GitOps-first Terraform automation with pull request-driven workflows, project isolation via self-hosted runners, and layered runs for ordered operations. Free for up to 3 users.
entries.desc_zh: GitOps 优先的 Terraform 自动化，提供由 pull request 驱动的工作流、通过自托管 runner 实现的项目隔离，以及用于有序操作的分层运行。最多 3 名用户免费。

entries.name: Trigger.dev
entries.desc_en: Open-source background jobs and AI agent platform with durable tasks, no timeouts, and realtime. Free plan includes $5 monthly compute credits, 20 concurrent runs, unlimited tasks, 5 team members, 10 schedules, and 1-day log retention.
entries.desc_zh: 开源的后台任务和 AI 代理平台，具有持久化任务、无超时和实时特性。免费计划包含每月 5 美元计算积分、20 个并发运行、不限任务数量、5 名团队成员、10 个定时调度和 1 天日志保留。

entries.name: Appetize
entries.desc_en: Test your Android & iOS apps on this Cloud Based Android Phone / Tablets emulator and iPhone/iPad simulators directly in your browser. The free tier includes two concurrent session with 30 minutes of usage per month. No limit on app size.
entries.desc_zh: 在浏览器中直接基于云的 Android 手机/平板模拟器和 iPhone/iPad 模拟器上测试您的 Android 和 iOS 应用。免费套餐包括每月两次并发会话，每次使用 30 分钟。应用大小无限制

entries.name: Argos
entries.desc_en: Open Source visual testing for developers. Unlimitedprojects, with 5,000 screenshots per month. Free for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的开源视觉测试。项目数量不限，每月 5,000 张截图。对开源项目免费。

entries.name: Bencher
entries.desc_en: A continuous benchmarking tool suite to catch CI performance regressions. Free for all public projects.
entries.desc_zh: 一套持续基准测试工具套件，用于捕获 CI 性能回退。对所有公开项目免费。

entries.name: BugBug
entries.desc_en: Lightweight test automation tool for web applications. It is easy to learn and doesn't require coding. You can run unlimited tests on your own computer for free. You also get cloud monitoring and CI/CD integration for an additional monthly fee.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web 应用的轻量级测试自动化工具。易于学习，无需编写代码。你可以在自己的电脑上免费运行无限量测试。此外还可按月付费获得云监控和 CI/CD 集成。

entries.name: checkbot.io
entries.desc_en: Browser extension that tests if your website follows 50+ SEO, speed and security best practices. Free tier for smaller websites.
entries.desc_zh: 一款浏览器扩展，用于测试你的网站是否遵循 50 多项 SEO、速度和安全最佳实践。为小型网站提供免费套餐。

entries.name: Checkly
entries.desc_en: Code-first synthetic monitoring for modern DevOps. Monitor your APIs and apps at a fraction of the price of legacy providers. Powered by a Monitoring as Code workflow and Playwright. Generous free tier for devs.
entries.desc_zh: 面向现代 DevOps 的代码优先合成监控。以传统供应商价格的一小部分监控你的 API 和应用。由 Monitoring as Code 工作流和 Playwright 驱动。为开发者提供慷慨的免费套餐。

entries.name: CORS-Tester
entries.desc_en: A free tool for developers and API testers to check if an API is CORS-enabled for a given domain and identify gaps. Get actionable insights.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向开发者和 API 测试人员的免费工具，用于检查某个 API 是否针对给定域名启用了 CORS，并找出差距。获得可操作的洞察。

entries.name: cypress.io
entries.desc_en: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser. Cypress Test Runner is always free and open-source with no restrictions and limitations. Cypress Dashboard is free for open-source projects for up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 为任何在浏览器中运行的东西提供快速、简单、可靠的测试。Cypress Test Runner 永久免费且开源，没有任何限制和约束。Cypress Dashboard 对开源项目免费，最多支持 5 名用户。

entries.name: everystep-automation.com
entries.desc_en: Records and replays all steps made in a web browser and creates scripts, free with fewer options
entries.desc_zh: 记录并回放在网页浏览器中执行的所有步骤并生成脚本，免费版选项较少

entries.name: gridlastic.com
entries.desc_en: Selenium Grid testing with a free plan of up to 4 simultaneous selenium nodes/10 grid starts/4,000 test minutes/month
entries.desc_zh: Selenium Grid 测试，免费套餐包含最多 4 个并行 Selenium 节点/10 次 Grid 启动/每月 4,000 分钟测试时长

entries.name: katalon.com
entries.desc_en: Provides a testing platform that can help teams of all sizes at different levels of testing maturity, including  Katalon Studio, TestOps (+ Visual Testing free), TestCloud, and Katalon Recorder.
entries.desc_zh: 提供一个测试平台，可帮助各种规模、处于不同测试成熟度水平的团队，包括 Katalon Studio、TestOps（+ Visual Testing 免费）、TestCloud 和 Katalon Recorder。

entries.name: Keploy
entries.desc_en: Keploy is a functional testing toolkit for developers. Recording API calls generates E2E tests for APIs (KTests) and mocks or stubs(KMocks). It is free for Open Source projects.
entries.desc_zh: Keploy 是一款面向开发者的功能测试工具包。通过记录 API 调用，为 API 生成 E2E 测试（KTests）以及 mock 或 stub（KMocks）。对开源项目免费。

entries.name: Lastest
entries.desc_en: Ship fast. Don't break things. AI-supported visual verification and tests you can actually trust. Free forever plan: 1 project, 500 runner-minutes/mo, 1 concurrent run, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 快速发布，不搞坏东西。AI 支持的视觉验证，以及你真正可以信赖的测试。永久免费计划：1 个项目、每月 500 runner 分钟、1 个并发运行，无需信用卡。

entries.name: loadmill.com
entries.desc_en: Automatically create API and load tests by analyzing network traffic. Simulate up to 50 concurrent users for up to 60 minutes for free monthly.
entries.desc_zh: 通过分析网络流量自动创建 API 和负载测试。每月免费模拟最多 50 个并发用户，时长最多 60 分钟。

entries.name: lost-pixel.com
entries.desc_en: holistic visual regression testing for your Storybook, Ladle, Histoire stories and Web Apps. Unlimited team members, totally free for open-source, 7,000 snapshots/month.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的 Storybook、Ladle、Histoire 故事和 Web 应用提供全面的视觉回归测试。团队成员数量不限，开源项目完全免费，每月 7,000 张快照。

entries.name: OpenWebhook
entries.desc_en: Temporary webhook URL and live inspector. No signup. Event history stays in the browser. Custom slugs and remote forwarding are paid.
entries.desc_zh: 临时 webhook URL 和实时检查器。无需注册。事件历史保存在浏览器中。自定义 slug 和远程转发为付费功能。

entries.name: pagegym.com
entries.desc_en: Load behaviour and page speed analysis and optimization tool. The free plan provides 10 tests per day, 5 experiments per week, and 15 GB of maximum ingested data per month.
entries.desc_zh: 负载行为和页面速度分析与优化工具。免费套餐提供每天 10 次测试、每周 5 次实验，以及每月最多摄取 15 GB 数据。

entries.name: percy.io
entries.desc_en: Add visual testing to any web app, static site, style guide, or component library.  Unlimited team members, Demo app, and unlimited projects, 5,000 snapshots/month.
entries.desc_zh: 为任何 Web 应用、静态网站、样式指南或组件库添加视觉测试。团队成员数量不限、提供 Demo 应用、项目数量不限，每月 5,000 张快照。

entries.name: qase.io
entries.desc_en: Test management system for Dev and QA teams. Manage test cases, compose test runs, perform tests, track defects, and measure impact. The free tier includes all core features, with 500MB available for attachments and up to 3 users.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发和 QA 团队的测试管理系统。管理测试用例、组织测试运行、执行测试、跟踪缺陷并衡量影响。免费套餐包含所有核心功能，提供 500 MB 附件空间，最多支持 3 名用户。

entries.name: Repeato
entries.desc_en: No-code mobile app test automation tool built on top of computer vision and AI.
entries.desc_zh: 基于计算机视觉和 AI 构建的无代码移动应用测试自动化工具。

entries.name: Requestly
entries.desc_en: Open-source Chrome Extension to Intercept, Redirect and Mock HTTP Requests.
entries.desc_zh: 用于拦截、重定向和 Mock HTTP 请求的开源 Chrome 扩展。

entries.name: Sample Files
entries.desc_en: Collection of free test files across video, audio, document and archive formats, useful for testing and QA.
entries.desc_zh: 涵盖视频、音频、文档和压缩包格式的免费测试文件合集，对测试和 QA 很有用。

entries.name: seotest.me
entries.desc_en: Free on-page SEO website tester. 10 free website crawls per day. Useful SEO learning resources and recommendations on how to improve the on-page SEO results for any website regardless of technology.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的页面 SEO 网站测试工具。每天 10 次免费网站抓取。提供实用的 SEO 学习资源，以及针对任何网站（无论何种技术）改进页面 SEO 结果的建议。

entries.name: Sherlo
entries.desc_en: Visual regression testing for React Native apps. Free plan: 1,000 snapshots/month, iOS & Android simulators.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 React Native 应用的视觉回归测试。免费计划：每月 1,000 张快照，支持 iOS 和 Android 模拟器。

entries.name: snippets.uilicious.com
entries.desc_en: It's like CodePen but for cross-browser testing. UI-licious lets you write tests like user stories and offers a free platform - UI-licious Snippets - that allows you to run unlimited tests on Chrome with no sign-up required for up to 3 minutes per test run. Found a bug? You can copy the unique URL to your test to show your devs exactly how to reproduce the bug.
entries.desc_zh: 就像 CodePen，但用于跨浏览器测试。UI-licious 让你可以像编写用户故事一样编写测试，并提供一个免费平台——UI-licious Snippets——让你无需注册即可在 Chrome 上运行无限量测试，每次测试运行最多 3 分钟。发现了 bug？你可以复制该测试的唯一 URL，向你的开发者准确展示如何复现该 bug。

entries.name: SSR (Server-side Rendering) Checker
entries.desc_en: Check SSR (server-side rendering) for any URL by visually comparing the server rendered version of the page with the regular version.
entries.desc_zh: 通过直观比较页面的服务器渲染版本与常规版本，检查任意 URL 的 SSR（服务器端渲染）。

entries.name: stateofpixel
entries.desc_en: Catch UI regressions before they merge. Your CI takes the screenshots with Playwright, Storybook or any tool that writes PNGs, and a person approves each change on the pull request. Open source and self-hostable. Free up to 10 GB.
entries.desc_zh: 在 UI 回退被合并之前捕获它们。你的 CI 使用 Playwright、Storybook 或任何能生成 PNG 的工具截取屏幕截图，由人在 pull request 上批准每处变更。开源且可自托管。免费额度最高 10 GB。

entries.name: testingbot.com
entries.desc_en: Selenium Browser and Device Testing, [free for Open Source](https://testingbot.com/open-source)
entries.desc_zh: Selenium 浏览器和设备测试，[free for Open Source](https://testingbot.com/open-source)

entries.name: Testspace.com
entries.desc_en: A Dashboard for publishing automated test results and a Framework for implementing manual tests as code using GitHub. The service is [free for Open Source](https://github.com/marketplace/testspace-com) and accounts for 450 monthly results.
entries.desc_zh: 一个用于发布自动化测试结果的 Dashboard，以及一个借助 GitHub 将手动测试实现为代码的 Framework。该服务 [free for Open Source](https://github.com/marketplace/testspace-com)，每月包含 450 条结果。

entries.name: tesults.com
entries.desc_en: Test results reporting and test case management. Integrates with popular test frameworks. Open Source software developers, individuals, educators, and small teams getting started can request discounted and free offerings beyond basic free projects.
entries.desc_zh: 测试结果报告与测试用例管理。可与流行的测试框架集成。Open Source 软件开发者、个人、教育工作者以及刚起步的小团队，可在基础免费项目之外申请折扣和免费方案。

entries.name: UI Verify
entries.desc_en: Visual regression testing for Storybook, Playwright and Vitest, built for coding agents. 10,000 snapshots per month free, no credit card. 50,000 per month for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 为 Storybook、Playwright 和 Vitest 提供的视觉回归测试，专为 coding agent 构建。每月免费 10,000 张快照，无需信用卡。开源项目每月 50,000 张。

entries.name: UseWebhook.com
entries.desc_en: Capture and inspect webhooks from your browser. Forward to localhost, or replay from history. Free to use.
entries.desc_zh: 在浏览器中捕获和检查 webhook。转发到 localhost，或从历史记录中重放。免费使用。

entries.name: Vaadin
entries.desc_en: Build scalable UIs in Java or TypeScript, and use the integrated tooling, components, and design system to iterate faster, design better, and simplify the development process. Unlimited Projects with five years of free maintenance.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 Java 或 TypeScript 构建可扩展的 UI，并借助集成的工具、组件和设计系统更快地迭代、更好地设计并简化开发流程。项目数量不限，并附带五年免费维护。

entries.name: VibeView
entries.desc_en: Browser-based iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV simulators with AI-powered test automation from a recorded flow or plain-language instructions. Free tier includes two concurrent sessions and 30 minutes of streaming per month. Bringing your own API key bypasses the included AI usage credit.
entries.desc_zh: 基于浏览器的 iOS、Android、Apple TV 和 Android TV 模拟器，支持通过录制的流程或自然语言指令进行 AI 驱动的测试自动化。免费套餐包含两个并发会话和每月 30 分钟的串流时长。自带 API key 可绕过内置的 AI 用量额度。

entries.name: webhook.site
entries.desc_en: Verify webhooks, outbound HTTP requests, or emails with a custom URL. A temporary URL and email address are always free.
entries.desc_zh: 使用自定义 URL 验证 webhook、出站 HTTP 请求或电子邮件。临时 URL 和电子邮件地址永久免费。

entries.name: websitepulse.com
entries.desc_en: Various free network and server tools.
entries.desc_zh: 各种免费的网络和服务器工具。

entries.name: kogiQA
entries.desc_en: A web UI automation tool that functions without the need for selectors. Every developer gets 500 actions per month for free.
entries.desc_zh: 一款无需选择器即可工作的 Web UI 自动化工具。每位开发者每月可免费获得 500 次操作。

entries.name: aikido.dev
entries.desc_en: All-in-one appsec platform covering SCA, SAST, CSPM, DAST, Secrets, IaC, Malware, Container scanning, EOL,... Free plan includes two users, scanning of 10 repos, 1 cloud, 2 containers & 1 domain.
entries.desc_zh: 一站式应用安全（appsec）平台，涵盖 SCA、SAST、CSPM、DAST、Secrets、IaC、恶意软件、容器扫描、EOL 等。免费计划包含两名用户，可扫描 10 个代码仓库、1 个云、2 个容器和 1 个域名。

entries.name: CertKit
entries.desc_en: Manage SSL Certificate issuance, renewal, and monitoring. Search the Certificate Transparency Logs. Free for 3 certificates and 1 user after the beta.
entries.desc_zh: 管理 SSL 证书的签发、续期和监控。搜索 Certificate Transparency 日志。Beta 结束后，3 张证书和 1 名用户免费。

entries.name: CertObserver CT Search
entries.desc_en: Find public SSL/TLS certificates recorded in Certificate Transparency logs. CT search is free but CT monitoring is not.
entries.desc_zh: 查找记录在 Certificate Transparency 日志中的公开 SSL/TLS 证书。CT 搜索免费，但 CT 监控收费。

entries.name: CertPost
entries.desc_en: Live SSL/TLS certificate monitoring on port 443 or custom ports (SMTP/IMAP). Reads the served certificate on the wire, full chain verification, and alerts via email or webhook before expiration. Free tier includes 3 certificates monitored forever.
entries.desc_zh: 对端口 443 或自定义端口（SMTP/IMAP）进行实时 SSL/TLS 证书监控。直接从线路上读取所提供的证书，进行完整证书链验证，并在到期前通过电子邮件或 webhook 发出警报。免费套餐包含 3 张证书的永久监控。

entries.name: Corgea
entries.desc_en: Free autonomous security platform that finds, validates and fixes insecure code and packages across +20 languages and frameworks. Free plan includes 1 user and 2 repos.
entries.desc_zh: 免费自主式安全平台，可发现、验证并修复 20 多种语言和框架中的不安全代码和软件包。免费计划包含 1 名用户和 2 个代码仓库。

entries.name: crypteron.com
entries.desc_en: Cloud-first, developer-friendly security platform prevents data breaches in .NET and Java applications
entries.desc_zh: 云优先、对开发者友好的安全平台，防范 .NET 和 Java 应用程序中的数据泄露

entries.name: CyberChef
entries.desc_en: A simple, intuitive web app for analyzing and decoding/encoding data without dealing with complex tools or programming languages. Like a Swiss army knife of cryptography & encryption. All features are free to use, with no limit. Open source if you wish to self-host.
entries.desc_zh: 一款简单直观的 Web 应用，用于分析和解码/编码数据，无需使用复杂的工具或编程语言。就像加密与密码学领域的瑞士军刀。所有功能免费使用，无任何限制。如需自行托管，该项目开源。

entries.name: Datree
entries.desc_en: Open Source CLI tool to prevent Kubernetes misconfigurations by ensuring that manifests and Helm charts follow best practices as well as your organization’s policies
entries.desc_zh: 一个开源的 CLI 工具，通过确保清单和 Helm 图表遵循最佳实践以及您组织的策略，来防止 Kubernetes 配置错误

entries.name: Dependabot
entries.desc_en: Automated dependency updates for Ruby, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Elixir,
entries.desc_zh: Ruby、JavaScript、Python、PHP、Elixir 的自动化依赖更新

entries.name: DJ Checkup
entries.desc_en: Scan your Django site for security flaws with this free, automated checkup tool. Forked from the Pony Checkup site.
entries.desc_zh: 使用这个免费、自动化的检查工具扫描您的 Django 站点是否存在安全漏洞。源自 Pony Checkup 网站。

entries.name: Doppler
entries.desc_en: Universal Secrets Manager for application secrets and config, with support for syncing to various cloud providers. Free for five users with basic access controls.
entries.desc_zh: 面向应用密钥和配置的通用 Secrets 管理器，支持同步到多种云服务提供商。五个用户免费，提供基本访问控制。

entries.name: Dotenv
entries.desc_en: Sync your .env files, quickly & securely. Stop sharing your .env files over insecure channels like Slack and email, and never lose an important .env file again. Free for up to 3 teammates.
entries.desc_zh: 快速且安全地同步您的 .env 文件。停止通过 Slack 和邮件等不安全渠道共享 .env 文件，并永远不要再丢失重要的 .env 文件。最多 3 名队友免费。

entries.name: GitGuardian
entries.desc_en: Keep secrets out of your source code with automated secrets detection and remediation. Scan your git repos for 350+ types of secrets and sensitive files - Free for individuals and teams of 25 developers or less.
entries.desc_zh: 通过自动化密钥检测和修复，防止密钥出现在您的源代码中。扫描您的 git 仓库以查找 350+ 种类型的密钥和敏感文件——个人和 25 名或更少开发者的团队免费。

entries.name: HasMySecretLeaked
entries.desc_en: Search across 20 million exposed secrets in public GitHub repositories, gists, issues,and comments for Free
entries.desc_zh: 免费搜索公开 GitHub 仓库、代码片段、问题和评论中的 2000 万个泄露密钥

entries.name: Have I been pwned?
entries.desc_en: REST API for fetching the information on the breaches.
entries.desc_zh: 用于获取泄露信息的 REST API。

entries.name: HimitsuShell
entries.desc_en: A shell script DRM compiler that converts shell scripts into obfuscated binaries using an embedded shell interpreter and anti-debugging (alternative to shc). Free unlimited web edition.
entries.desc_zh: 一个 Shell 脚本 DRM 编译器，使用嵌入式 Shell 解释器和反调试功能将 Shell 脚本转换为混淆二进制文件（shc 的替代品）。免费无限网络版。

entries.name: hostedscan.com
entries.desc_en: Online vulnerability scanner for web applications, servers, and networks. Ten free scans per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web 应用程序、服务器和网络的在线漏洞扫描器。每月十次免费扫描。

entries.name: Infisical
entries.desc_en: Open source platform that lets you manage developer secrets across your team and infrastructure: everywhere from local development to staging/production 3rd-party services. Free for up to 5 developers.
entries.desc_zh: 开源平台，让你在团队和基础设施中管理开发者机密信息（secrets）：从本地开发到预发布/生产环境的第三方服务，处处适用。最多 5 名开发者可免费使用。

entries.name: inspect.software
entries.desc_en: Public record of automated open-source repository audits: security posture, maintainability, dependency health, and malicious-package checks, with a versioned methodology and grade badges. Free tier: full access to all published reports, automatic coverage of repositories above the public-interest threshold (≥500 stars, ≥50 forks, or org-owned with ≥250 stars), embeddable badges, and 100 starting credits (5 inspections) for below-threshold repositories.
entries.desc_zh: 自动化开源仓库审计的公开记录：涵盖安全态势、可维护性、依赖健康状况和恶意包检查，包含版本化方法和等级徽章。免费层级：可完全访问所有已发布报告，对超过公共利益阈值（≥500 星，≥50 分叉，或拥有 ≥250 星的组织）的仓库进行自动覆盖，提供可嵌入徽章，以及低于阈值的仓库的 100 初始积分（5 次检查）。

entries.name: Internet.nl
entries.desc_en: Test for modern Internet Standards like IPv6, DNSSEC, HTTPS, DMARC, STARTTLS and DANE
entries.desc_zh: 测试现代互联网标准，如 IPv6、DNSSEC、HTTPS、DMARC、STARTTLS 和 DANE

entries.name: IntoDNS.ai
entries.desc_en: DNS and email security analyzer that checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNSSEC, BIMI, MTA-STS, and 40+ blacklists with AI-powered explanations and fix suggestions. 100% free, no signup required.
entries.desc_zh: DNS 和电子邮件安全分析器，检查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、DNSSEC、BIMI、MTA-STS 和 40+ 黑名单，并提供 AI 驱动的解释和修复建议。100% 免费，无需注册。

entries.name: letsencrypt.org
entries.desc_en: Free SSL Certificate Authority with certs trusted by all major browsers
entries.desc_zh: 免费 SSL 证书颁发机构，其证书被所有主流浏览器信任

entries.name: meterian.io
entries.desc_en: Monitor Java, Javascript, .NET, Scala, Ruby, and NodeJS projects for security vulnerabilities in dependencies. Free for one private project, unlimited projects for open source.
entries.desc_zh: 监控 Java、Javascript、.NET、Scala、Ruby 和 NodeJS 项目的依赖安全漏洞。一个私有项目免费，开源项目不限数量。

entries.name: Mozilla Observatory
entries.desc_en: Find and fix security vulnerabilities in your site.
entries.desc_zh: 在您的站点中查找并修复安全漏洞。

entries.name: Otterwatch
entries.desc_en: Daily SSL/TLS certificate monitoring: expiry alerts (30/7/1 day), chain and OCSP revocation checks, and certificate transparency issuance history. Free forever for 5 domains, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 每日 SSL/TLS 证书监控：过期警报（30/7/1 天），链和 OCSP 撤销检查，以及证书透明度签发历史。5 个域名永久免费，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Protectumus
entries.desc_en: Free website security check, site antivirus, and server firewall (WAF) for PHP. Email notifications for registered users in the free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 针对 PHP 的免费网站安全检查、站点杀毒和服务器防火墙 (WAF)。免费层级的注册用户可接收电子邮件通知。

entries.name: Public Cloud Threat Intelligence
entries.desc_en: High confidence Indicator of Compromise(IOC) targeting public cloud infrastructure, A portion is available on github (https://github.com/unknownhad/AWSAttacks). Full list is available via API
entries.desc_zh: 针对公共云基础设施的高置信度入侵指标 (IOC)，一部分在 github 上可用 (https://github.com/unknownhad/AWSAttacks)。完整列表可通过 API 获取

entries.name: pyup.io
entries.desc_en: Monitor Python dependencies for security vulnerabilities and update them automatically. Free for one private project, unlimited projects for open source.
entries.desc_zh: 监控 Python 依赖的安全漏洞并自动更新。一个私有项目免费，开源项目不限数量。

entries.name: qualys.com
entries.desc_en: Find web app vulnerabilities, audit for OWASP Risks
entries.desc_zh: 查找 Web 应用漏洞，审计 OWASP 风险。

entries.name: SikkerKey
entries.desc_en: Machine authenticated secrets manager, includes 2 projects, 2 bootstrapped machines, 20 secrets and 7 days audit log retention for free.
entries.desc_zh: 机器认证的密钥管理器，包含 2 个项目、2 台引导机器、20 个密钥和 7 天审计日志保留，免费。

entries.name: Smart Grow Vault
entries.desc_en: Secure Enterprise-grade platform for managing environment variables and secrets. Free tier includes up to 3 applications and 150 secrets per project.
entries.desc_zh: 安全的企业级平台，用于管理环境变量和密钥。免费层包含最多 3 个应用程序和每个项目 150 个密钥。

entries.name: Socket
entries.desc_en: Free supply chain security for individual developers, small teams, and open source projects. Includes a free app and firewall CLI tool to protect your code from vulnerable and malicious dependencies. Detects 70+ indicators of supply chain risk.
entries.desc_zh: 为个人开发者、小型团队和开源项目提供免费的供应链安全。包含一个免费应用程序和防火墙 CLI 工具，以保护代码免受易受攻击和恶意依赖项的影响。检测 70 多个供应链风险指标。

entries.name: ssllabs.com
entries.desc_en: Intense analysis of the configuration of any SSL web server
entries.desc_zh: 对任何 SSL Web 服务器的配置进行深入分析。

entries.name: SubdomainWatch
entries.desc_en: Attack surface monitoring and CI/CD takeover guard. Free standalone DNS scanner, GitHub Action with SARIF export, and continuous asset monitoring tier.
entries.desc_zh: 攻击面监控和 CI/CD 接管防护。免费的独立 DNS 扫描器、带有 SARIF 导出的 GitHub Action 以及持续资产监控层。

entries.name: Sucuri SiteCheck
entries.desc_en: Free website security check and malware scanner
entries.desc_zh: 免费的网站安全检查和恶意软件扫描器。

entries.name: TestTLS.com
entries.desc_en: Test an SSL/TLS service for secure server configuration, certificates, chains, etc. Not limited to HTTPS.
entries.desc_zh: 测试 SSL/TLS 服务器的安全服务器配置、证书、链等。不限于 HTTPS。

entries.name: Virgil Security
entries.desc_en: Tools and services for implementing end-to-end encryption, database protection, IoT security, and more in your digital solution. Free for applications with up to 250 users.
entries.desc_zh: 在您的数字解决方案中实现端到端加密、数据库保护、IoT 安全等的工具和服务。最多 250 个用户的应用程序免费。

entries.name: semgrep
entries.desc_en: Scan code for security issues and vulnerable dependencies with SAST and SCA. Free tier includes up to 10 contributors and 10 private repos (unlimited public repos).
entries.desc_zh: 使用 SAST 和 SCA 扫描代码中的安全问题和不安全依赖项。免费层包含最多 10 个贡献者和 10 个私有仓库（无限公共仓库）。

entries.name: SnapEnv
entries.desc_en: Secure environment variable manager for dev teams. AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, CLI, Kubernetes operator, and audit log. Free plan includes 3 projects, 3 members, and 3 environments per project, forever.
entries.desc_zh: 为开发团队提供的安全环境变量管理器。静态 AES-256-GCM 加密，CLI，Kubernetes 操作符和审计日志。免费计划包含 3 个项目、3 个成员和每个项目 3 个环境，永久。

entries.name: 360username
entries.desc_en: A free tool to search a username across 90+ social platforms to find matching profiles.
entries.desc_zh: 一个免费的工具，可在 90 多个社交平台上搜索用户名以查找匹配的个人资料。

entries.name: Aserto
entries.desc_en: Fine-grained authorization as a service for applications and APIs. Free up to 1000 MAUs and 100 authorizer instances.
entries.desc_zh: 为应用程序和 API 提供的细粒度授权即服务。免费最多 1000 MAU 和 100 个授权器实例。

entries.name: asgardeo.io
entries.desc_en: Seamless Integration of SSO, MFA, passwordless auth and more. Includes SDKs for frontend and backend apps. Free up to 1000 MAUs and five identity providers.
entries.desc_zh: SSO、MFA、无密码认证等的无缝集成。包含前端和后端应用程序的 SDK。免费最多 1000 MAU 和五个身份提供商。

entries.name: Auth0
entries.desc_en: Hosted SSO. The free plan includes 25,000 MAUs, unlimited Social Connections, a custom domain, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 托管 SSO。免费计划包含 25,000 MAU、无限社交连接、自定义域名等。

entries.name: Authgear
entries.desc_en: Bring Passwordless, OTPs, 2FA, SSO to your apps in minutes. All Front-end included. Free up to 5000 MAUs.
entries.desc_zh: 在几分钟内将无密码、OTP、2FA、SSO 带到您的应用程序。包含所有前端。免费最多 5000 MAU。

entries.name: Authress
entries.desc_en: Authentication login and access control, unlimited identity providers for any project. Facebook, Google, Twitter and more. The first 1000 API calls are free.
entries.desc_zh: 身份验证登录和访问控制，任何项目无限身份提供商。Facebook、Google、Twitter 等。前 1000 次 API 调用免费。

entries.name: Authy
entries.desc_en: Two-factor authentication (2FA) on multiple devices, with backups. Drop-in replacement for Google Authenticator. Free for up to 100 successful authentications.
entries.desc_zh: 多设备上的双因素认证 (2FA)，带有备份。Google Authenticator 的即插即用替代品。最多 100 次成功认证免费。

entries.name: Cerbos Hub
entries.desc_en: A complete authorization management system for authoring, testing, and deploying access policies. Fine-grained authorization and access control, free up to 100 monthly active principals.
entries.desc_zh: 一套完整的授权管理系统，用于编写、测试和部署访问策略。细粒度授权与访问控制，每月活跃主体最多 100 个免费。

entries.name: Clerk
entries.desc_en: User management, authentication, 2FA/MFA, prebuilt UI components for sign-in, sign-up, user profiles, and more. Free plan includes unlimited applications, 50,000 MRU limit per app, 3 dashboard seats, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 用户管理、身份验证、2FA/MFA、用于登录、注册、用户资料等的预构建 UI 组件。免费计划包括无限应用、每个应用 50,000 MRU 限制、3 个仪表板席位等。

entries.name: Cloud-IAM
entries.desc_en: Keycloak Identity and Access Management as a Service. Free up to 100 users and one realm.
entries.desc_zh: Keycloak 身份与访问管理即服务。免费使用最多 100 个用户和一个领域。

entries.name: Descope
entries.desc_en: Highly customizable AuthN flows, has both a no-code and API/SDK approach, Free 7,500 active users/month, 50 tenants (up to 5 SAML/SSO tenants).
entries.desc_zh: 高度可定制的 AuthN 流程，具有无代码和 API/SDK 方法，免费 7,500 活跃用户/月，50 个租户（最多 5 个 SAML/SSO 租户）。

entries.name: duo.com
entries.desc_en: Two-factor authentication (2FA) for website or app. Free for ten users, all authentication methods, unlimited, integrations, hardware tokens.
entries.desc_zh: 面向网站或应用的双因素认证（2FA）。十位用户免费，包含所有认证方式、不限用量、集成以及硬件令牌。

entries.name: Frontegg
entries.desc_en: Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs
entries.desc_zh: B2B SaaS 的客户身份管理：认证、SSO/SCIM、MFA、RBAC 和多租户用户管理。免费套餐包含 7,500 MAU

entries.name: Kinde
entries.desc_en: Simple, robust authentication you can integrate with your product in minutes.  Everything you need to get started with 7,500 free MAU.
entries.desc_zh: 简单、稳健的身份验证，您可以在几分钟内集成到您的产品中。开始使用 7,500 免费月活跃用户所需的一切。

entries.name: logintc.com
entries.desc_en: Two-factor authentication (2FA) by push notifications, free for ten users, VPN, Websites, and SSH
entries.desc_zh: 通过推送通知实现的双因素认证（2FA），十位用户免费，支持 VPN、网站和 SSH

entries.name: Logto
entries.desc_en: Develop, secure, and manage user identities of your product - for both authentication and authorization. Free for up to 5,000 MAUs with open-source self-hosted option available.
entries.desc_zh: 开发、保护和管理您产品的用户身份——用于身份验证和授权。免费最多 5,000 MAU，并提供开源自托管选项。

entries.name: MojoAuth
entries.desc_en: MojoAuth makes it easy to implement Passwordless authentication on your web, mobile, or any application in minutes.
entries.desc_zh: MojoAuth 让您可以在几分钟内轻松在您的网站、移动设备或任何应用上实现无密码身份验证。

entries.name: Okta
entries.desc_en: User management, authentication and authorization. Free for up to 100 monthly active users.
entries.desc_zh: 用户管理、身份验证和授权。免费最多 100 月活跃用户。

entries.name: Ory
entries.desc_en: AuthN/AuthZ/OAuth2.0/Zero Trust managed security platform. Forever free developer accounts with all security features, unlimited team members, 200 daily active users, and 25k/mo permission checks.
entries.desc_zh: AuthN/AuthZ/OAuth2.0/零信任托管安全平台。永久免费开发者账户，包含所有安全功能、无限团队成员、200 每日活跃用户和 25k/月权限检查。

entries.name: Permit.io
entries.desc_en: Auhtorization-as-a-service provider platform enabling RBAC, ABAC, and ReBAC for scalable microservices with real-time updates and a no-code policy UI. A 1000 Monthly Active User free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 授权即服务提供商平台，为可扩展微服务启用 RBAC、ABAC 和 ReBAC，具有实时更新和无代码策略 UI。1000 月活跃用户免费层级。

entries.name: Phase Two
entries.desc_en: Keycloak Open Source Identity and Access Management. Free realm up to 1000 users, up to 10 SSO connections, leveraging Phase Two's Keycloak enhanced container which includes the [Organization](https://phasetwo.io/product/organizations/) extension.
entries.desc_zh: Keycloak 开源身份与访问管理。免费领域最多 1000 个用户，最多 10 个 SSO 连接，利用 Phase Two 的 Keycloak 增强容器，其中包括 [Organization](https://phasetwo.io/product/organizations/) 扩展。

entries.name: PropelAuth
entries.desc_en: A Sell to companies of any size immediately with a few lines of code, free up to 200 users and 10k Transactional Emails (with a watermark branding: "Powered by PropelAuth").
entries.desc_zh: 用几行代码立即向任何规模的公司销售，免费最多 200 个用户和 10k 交易邮件（带有水印品牌：“Powered by PropelAuth”）。

entries.name: Scalekit
entries.desc_en: Enterprise SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, and social logins for B2B SaaS. Free tier includes 1 million MAU, 100 organizations, 1 SSO connection, and 1 SCIM connection.
entries.desc_zh: B2B SaaS 的企业 SSO (SAML, OIDC)、SCIM 配置和社交登录。免费层级包括 1 million MAU、100 个组织、1 个 SSO 连接和 1 个 SCIM 连接。

entries.name: Stack Auth
entries.desc_en: Open-source authentication that doesn't suck. The most developer-friendly solution, getting you started in just five minutes. Self-hostable for free, or offers a managed SaaS version with 10k free Monthly Active Users.
entries.desc_zh: 不烂的开源身份验证。最开发者友好的解决方案，只需五分钟即可开始。可免费自托管，或提供托管 SaaS 版本，包含 10k 免费月活跃用户。

entries.name: Stytch
entries.desc_en: An all-in-one platform that provides APIs and SDKs for authentication and fraud prevention. The free plan includes 10,000 monthly active users, unlimited organizations, 5 SSO or SCIM connections, and 1,000 M2M tokens.
entries.desc_zh: 一个提供身份验证和反欺诈 API 和 SDK 的综合平台。免费计划包括 10,000 月活跃用户、无限组织、5 个 SSO 或 SCIM 连接以及 1,000 M2M 令牌。

entries.name: SuperTokens
entries.desc_en: Open source user authentication that natively integrates into your app - enabling you to get started quickly while controlling the user and developer experience. Free for up to 5000 MAUs.
entries.desc_zh: 原生集成到您应用中的开源用户认证——让您能够快速上手，同时掌控用户体验和开发者体验。免费提供高达 5000 MAU。

entries.name: Unkey
entries.desc_en: Open-source API key management and rate-limiting platform. Free for up to 100,000 requests per month and 100 active API keys, with full access to key creation, revocation, and rate-limiting capabilities.
entries.desc_zh: 开源 API 密钥管理和速率限制平台。免费最多 100,000 每月请求数和 100 个活跃 API 密钥，完全访问密钥创建、撤销和速率限制功能。

entries.name: WorkOS
entries.desc_en: Free user management and authentication for up to 1 Million MAUs. Support email + password, social auth, Magic Auth, MFA, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 最多 1 Million MAU 的免费用户管理和身份验证。支持电子邮件 + 密码、社交身份验证、Magic Auth、MFA 等。

entries.name: ZITADEL Cloud
entries.desc_en: A turnkey user and access management that works for you and supports multi-tenant (B2B) use cases. Free for up to 25,000 authenticated requests, with all security features (no paywall for OTP, Passwordless, Policies, and so on).
entries.desc_zh: 一键式用户和访问管理，为您工作并支持多租户 (B2B) 用例。免费最多 25,000 个已验证请求，包含所有安全功能（OTP、无密码、策略等无付费墙）。

entries.name: Appho.st
entries.desc_en: Mobile app hosting platform. The free plan includes five apps, 50 monthly downloads, and a maximum file size of 100 MB.
entries.desc_zh: 移动应用托管平台。免费套餐包含五个应用、每月 50 次下载，以及最大 100 MB 的文件大小。

entries.name: Diawi
entries.desc_en: Deploy iOS & Android apps directly to devices. Free plan: app uploads, password-protected links, 1-day expiration, ten installations.
entries.desc_zh: 将 iOS 和 Android 应用直接部署到设备。免费套餐：应用上传、密码保护链接、1 天有效期、十次安装。

entries.name: GetUpdraft
entries.desc_en: Distribute mobile apps for testing. The free plan includes one app project, three app versions, 500 MB storage, and 100 app installations per month.
entries.desc_zh: 分发移动应用以供测试。免费套餐包含一个应用项目、三个应用版本、500 MB 存储空间，以及每月 100 次应用安装。

entries.name: InstallOnAir
entries.desc_en: Distribute iOS & Android apps over the air. Free plan: unlimited uploads, private links, 2-day expiration for guests, 60 days for registered users.
entries.desc_zh: 通过空中分发 iOS & Android 应用。免费计划：无限上传、私密链接、访客 2 天过期、注册用户 60 天过期。

entries.name: Loadly
entries.desc_en: iOS & Android beta apps distribution service offers completely free services with unlimited downloads, high-speed downloads, and unlimited uploads.
entries.desc_zh: iOS & Android 测试应用分发服务提供完全免费的服务，包括无限下载、高速下载和无限上传。

entries.name: DistApp
entries.desc_en: Manage and distribute Android, iOS and Desktop apps. Useful for tester or self distribution. Try it for free with 2 apps, 1 org, 100 MB storage with unlimited downloads, or self-hosted your self.
entries.desc_zh: 管理和分发 Android、iOS 和桌面应用。适用于测试人员或自行分发。免费试用 2 个应用、1 个组织、100 MB 存储空间且无限下载，或自行托管。

entries.name: bitnami.com
entries.desc_en: Deploy prepared apps on IaaS. Management of 1 AWS micro instance free
entries.desc_zh: 在 IaaS 上部署准备好的应用。免费管理 1 个 AWS micro 实例。

entries.name: Esper
entries.desc_en: MDM and MAM for Android Devices with DevOps. One hundred devices free with one user license and 25 MB Application Storage.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Android 设备、支持 DevOps 的 MDM 和 MAM。一个用户许可证可免费管理一百台设备，并提供 25 MB 应用存储空间。

entries.name: jamf.com
entries.desc_en: Device management for iPads, iPhones, and Macs, three devices free
entries.desc_zh: 面向 iPad、iPhone 和 Mac 的设备管理，三台设备免费

entries.name: Miradore
entries.desc_en: Device Management service. Stay up-to-date with your device fleet and secure unlimited devices for free. The free plan offers basic features.
entries.desc_zh: 设备管理服务。随时掌握你的设备群最新状况，并可免费保护不限数量的设备。免费套餐提供基本功能。

entries.name: ploi.io
entries.desc_en: Server management tool to easily manage and deploy your servers & sites. Free for one server.
entries.desc_zh: 服务器管理工具，轻松管理和部署你的服务器与网站。一台服务器免费。

entries.name: runcloud.io
entries.desc_en: Server management focusing mainly on PHP projects. Free for up to 1 server.
entries.desc_zh: 服务器管理，主要专注于 PHP 项目。免费使用最多 1 台服务器。

entries.name: serveravatar.com
entries.desc_en: Manage and monitor PHP-based web servers with automated configurations. Free for one server.
entries.desc_zh: 通过自动化配置管理和监控基于 PHP 的 Web 服务器。一台服务器免费。

entries.name: xcloud.host
entries.desc_en: Server management and deployment platform with a user-friendly interface. Free tier available for one server.
entries.desc_zh: 界面友好的服务器管理和部署平台。一台服务器可使用免费层级。

entries.name: Ably
entries.desc_en: Realtime messaging service with presence, persistence and guaranteed delivery. The free plan includes 3m messages per month, 100 peak connections, and 100 peak channels.
entries.desc_zh: 具有在线状态、持久化和保证投递功能的实时消息服务。免费计划包含每月 300 万条消息、100 个峰值连接和 100 个峰值频道。

entries.name: cloudamqp.com
entries.desc_en: RabbitMQ as a Service. Little Lemur plan: max 1 million messages/month, max 20 concurrent connections, max 100 queues, max 10,000 queued messages, multiple nodes in different AZ's
entries.desc_zh: RabbitMQ 即服务。Little Lemur 计划：每月最多 100 万条消息、最多 20 个并发连接、最多 100 个队列、最多 10,000 条排队消息、不同 AZ 中的多个节点。

entries.name: courier.com
entries.desc_en: Single API for push, in-app, email, chat, SMS, and other messaging channels with template management and other features. The free plan includes 10,000 messages/mo.
entries.desc_zh: 用于推送、应用内、电子邮件、聊天、短信和其他消息渠道的单个 API，具有模板管理和其他功能。免费计划包含每月 10,000 条消息。

entries.name: EMQX Serverless
entries.desc_en: Scalable and secure serverless MQTT broker you can get in seconds. 1M session minutes/month free forever (no credit card required).
entries.desc_zh: 可在几秒钟内获得的可扩展且安全的无服务器 MQTT 代理。永久免费每月 100 万会话分钟数（无需信用卡）。

entries.name: Engage
entries.desc_en: All-in-one Customer Engagement and Automation Tool (email, push, SMS, product tours, banners and more) for SaaS. Free for up to 1,000 active users per month.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于 SaaS 的全功能客户参与和自动化工具（电子邮件、推送、短信、产品导览、横幅等）。免费使用每月最多 1,000 个活跃用户。

entries.name: HiveMQ
entries.desc_en: Connect your MQTT devices to the Cloud Native IoT Messaging Broker.  Free to connect up to 100 devices (no credit card required) forever.
entries.desc_zh: 将您的 MQTT 设备连接到 Cloud Native IoT 消息代理。永久免费连接最多 100 台设备（无需信用卡）。

entries.name: httpSMS
entries.desc_en: Send and receive text messages using your Android phone as an SMS Gateway. Free to send and receive up to 200 messages per month.
entries.desc_zh: 使用您的 Android 手机作为 SMS Gateway 发送和接收短信。每月免费发送和接收最多 200 条消息。

entries.name: knock.app
entries.desc_en: Notifications infrastructure for developers. Send to multiple channels like in-app, email, SMS, Slack, and push with a single API call. The free plan includes 10,000 messages/mo.
entries.desc_zh: 开发者的通知基础设施。通过单个 API 调用即可发送到应用内、电子邮件、短信、Slack 和推送等多个渠道。免费计划包括每月 10,000 条消息。

entries.name: Novu.co
entries.desc_en: The open-source notification infrastructure for developers. Simple components and APIs for managing all communication channels in one place: Email, SMS, Direct, In-App and Push. The free plan includes 30,000 notifications/month with 90 days of retention.
entries.desc_zh: 开发者的开源通知基础设施。简单的组件和 API 可在一个地方管理所有通信渠道：电子邮件、短信、Direct、应用内和推送。免费计划包括每月 30,000 条通知，保留期为 90 天。

entries.name: ntail.io
entries.desc_en: Serverless Apache Kafka streaming service. The free plan includes 200 KiB/s in, 400 KiB/s out, 1-day retention and up to 10 topics. No card required and no time limit.
entries.desc_zh: 无服务器 Apache Kafka 流式服务。免费计划包括 200 KiB/s 输入，400 KiB/s 输出，1 天保留期和最多 10 个主题。无需信用卡且无时间限制。

entries.name: Pingram.io
entries.desc_en: Communication infrastructure in 5 minutes. Free tier includes: 100 SMS and calls, 3000 Emails, Push, Slack, MS Teams, WhatsApp, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 5 分钟内搭建通信基础设施。免费套餐包括：100 条短信和通话，3000 封电子邮件，推送，Slack，MS Teams，WhatsApp 等。

entries.name: Pocket Alert
entries.desc_en: Send push notifications to your iOS and Android devices. Effortlessly integrate via API or Webhooks and maintain full control over your alerts. Free plan: 50 messages per day to 1 device and 1 application.
entries.desc_zh: 向您的 iOS 和 Android 设备发送推送通知。通过 API 或 Webhooks 轻松集成并完全控制您的警报。免费计划：每天 50 条消息发送到 1 个设备和 1 个应用程序。

entries.name: pubnub.com
entries.desc_en: Swift, Kotlin, and React messaging at 1 million transactions each month. Transactions may contain multiple messages.
entries.desc_zh: 每月 100 万笔交易的 Swift、Kotlin 和 React 消息传递。交易可能包含多条消息。

entries.name: pusher.com
entries.desc_en: Realtime messaging service. Free for up to 100 simultaneous connections and 200,000 messages/day
entries.desc_zh: 实时消息服务。免费用于最多 100 个同时连接和每天 200,000 条消息。

entries.name: scaledrone.com
entries.desc_en: Realtime messaging service. Free for up to 20 simultaneous connections and 100,000 events/day
entries.desc_zh: 实时消息服务。免费用于最多 20 个同时连接和每天 100,000 个事件。

entries.name: SMSGate
entries.desc_en: SMS Gateway for Android™ enables sending and receiving SMS messages through your devices using cloud routing. Completely free cloud service (with recommended notification for usage above 10,000 messages/day to maintain quality for all users).
entries.desc_zh: Android™ 短信网关通过使用云路由通过您的设备发送和接收短信。完全免费的云服务（对于每天使用超过 10,000 条消息的情况，建议通知以保持所有用户的质量）。

entries.name: SuprSend
entries.desc_en: SuprSend is a notification infrastructure that streamlines your product notifications with an API-first approach. Create and deliver transactional, crons, and engagement notifications on multiple channels with a single notification API. In free plan you get 10,000 notifications per month, including different workflow nodes such as digests, batches, multi-channels, preferences, tenants, broadcasts and more.
entries.desc_zh: SuprSend 是一种通知基础设施，通过 API 优先的方法简化您的产品通知。使用单个通知 API 即可在多个渠道创建和传递事务性、定时和参与通知。在免费计划中，您每月获得 10,000 条通知，包括不同的工作流节点，如摘要、批处理、多渠道、偏好设置、租户、广播等。

entries.name: synadia.com
entries.desc_en: [NATS.io](https://nats.io) as a service. Global, AWS, GCP, and Azure. Free forever with 4k msg size, 50 active connections, and 5GB of data per month.
entries.desc_zh: [NATS.io](https://nats.io) 作为服务。全球，AWS，GCP 和 Azure。永久免费，包括 4k 消息大小，50 个活跃连接和每月 5GB 数据。

entries.name: webpushr
entries.desc_en: Web Push Notifications - Free for upto 10k subscribers, unlimited push notifications, in-browser messaging
entries.desc_zh: Web 推送通知 - 免费用于最多 10k 订阅者，无限推送通知，浏览器内消息传递。

entries.name: vask
entries.desc_en: Realtime messaging service, Pusher-compatible. Dev tier is limited to local development only and free with 100 concurrent connections, 1,000,000 broadcasts/month, unlimited client events, 32kb message size.
entries.desc_zh: 实时消息服务，兼容 Pusher。开发版仅限于本地开发且免费，包括 100 个并发连接，每月 1,000,000 次广播，无限客户端事件，32kb 消息大小。

entries.name: bugfender.com
entries.desc_en: Free up to 100k log lines/day with 24 hours retention
entries.desc_zh: 免费用于每天最多 100k 日志行，保留期为 24 小时。

entries.name: log.dog
entries.desc_en: LogDog is a remote debugging/logging SDK (iOS and Android) with a web ui. Captures all logs, requests and events in real-time and allows to intercept them. Free for up to 100MB of logs every month
entries.desc_zh: LogDog 是一个带有 Web UI 的远程调试/日志 SDK（iOS 和 Android）。实时捕获所有日志、请求和事件并允许拦截它们。每月免费用于最多 100MB 的日志。

entries.name: logflare.app
entries.desc_en: Free for up to 12,960,000 entries per app per month, 3 days retention
entries.desc_zh: 免费用于每个应用每月最多 12,960,000 条条目，保留期为 3 天。

entries.name: logtail.com
entries.desc_en: ClickHouse-based SQL-compatible log management. Free up to 1 GB per month, three days retention.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 ClickHouse 的兼容 SQL 的日志管理。每月最多 1 GB 免费，保留三天。

entries.name: logzab.com
entries.desc_en: Audit trail management system. Free 1,000 user activity logs per month, 1-month retention, for up to 5 projects.
entries.desc_zh: 审计跟踪管理系统。每月免费 1,000 条用户活动日志，1 个月保留期，最多 5 个项目。

entries.name: ManageEngine Log360 Cloud
entries.desc_en: Log Management service powered by Manage Engine. Free Plan offers 50 GB storage with 15 days Storage Retention and 7 days search.
entries.desc_zh: 由 Manage Engine 提供支持的日志管理服务。免费计划提供 50 GB 存储，15 天存储保留期和 7 天搜索。

entries.name: openobserve.ai
entries.desc_en: 200 GB Ingestion/month free, 15 Days Retention
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费 200 GB 数据摄入，15 天保留期

entries.name: Smart Grow Logs
entries.desc_en: Centralized log management platform with end-to-end encryption, real-time alerts, and multi-platform SDKs. Free tier includes up to 3.000 logs per day.
entries.desc_zh: 具有端到端加密、实时警报和多平台 SDK 的集中式日志管理平台。免费层级包含每天最多 3.000 条日志。

entries.name: AutoLocalise.com
entries.desc_en: Instantly localize without managing translation files. Free for up to 10,000 characters/month, unlimited languages.
entries.desc_zh: 无需管理翻译文件即可即时本地化。每月免费 10,000 字符，无限语言。

entries.name: crowdin.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited projects, unlimited strings, and collaborators for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 为 Open Source 提供不限数量的项目、字符串和协作者

entries.name: Free PO editor
entries.desc_en: Free for everybody
entries.desc_zh: 对所有人免费

entries.name: Lingo.dev
entries.desc_en: Open-source AI-powered CLI for web & mobile localization. Bring your own LLM, or use 10,000 free words every month via Lingo.dev-managed localization engine.
entries.desc_zh: 用于 Web 和移动端本地化的开源 AI 驱动 CLI。自带 LLM，或通过 Lingo.dev 托管的本地化引擎每月使用 10,000 个免费单词。

entries.name: lingohub.com
entries.desc_en: Free up to 3 users, always free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 免费最多 3 个用户，开源项目永久免费

entries.name: Localhero.ai
entries.desc_en: Automatic on-brand translations on every pull request, with glossary and translation memory. Free for 1 project, 250 translation credits/month (~4,000 words).
entries.desc_zh: 每次拉取请求时自动进行品牌化翻译，附带词汇表和翻译记忆库。免费 1 个项目，每月 250 个翻译积分（约 4,000 字）。

entries.name: localazy.com
entries.desc_en: Free for 1000 source language strings, unlimited languages, unlimited contributors, startup and open source deals
entries.desc_zh: 免费 1000 个源语言字符串，无限语言，无限贡献者，初创公司和开源优惠

entries.name: Localit
entries.desc_en: Fast, developer-friendly localization platform with seamless and free GitHub/GitLab integration, AI-assisted and manual translations, and a generous free plan (includes 2 users, 500 keys, and unlimited projects).
entries.desc_zh: 快速、开发者友好的本地化平台，具有无缝且免费的 GitHub/GitLab 集成、AI 辅助和手动翻译，以及慷慨的免费计划（包含 2 个用户、500 个密钥和无限项目）。

entries.name: localizely.com
entries.desc_en: Free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 开源项目免费

entries.name: Loco
entries.desc_en: Free up to 2000 translations, Unlimited translators, ten languages/project, 1000 translatable assets/project
entries.desc_zh: 最多 2000 条翻译免费，翻译者数量不限，每个项目十种语言，每个项目 1000 个可翻译资产

entries.name: POEditor
entries.desc_en: Free up to 1000 strings
entries.desc_zh: 免费最多 1000 个字符串

entries.name: SimpleLocalize
entries.desc_en: Free up to 100 translation keys, unlimited strings, unlimited languages, startup deals
entries.desc_zh: 免费最多 100 个翻译密钥，无限字符串，无限语言，初创公司优惠

entries.name: Texterify
entries.desc_en: Free for a single user
entries.desc_zh: 单个用户免费

entries.name: Tolgee
entries.desc_en: Free SaaS offering with limited translations, forever-free self-hosted version
entries.desc_zh: 免费翻译数量有限的 SaaS 提供商，以及永久免费的自行托管版本

entries.name: transifex.com
entries.desc_en: Free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 开源项目免费

entries.name: Pingzo
entries.desc_en: Free tier offers 1 uptime/API monitor with 15-minute check intervals and instant email alerts.
entries.desc_zh: 免费层级提供 1 个正常运行时间/API 监控器，15 分钟检查间隔和即时邮件警报。

entries.name: Accesserty Pulse
entries.desc_en: Accesserty Pulse monitors interaction signals and detectable accessibility risks on live websites. Free plans for everyone and 14-day Pro trial.
entries.desc_zh: Accesserty Pulse 监控实时网站上的交互信号和可检测的无障碍风险。人人免费计划，以及 14 天专业版试用。

entries.name: AlertKick
entries.desc_en: server security (eBPF agent for Linux), uptime monitoring, on-call alerting/status pages in one product. Free tier includes 10 uptime monitors and heartbeats, 5-minute check intervals, 7-day retention.
entries.desc_zh: 服务器安全（Linux eBPF 代理）、正常运行时间监控、值班警报/状态页集成在一个产品中。免费层级包含 10 个正常运行时间监控器和心跳，5 分钟检查间隔，7 天保留期。

entries.name: assertible.com
entries.desc_en: Automated API testing and monitoring. Free plans for teams and individuals.
entries.desc_zh: 自动化 API 测试和监控。团队和个人免费计划。

entries.name: Better Stack
entries.desc_en: Uptime monitoring, incident management, on-call scheduling/alerting, and status pages in a single product. The free plan includes ten monitors with 3-minute check frequency and status pages.
entries.desc_zh: 一款产品集在线状态监控、事件管理、值班排班/告警和状态页于一体。免费套餐包含十个监控项，检查频率为 3 分钟，并附带状态页。

entries.name: bleemeo.com
entries.desc_en: Free for 3 servers, 5 uptime monitors, unlimited users, unlimited dashboards, unlimited alerting rules.
entries.desc_zh: 免费使用 3 台服务器、5 个正常运行时间监控、无限用户、无限仪表板和无限告警规则。

entries.name: checklyhq.com
entries.desc_en: Open source E2E / Synthetic monitoring and deep API monitoring for developers. Free plan with one user and 10k API & network / 1.5k browser check runs.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的开源 E2E / 拨测监控和深度 API 监控。免费套餐包含一个用户，以及 10,000 次 API 与网络 / 1,500 次浏览器检查运行。

entries.name: Core Web Vitals History
entries.desc_en: Find Core Web Vitals history for a url or a website.
entries.desc_zh: 查询某个 URL 或网站的 Core Web Vitals 历史记录。

entries.name: cronalive.com
entries.desc_en: Heartbeat monitoring for cron jobs, plus HTTP uptime and TLS expiry checks, and a Laravel package that creates checks from your scheduler. Free tier with 10 checks, HTTP interval from 5 min, 30 days of history, 50k pings/mo.
entries.desc_zh: 定时任务的心跳监控，以及 HTTP 正常运行时间检查和 TLS 过期检查，还有一个从调度器创建检查的 Laravel 包。免费层级包含 10 个检查，HTTP 间隔从 5 分钟开始，30 天历史记录，50k pings/月。

entries.name: cronitor.io
entries.desc_en: Performance insights and uptime monitoring for cron jobs, websites, APIs and more. A free tier with five monitors.
entries.desc_zh: 为 cron 作业、网站、API 等提供性能洞察和在线状态监控。免费层级包含五个监控项。

entries.name: watchcron.com
entries.desc_en: Cron job monitoring with heartbeat pings and alerts. Free tier with up to 5 monitors and email notifications.
entries.desc_zh: 带有心跳 ping 和告警的定时任务监控。免费层级最多包含 5 个监控器和邮件通知。

entries.name: datadoghq.com
entries.desc_en: Free for up to 5 nodes
entries.desc_zh: 免费使用最多 5 个节点

entries.name: DeadBro
entries.desc_en: Rails APM with request-based pricing: live traces, slow SQL, N+1 detection, and error tracking. Free forever for 50k requests/month, 7-day retention, 1 app, 1 uptime check, and email alerts. No credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: Rails APM，基于请求的定价：实时追踪、慢速 SQL、N+1 检测和错误追踪。永久免费使用 50k 请求/月、7 天保留期、1 个应用、1 个正常运行时间检查和邮件告警。无需信用卡。

entries.name: deadmanssnitch.com
entries.desc_en: Monitoring for cron jobs. One free snitch (monitor), more if you refer others to sign up
entries.desc_zh: 定时任务监控。一个免费告警器（监控器），如果推荐他人注册，可以获得更多。

entries.name: downtimemonkey.com
entries.desc_en: 60 uptime monitors, 5-minute interval. Email, Slack alerts.
entries.desc_zh: 60 个正常运行时间监控，5 分钟间隔。邮件、Slack 告警。

entries.name: drumbeats.io
entries.desc_en: Cron, heartbeat, and uptime monitoring with incident management and status pages. Free for up to 50 monitors with 1-min interval and unlimited team seats.
entries.desc_zh: 带有事件管理和状态页的定时任务、心跳和正常运行时间监控。免费使用最多 50 个监控器，1 分钟间隔和无限团队席位。

entries.name: economize.cloud
entries.desc_en: Economize helps demystify cloud infrastructure costs by organizing cloud resources to optimize and report the same. Free for up to $5,000 spent on Google Cloud Platform every month.
entries.desc_zh: Economize 通过整理云资源来优化和报告成本，帮助阐明云基础设施成本。免费使用每月在 Google Cloud Platform 上花费的最多 $5,000。

entries.name: fivenines.io
entries.desc_en: Linux server monitoring with real‑time dashboards and alerting - free forever for up to 5 monitored servers at 60-seconds interval. No credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 带有实时仪表板和告警的 Linux 服务器监控——免费永久使用最多 5 台监控服务器，间隔为 60 秒。无需信用卡。

entries.name: FlareWarden
entries.desc_en: Uptime, content, dependency, and SSL monitoring with multi-region verification and status pages. Free plan includes 15 monitors, 5-minute checks, and 90 days of history.
entries.desc_zh: 带有多区域验证和状态页的正常运行时间、内容、依赖和 SSL 监控。免费计划包含 15 个监控器、5 分钟检查和 90 天历史记录。

entries.name: Grafana Cloud
entries.desc_en: Grafana Cloud is a composable observability platform that integrates metrics and logs with Grafana. Free: 3 users, ten dashboards, 100 alerts, metrics storage in Prometheus and Graphite (10,000 series, 14 days retention), logs storage in Loki (50 GB of logs, 14 days retention)
entries.desc_zh: Grafana Cloud 是一个可组合的可观测性平台，通过 Grafana 整合指标和日志。免费：3 个用户、十个仪表板、100 个告警，Prometheus 和 Graphite 指标存储（10,000 条序列，保留 14 天），Loki 日志存储（50 GB 日志，保留 14 天）

entries.name: healthchecks.io
entries.desc_en: Monitor your cron jobs and background tasks. Free for up to 20 checks.
entries.desc_zh: 监控您的定时任务和后台任务。免费使用最多 20 次检查。

entries.name: incidenthub.cloud
entries.desc_en: Cloud and SaaS status page aggregator - 20 monitors and 2 notification channels (Slack and Discord) are free forever.
entries.desc_zh: 云和 SaaS 状态页聚合器——20 个监控器和 2 个通知渠道（Slack 和 Discord）永久免费。

entries.name: inspector.dev
entries.desc_en: A complete Real-Time monitoring dashboard in less than one minute with a free forever tier.
entries.desc_zh: 在不到一分钟内创建完整的实时监控仪表板，带有永久免费的层级。

entries.name: instatus.com
entries.desc_en: Get a beautiful status page in 10 seconds. Free forever with unlimited subs and unlimited teams.
entries.desc_zh: 在 10 秒内获得一个漂亮的状态页。永久免费，无限订阅和无限团队。

entries.name: isitdownstatus.com
entries.desc_en: Free public JSON API returning real-time status for 500+ popular services (GitHub, Stripe, AWS, etc.). No auth required, CORS enabled.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的公开 JSON API，返回 500 多个热门服务（GitHub、Stripe、AWS 等）的实时状态。无需身份验证，已启用 CORS。

entries.name: LastPing
entries.desc_en: Dead man's switch for AI agents, cron jobs and CI. Free for individuals with unlimited monitors and destinations. Let AI agents build monitoring for everything including themselves.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 AI agents、cron 作业和 CI 的死人开关（Dead man's switch）。个人用户免费，监控器和通知目的地数量不限。让 AI agents 为包括它们自身在内的一切构建监控。

entries.name: linkok.com
entries.desc_en: Online broken link checker, free for small websites up to 100 pages, completely free for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 在线失效链接检查工具，最多 100 个页面的小型网站可免费使用，开源项目则完全免费。

entries.name: loader.io
entries.desc_en: Free load testing tools with limitations
entries.desc_zh: 有限制的免费负载测试工具

entries.name: MarionetteOps.com
entries.desc_en: Server monitoring, public status pages, and service uptime monitoring.
entries.desc_zh: 服务器监控、公开状态页面以及服务正常运行时间监控。

entries.name: Middleware.io
entries.desc_en: Middleware observability platform provides complete visibility into your apps & stack, so you can monitor & diagnose issues at scale. They have a free forever plan for Dev community use that allows Log monitoring for up to 1M log events, Infrastructure monitoring & APM for up to 2 hosts.
entries.desc_zh: Middleware 可观测性平台可让你对自己的应用与技术栈获得完整的可见性，从而能够大规模地监控和诊断问题。他们为 Dev 社区使用提供永久免费计划，支持最多 100 万条日志事件的日志监控，以及最多 2 台主机的基础设施监控与 APM。

entries.name: Monitorable
entries.desc_en: Server health monitoring for Linux (bare metal, VMs, LXC): host and Docker metrics, systemd services and SMART disk health, with alerting, OpenTelemetry Collector agent. Free for 3 servers, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: Linux（裸金属、虚拟机、LXC）服务器健康监控：主机和 Docker 指标、systemd 服务和 SMART 磁盘健康，支持告警、OpenTelemetry Collector 代理。3 台服务器免费，无需信用卡。

entries.name: MonitorMonk
entries.desc_en: Minimalist uptime monitoring with beautiful status pages. The Forever Free plan offers HTTPS, Keyword, SSL and Response-time monitorming for 10 websites or api-endpoints, and provides 2 dashboards/status pages.
entries.desc_zh: 极简的在线状态监控，配有精美的状态页。Forever Free 计划为 10 个网站或 API 端点提供 HTTPS、关键字、SSL 和响应时间监控，并提供 2 个仪表盘/状态页。

entries.name: netdata.cloud
entries.desc_en: Netdata is an open-source tool to collect real-time metrics. It's a growing product and can also be found on GitHub!
entries.desc_zh: Netdata 是一款用于收集实时指标的开源工具。它是一款持续成长的产品，在 GitHub 上也可以找到它！

entries.name: newrelic.com
entries.desc_en: New Relic observability platform built to help engineers create more perfect software. From monoliths to serverless, you can instrument everything and then analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize your entire software stack. The free tier offers 100GB/month of free data ingest, one free full-access user, and unlimited free primary users.
entries.desc_zh: New Relic 可观测性平台旨在帮助工程师创建更完美的软件。从单体架构到无服务器架构，您可以检测一切，然后分析、排查和优化整个软件堆栈。免费层每月提供 100GB 的免费数据摄取、一个免费的全访问用户和无限免费的主要用户。

entries.name: OnlineOrNot.com
entries.desc_en: OnlineOrNot provides uptime monitoring for websites and APIs, monitoring for cron jobs and scheduled tasks. Also provides status pages. The first five checks with a 3-minute interval are free. The free tier sends alerts via Slack, Discord, and Email.
entries.desc_zh: OnlineOrNot 为网站和 API 提供可用性监控，以及对 cron 任务和定时任务的监控，同时还提供状态页。前五个以 3 分钟为间隔的检查项免费。免费套餐可通过 Slack、Discord 和电子邮件发送警报。

entries.name: OntarioNet.ca CN Test
entries.desc_en: Check if a website is blocked in China by the Great Firewall. It identifies DNS pollution by comparing DNS results and ASN information detected by servers in China versus servers in the United States.
entries.desc_zh: 检测网站在中国大陆是否被防火墙屏蔽：对比中国大陆与美国服务器返回的 DNS 结果与 ASN 信息，识别 DNS 污染。

entries.name: OpenUptime
entries.desc_en: Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.
entries.desc_zh: 托管正常运行时间监控和状态页。免费层级包含 3 个活跃监控器，检查间隔为 5 分钟，每月 26,000 次检查和 100 封邮件，以及 30 天的检查历史记录。

entries.name: pagecrawl.io
entries.desc_en: Monitor website changes, free for up to 6 monitors with daily checks.
entries.desc_zh: 监控网站变化，免费提供最多 6 个监控项，每日检查。

entries.name: pagertree.com
entries.desc_en: Simple interface for alerting and on-call management. Free up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 简洁的告警和值班管理界面。最多 5 名用户免费。

entries.name: phare.io
entries.desc_en: Uptime Monitoring free for up to 100,000 events for unlimited projects and unlimited status pages.
entries.desc_zh: Uptime Monitoring 免费，最多 100,000 个事件，支持不限数量的项目和状态页。

entries.name: pingbreak.com
entries.desc_en: Modern uptime monitoring service. Check unlimited URLs and get downtime notifications via Discord, Slack, or email.
entries.desc_zh: 现代化的在线率监控服务。可监控不限数量的 URL，并通过 Discord、Slack 或电子邮件接收宕机通知。

entries.name: Pingmeter.com
entries.desc_en: 5 uptime monitors with 10-minute interval. Monitor SSH, HTTP, HTTPS, and any custom TCP ports.
entries.desc_zh: 5 个在线率监控项，间隔 10 分钟。可监控 SSH、HTTP、HTTPS 以及任何自定义 TCP 端口。

entries.name: pingpong.one
entries.desc_en: Advanced status page platform with monitoring. The free tier includes one public customizable status page with an SSL subdomain. Pro plan is offered to open-source projects and non-profits free of charge.
entries.desc_zh: 带监控功能的先进状态页平台。免费套餐包含一个可自定义的公开状态页，附带 SSL 子域名。Pro 计划向开源项目和非营利组织免费提供。

entries.name: Prismix
entries.desc_en: Free REST API (GET /api/v1/statuses) returning real-time operational status for 75+ AI services including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, and more. No authentication required. [Free tier available with Pro at $10/month]
entries.desc_zh: 免费 REST API（GET /api/v1/statuses），返回 75+ 个 AI 服务（包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Mistral 等）的实时运行状态。无需身份验证。[可搭配 $10/月的 Pro 使用免费套餐]

entries.name: Pulsetic
entries.desc_en: 10 monitors, 6 Months of historical Uptime/Logs, unlimited status pages, and custom domains included! For infinite time and unlimited email alerts for free. You don't need a credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 包含 10 个监控项、6 个月的历史 Uptime/日志、不限数量的状态页以及自定义域名！无限期免费且邮件告警不限量。无需信用卡。

entries.name: Relvato
entries.desc_en: Continuous website monitoring - Relvato rechecks all your site vitals (performance, critical user journeys, visual design, security, SEO, legal compliance, accessibility etc) after every code update. Free for one site, no card needed. MCP also available.
entries.desc_zh: 持续网站监控 - Relvato 会在每次代码更新后重新检查你网站的所有关键指标（性能、关键用户路径、视觉设计、安全性、SEO、法律合规、无障碍等）。单个网站免费，无需银行卡。也提供 MCP 支持。

entries.name: robusta.dev
entries.desc_en: Powerful Kubernetes monitoring based on Prometheus. Bring your own Prometheus or install the all-in-one bundle. The free tier includes up to 20 Kubernetes nodes. Alerts via Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and more. Integrations with PagerDuty, OpsGenie, VictorOps, DataDog, and many other tools.
entries.desc_zh: 基于Prometheus的强大Kubernetes监控。自带Prometheus或安装一体化套件。免费层级包含最多20个Kubernetes节点。通过Slack、Microsoft Teams、Discord等发送警报。与PagerDuty、OpsGenie、VictorOps、DataDog及许多其他工具集成。

entries.name: Runframe
entries.desc_en: On-call alerting, incident management, and public/private status pages. The free plan includes up to 5 users, 1 team, 1 on-call schedule, basic status pages, incident lifecycle, and Slack-native incident response.
entries.desc_zh: 值班警报、事件管理和公共/私有状态页。免费计划包含最多5个用户、1个团队、1个值班排程、基础状态页、事件生命周期和Slack原生事件响应。

entries.name: Servervana
entries.desc_en: Advanced uptime monitoring with support for large projects and teams. Provides HTTP monitoring, Browser based monitoring, DNS monitoring, domain monitoring, status pages and more. The free tier includes 10 HTTP monitors, 1 DNS monitor and one status page.
entries.desc_zh: 先进的在线率监控，支持大型项目和团队。提供 HTTP 监控、基于浏览器的监控、DNS 监控、域名监控、状态页等。免费套餐包含 10 个 HTTP 监控项、1 个 DNS 监控项和一个状态页。

entries.name: Simple Observability
entries.desc_en: Powerful server monitoring in a unified platform for metrics and logs, with no setup complexity. Free for one server.
entries.desc_zh: 强大的服务器监控，在统一平台中整合指标与日志，无复杂的设置。单台服务器免费。

entries.name: sitesure.net
entries.desc_en: Website and cron monitoring - 2 monitors free
entries.desc_zh: 网站和Cron监控 - 2个监控器免费

entries.name: skylight.io
entries.desc_en: Free for first 100,000 requests (Rails only)
entries.desc_zh: 前100,000次请求免费（仅限Rails）

entries.name: statuscake.com
entries.desc_en: Website monitoring, unlimited tests free with limitations
entries.desc_zh: 网站监控，无限次测试免费（含一定限制）

entries.name: statusgator.com
entries.desc_en: Status page monitoring, 3 monitors free
entries.desc_zh: 状态页监控，3个监控器免费

entries.name: supaguard.app
entries.desc_en: Synthetic monitoring from 20+ global regions. The free tier includes 1,000 browser checks/mo with AI-driven self-healing and automated test generation.
entries.desc_zh: 来自20+全球区域的合成监控。免费层级包含每月1,000次浏览器检查，具有AI驱动的自愈和自动化测试生成。

entries.name: superlog.sh
entries.desc_en: Open-source OpenTelemetry observability (traces, logs, and metrics) with AI-agent incident investigation. The free tier includes 1M spans, 5M logs, and 10M metric points per month with 30-day retention, no credit card required. Fully open-source and self-hostable.
entries.desc_zh: 开源OpenTelemetry可观测性（追踪、日志和指标），具有AI代理事件调查。免费层级包含每月100万追踪、500万日志和1000万指标点，保留30天，无需信用卡。完全开源且可自托管。

entries.name: SweetUptime
entries.desc_en: Server monitoring, uptime monitoring, DNS & domain monitoring. Monitor 10 server, 10 uptime, and 10 domain for free.
entries.desc_zh: 服务器监控、正常运行时间监控、DNS和域名监控。免费监控10个服务器、10个正常运行时间和10个域名。

entries.name: syagent.com
entries.desc_en: Noncommercial free server monitoring service, alerts and metrics.
entries.desc_zh: 面向非商业用途的免费服务器监控服务，包含告警和指标。

entries.name: UptimeObserver.com
entries.desc_en: Get 20 uptime monitors with 5-minute intervals and a customizable status page-even for commercial use. Enjoy unlimited, real-time notifications via email and Telegram. No credit card needed to get started.
entries.desc_zh: 获取20个正常运行时间监控器，间隔5分钟，以及可自定义的状态页——即使是商业用途。享受通过电子邮件和Telegram的无限实时通知。无需信用卡即可开始。

entries.name: uptimetoolbox.com
entries.desc_en: Free monitoring for five websites, 3-minute intervals, public statuspage.
entries.desc_zh: 五个网站的免费监控，3分钟间隔，公开状态页面。

entries.name: Wachete
entries.desc_en: monitor five pages, checks every 24 hours.
entries.desc_zh: 监控五个页面，每24小时检查一次。

entries.name: Watchgoose
entries.desc_en: Cron job and heartbeat monitoring and status pages for scheduled tasks, backups and background jobs, MCP server available. Free tier: 10 checks, 200 ping log entries, email/chat/webhook alerts, no credit card. Open Source support program for qualifying OS projects.
entries.desc_zh: 定时任务、备份和后台作业的Cron作业和心跳监控及状态页，提供MCP服务器。免费层级：10次检查，200个ping日志条目，电子邮件/聊天/网络钩子警报，无需信用卡。符合资格的开源项目的开源支持计划。

entries.name: Xitoring.com
entries.desc_en: Uptime monitoring: 20 free, Linux and Windows Server monitoring: 5 free, Status page: 1 free - Mobile app, multiple notification channel, and much more!
entries.desc_zh: 正常运行时间监控：20个免费，Linux和Windows服务器监控：5个免费，状态页：1个免费 - 移动应用、多种通知渠道和更多！

entries.name: UptimeRobot
entries.desc_en: Free uptime monitoring for hobby projects. Includes 50 monitors with 5-minute check intervals, supports HTTP, ping, port, and keyword monitoring.
entries.desc_zh: 爱好项目免费正常运行时间监控。包含50个监控器，5分钟检查间隔，支持HTTP、ping、端口和关键词监控。

entries.name: Axiom
entries.desc_en: Store up to 0.5 TB of logs with 30-day retention. Includes integrations with platforms like Vercel and advanced data querying with email/Discord notifiers.
entries.desc_zh: 存储0.5 TB的日志，保留30天。包含与Vercel等平台的集成，以及使用电子邮件/Discord通知器的高级数据查询。

entries.name: Bugsink
entries.desc_en: Error-tracking with Sentry-SDK compatibility. Free for up to 5,000 errors/month, or unlimited use when self-hosted.
entries.desc_zh: 具有Sentry-SDK兼容性的错误追踪。每月最多5,000个错误免费，或自托管时无限使用。

entries.name: bugsnag.com
entries.desc_en: Free for up to 2,000 errors/month after the initial trial
entries.desc_zh: 完成初始试用后，每月最多 2,000 个错误免费

entries.name: CatchJS.com
entries.desc_en: JavaScript error tracking with screenshots and click trails. Free for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 带截图和点击轨迹的 JavaScript 错误追踪。对开源项目免费。

entries.name: elmah.io
entries.desc_en: Error logging and uptime monitoring for web developers. Free Small Business subscription for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web 开发者的错误日志和在线率监控。为开源项目提供免费的 Small Business 订阅。

entries.name: Embrace
entries.desc_en: Mobile app monitoring. Free for small teams with up to 1 million user sessions per year.
entries.desc_zh: 移动应用监控。小型团队免费，每年最多 100 万用户会话。

entries.name: Everframe
entries.desc_en: Everframe is bug tracking, crash collection tool with AI triage, reporter conversations and boards all in one platform - for mobile, web, TV and Roku apps. Free tier includes 1000 monthly active installs with unlimited bug and crash reports, unlimited apps and seats, every SDK and AI triage on 50 reports per month.
entries.desc_zh: Everframe 是一款 bug 追踪与崩溃收集工具，在一个平台上集成了 AI 分诊、报告者对话和看板 - 适用于移动、Web、TV 和 Roku 应用。免费套餐包含每月 1000 个活跃安装，bug 和崩溃报告不限量，应用和席位不限量，涵盖所有 SDK，以及每月 50 份报告的 AI 分诊。

entries.name: exceptionless
entries.desc_en: Real-time error, feature, log reporting, and more. Free for 3k events per month/1 user. Open source and easy to self-host for unlimited use.
entries.desc_zh: 实时错误、功能、日志报告等。每月 3k 事件/1 名用户免费。开源且易于自托管，可无限量使用。

entries.name: GlitchTip
entries.desc_en: Simple, open-source error tracking. Compatible with open-source Sentry SDKs. 1000 events per month for free, or can self-host with no limits
entries.desc_zh: 简单的开源错误追踪。与开源 Sentry SDK 兼容。每月免费 1000 个事件，或可自托管且无限制

entries.name: honeybadger.io
entries.desc_en: Exception, uptime, and cron monitoring. Free for small teams and open-source projects (12,000 errors/month).
entries.desc_zh: 异常、在线率和 cron 监控。小型团队和开源项目免费（每月 12,000 个错误）。

entries.name: Jam
entries.desc_en: Developer friendly bug reports in one click. Free plan with unlimited jams.
entries.desc_zh: 开发者友好的 一键 bug 报告。免费计划包含不限量的 jams。

entries.name: memfault.com
entries.desc_en: Cloud device observability and debugging platform. 100 devices free for [Nordic](https://app.memfault.com/register-nordic), [NXP](https://app.memfault.com/register-nxp), and [Laird](https://app.memfault.com/register-laird) devices.
entries.desc_zh: 云设备可观测性和调试平台。[Nordic](https://app.memfault.com/register-nordic)、[NXP](https://app.memfault.com/register-nxp) 和 [Laird](https://app.memfault.com/register-laird) 设备可免费使用 100 台设备。

entries.name: rollbar.com
entries.desc_en: Exception and error monitoring, free plan with 5,000 errors/month, unlimited users, 30 days retention
entries.desc_zh: 异常和错误监控，免费计划包含每月 5,000 个错误、不限用户数、30 天数据保留

entries.name: Semaphr
entries.desc_en: Free all-in-one kill switch for your mobile apps.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的移动应用提供的免费一体化 kill switch。

entries.name: sentry.io
entries.desc_en: Sentry tracks app exceptions in real-time and has a small free plan. Free for 5k errors per month/ 1 user, unrestricted use if self-hosted
entries.desc_zh: Sentry 实时追踪应用异常，并提供小规模的免费计划。每月 5k 错误/1 名用户免费，自托管则不受使用限制

entries.name: Vinktar
entries.desc_en: Error tracking and product analytics in one tool, set up and queried by your coding agent over MCP. Free for 1M events and 50k errors per month, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 一个工具同时提供错误追踪和产品分析，可由你的编码代理通过 MCP 进行设置和查询。每月 100 万事件和 5 万错误免费，无需银行卡。

entries.name: Whitespace
entries.desc_en: One-click bug reports straight in your browser. Free plan with unlimited recordings for personal use.
entries.desc_zh: 直接在浏览器中一键提交 bug 报告。免费计划提供不限量录制，供个人使用。

entries.name: algolia.com
entries.desc_en: Hosted search solution with typo-tolerance, relevance, and UI libraries to easily create search experiences. The free "Build" plan includes 1M documents and 10K searches/month. Also offers [developer documentation search](https://docsearch.algolia.com/) for free.
entries.desc_zh: 托管搜索解决方案，具备拼写容错、相关性和 UI 库，可轻松创建搜索体验。免费的 “Build” 计划包含 100 万文档和每月 1 万次搜索。还免费提供 [developer documentation search](https://docsearch.algolia.com/)。

entries.name: bonsai.io
entries.desc_en: Free 1 GB memory and 1 GB storage
entries.desc_zh: 免费 1 GB 内存和 1 GB 存储

entries.name: CommandBar
entries.desc_en: Unified Search Bar as-a-service, web-based UI widget/plugin that allows your users to search contents, navigations, features, etc. within your product, which helps discoverability. Free for up to 1,000 Monthly Active Users, unlimited commands.
entries.desc_zh: 统一搜索栏即服务，基于 Web 的 UI 小组件/插件，让你的用户可以在产品内搜索内容、导航、功能等，提升可发现性。最多 1,000 名月活跃用户免费，命令不限量。

entries.name: searchly.com
entries.desc_en: Free 2 indices and 20 MB storage
entries.desc_zh: 免费 2 个索引和 20 MB 存储

entries.name: BylineCV
entries.desc_en: Form-based CV and cover letter builder to pass ATS filters and organize all your versions in one place. Free forever for core CV building, exports, and storage, with daily AI limits.
entries.desc_zh: 基于表单的简历和求职信构建器，可通过 ATS 过滤器并集中管理所有版本。核心简历构建、导出和存储永久免费，但有每日 AI 限制。

entries.name: Cisco Networking Academy, Skills for All
entries.desc_en: Offers free certification-aligned courses in topics like cybersecurity, networking, and Python.
entries.desc_zh: 提供与认证对齐的免费课程，主题涵盖网络安全、计算机网络和 Python 等。

entries.name: CloudCertPrep
entries.desc_en: Free, open-source AWS certification practice exams with 1,050+ questions for CLF-C02. Features timed mock exams, domain practice, spaced repetition, and progress tracking.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的开源 AWS 认证练习考试，针对 CLF-C02 提供 1,050+ 道题目。功能包括限时模拟考试、领域专项练习、间隔重复和进度追踪。

entries.name: CodeTrain
entries.desc_en: AI coding tutor that teaches you on your own codebase and never writes the code for you. Free tier: 10 in-browser lessons/month, Python/JS run client-side, no card required.
