entries.desc_zh: AI 编程导师，在你自己的代码库上教学，从不替你写代码。免费套餐：每月 10 节浏览器内课程，Python/JS 在客户端运行，无需银行卡。

entries.name: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
entries.desc_en: Free short courses from industry-leading experts to get hands-on experience with the latest generative AI tools and techniques in an hour or less.
entries.desc_zh: 由行业顶尖专家提供的免费短期课程，让你在一小时或更短时间内动手体验最新的生成式 AI 工具和技术。

entries.name: DevOpsLesson
entries.desc_en: Free DevOps tutorials, cheatsheets, troubleshooting guides, roadmaps, interview preparation and DevOps tools: Dockerfile Linter, K8S YAML file generator, Regex Tester.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 DevOps 教程、速查表、故障排查指南、路线图、面试准备以及 DevOps 工具：Dockerfile Linter、K8S YAML 文件生成器、Regex Tester。

entries.name: DevNet Academy
entries.desc_en: Free, self-paced training for the Cisco DevNet Expert / CCIE Automation certification. Covers Python Click and Flask-RESTx.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Cisco DevNet Expert / CCIE Automation 认证的免费自学培训。涵盖 Python Click 和 Flask-RESTx。

entries.name: Django-tutorial.dev
entries.desc_en: Free online guides for learning Django as their first framework & gives free dofollow backlink to articles written by users.
entries.desc_zh: 免费在线指南，帮助将 Django 作为第一个框架来学习，并为用户撰写的文章提供免费的 dofollow 反向链接。

entries.name: edX
entries.desc_en: Offers access to over 4,000 free online courses from 250 leading institutions, including Harvard and MIT, specializing in computer science, engineering, and data science.
entries.desc_zh: 提供来自 250 所顶尖机构（包括 Harvard 和 MIT）的 4000 多门免费在线课程，专注于计算机科学、工程和数据科学。

entries.name: Exercism
entries.desc_en: Free, open-source programming education in over 75 programming languages, with human mentoring. A nonprofit organisation.
entries.desc_zh: 提供超过 75 种编程语言的免费开源编程教育，并配有人工辅导。这是一个非营利组织。

entries.name: Free Professional Resume Templates & Editor
entries.desc_en: Free platform with lots of Resume templates of Experienced Professionals, ready to clone and edit fully and download, ATS optimized.
entries.desc_zh: 免费平台，提供大量经验丰富的专业人士的简历模板，可完整克隆、编辑并下载，已针对 ATS 优化。

entries.name: FreeCodeCamp
entries.desc_en: Open-source platform offering free courses and certifications in Data Analysis, Information Security, Web Development, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 开源平台，提供数据分析、信息安全、Web 开发等领域的免费课程和认证。

entries.name: Full Stack Open
entries.desc_en: Free university-level course on modern web development with React, Node.js, GraphQL, TypeScript, and more. Fully online and self-paced.
entries.desc_zh: 关于现代 Web 开发的免费大学级课程，内容涵盖 React、Node.js、GraphQL、TypeScript 等。完全在线，可按自己的节奏学习。

entries.name: Interactive CV
entries.desc_en: AI-powered resume builder with real-time editing and ATS optimization. Free tier includes automatic CV conversion to premium templates (Harvard, Europass), PDF export, job tracker with unlimited job posting insights and CV sharing with chat/voice features.
entries.desc_zh: AI 驱动的简历构建工具，支持实时编辑和 ATS 优化。免费层包括自动将简历转换为高级模板（Harvard、Europass）、PDF 导出、带无限职位发布洞察的求职追踪器，以及支持聊天/语音功能的简历分享。

entries.name: Khan Academy
entries.desc_en: Free online guides for learning basic and advanced HTML/CSS, JavaScript and SQL.
entries.desc_zh: 学习基础和进阶 HTML/CSS、JavaScript 和 SQL 的免费在线指南。

entries.name: LabEx
entries.desc_en: Develop skills in Linux, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Programming, Data Science, and more through interactive labs and real-world projects.
entries.desc_zh: 通过交互式实验和真实项目，培养 Linux、DevOps、网络安全、编程、数据科学等领域的技能。

entries.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
entries.desc_en: MIT OpenCourseWare is an online publication of materials from over 2,500 MIT courses, freely sharing knowledge with learners and educators around the world. Youtube channel can be found at [@mitocw](https://www.youtube.com/@mitocw/featured)
entries.desc_zh: MIT OpenCourseWare 是一个在线发布平台，收录了 2500 多门 MIT 课程的资料，免费向世界各地的学习者与教育者分享知识。YouTube 频道请见 [@mitocw](https://www.youtube.com/@mitocw/featured)

entries.name: Reactive Resume
entries.desc_en: Free, open-source resume builder with dozens of templates. Exports to PDF, DOCX and also provides a publicly shareable link to the resume (opt-in).
entries.desc_zh: 免费开源的简历构建工具，提供数十种模板。可导出为 PDF、DOCX，还可提供公开可分享的简历链接（需自行选择开启）。

entries.name: Roadmap.sh
entries.desc_en: Free learning roadmaps covering all aspects of development from Blockchain to UX Design.
entries.desc_zh: 免费学习路线图，涵盖从区块链到 UX 设计等开发的方方面面。

entries.name: The Odin Project
entries.desc_en: Free, open-source platform with a curriculum focused on JavaScript and Ruby for web development.
entries.desc_zh: 免费开源平台，课程聚焦于 JavaScript 和 Ruby 的 Web 开发。

entries.name: W3Schools
entries.desc_en: Offers free tutorials on web development technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 等 Web 开发技术的免费教程。

entries.name: WebTerm Learn
entries.desc_en: Learn the Linux terminal, Git and Vim in a simulated terminal in the browser. All 129 lessons are free; the first lesson of each course needs no account.
entries.desc_zh: 在浏览器中的模拟终端里学习 Linux 终端、Git 和 Vim。全部 129 节课程免费；每门课程的第一课无需账户。

entries.name: Unitpost
entries.desc_en: AI-First Transactional & Marketing Email Service. Free tier: 5,000 emails/mo, 200 emails/day, 10,000 contacts, 5 domains. No credit card required. SDKs, MCP and REST API available.
entries.desc_zh: AI 优先的事务性及营销邮件服务。免费层：每月 5000 封邮件、每天 200 封邮件、10000 个联系人、5 个域名。无需信用卡。提供 SDK、MCP 和 REST API。

entries.name: 10minutemail
entries.desc_en: Free, temporary email for testing.
entries.desc_zh: 用于测试的免费临时邮箱。

entries.name: AhaSend
entries.desc_en: Transactional email service, free for 1000 emails per month, with unlimited domains, team members, webhooks and message routes in the free plan.
entries.desc_zh: 事务性邮件服务，每月免费 1000 封邮件，免费计划包含不限量的域名、团队成员、Webhook 和消息路由。

entries.name: AnonAddy
entries.desc_en: Open-source anonymous email forwarding, create unlimited email aliases for free
entries.desc_zh: 开源的匿名邮件转发服务，可免费创建无限数量的邮箱别名。

entries.name: anon.li Alias
entries.desc_en: Open source, anonymous email alias/forwarding solution with PGP encryption, reply capability, 10 random & 1 custom alias on the free plan with developer API & CLI.
entries.desc_zh: 开源的匿名邮箱别名/转发解决方案，支持 PGP 加密和回复功能。免费计划包含 10 个随机别名和 1 个自定义别名，并提供开发者 API 和 CLI。

entries.name: Antideo
entries.desc_en: 10 API requests per hour for email verification, IP, and phone number validation in the free tier. No Credit Cards are required.
entries.desc_zh: 免费层提供每小时 10 次 API 请求，用于邮箱验证、IP 和电话号码校验。无需信用卡。

entries.name: Anypost
entries.desc_en: transactional and broadcast email API. 3,000 emails/month free, then as low as 8¢ per 1k
entries.desc_zh: 事务性和群发邮件 API。每月免费 3000 封邮件，之后低至每 1000 封 8 美分。

entries.name: Atomic Mail
entries.desc_en: Email built for AI agents, entirely free. Programmatic inbox creation, custom domains, and full send/receive over the open JMAP standard (RFC 8620/8621); hosted MCP server available. A real mailbox service, not disposable/temporary email.
entries.desc_zh: 专为 AI 智能体打造的邮箱，完全免费。支持以编程方式创建收件箱、自定义域名，并基于开放的 JMAP 标准（RFC 8620/8621）实现完整的收发功能；提供托管的 MCP 服务器。这是真实的邮箱服务，并非一次性/临时邮箱。

entries.name: Brevo
entries.desc_en: 9,000 emails/month, 300 emails/day free
entries.desc_zh: 每月 9000 封、每天 300 封邮件免费。

entries.name: Bump
entries.desc_en: Free 10 Bump email addresses, one custom domain
entries.desc_zh: 免费获得 10 个 Bump 邮箱地址和一个自定义域名。

entries.name: Burnermail
entries.desc_en: Free 5 Burner Email Addresses, 1 Mailbox, 7-day Mailbox History
entries.desc_zh: 免费 5 个一次性邮箱地址、1 个邮箱、7 天邮箱历史记录。

entries.name: Buttondown
entries.desc_en: Newsletter service. Up to 100 subscribers free
entries.desc_zh: Newsletter 服务。最多 100 位订阅者免费。

entries.name: Canny Pigeons
entries.desc_en: DMARC monitoring platform with DNS drift alerts, IP threat intel and unlimited users. First domain is free - no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: DMARC 监控平台，提供 DNS 漂移警报、IP 威胁情报和不限用户数。首个域名免费——无需信用卡。

entries.name: Conduit
entries.desc_en: Turn incoming emails into webhooks to trigger your API from emails. The service is completely free.
entries.desc_zh: 将收到的邮件转换为 Webhook，从而通过邮件触发你的 API。该服务完全免费。

entries.name: Contact.do
entries.desc_en: Contact form in a link (bitly for contact forms)
entries.desc_zh: 链接形式的联系表单（联系表单界的 bitly）。

entries.name: debugmail.io
entries.desc_en: Easy to use testing mail server for developers
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的易用测试邮件服务器。

entries.name: disban.io
entries.desc_en: Protect user signups from disposable emails, or just validate an email against disposable service. Free 2000 check credits per month, No Credit Card required.
entries.desc_zh: 保护用户注册免受一次性邮箱干扰，或仅校验某个邮箱是否为一次性邮箱服务。每月免费 2000 次检查额度，无需信用卡。

entries.name: dkimvalidator.com
entries.desc_en: Test if the email's DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings are correct, free service by roundsphere.com
entries.desc_zh: 测试邮箱的 DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC 设置是否正确，由 roundsphere.com 提供的免费服务。

entries.name: DMARCmetric
entries.desc_en: DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 带有命名发件源的 DMARC 报告监控，支持 SPF/DKIM 对齐和通俗易懂的摘要。免费适用于 1 个域名：每月 10,000 条消息，30 天历史记录，邮件警报，无需信用卡。

entries.name: DNSExit
entries.desc_en: Up to 2 Email addresses under your domain for free with 100MB of storage space. IMAP, POP3, SMTP, SPF/DKIM support.
entries.desc_zh: 在你的域名下免费获得最多 2 个邮箱地址，包含 100MB 存储空间。支持 IMAP、POP3、SMTP、SPF/DKIM。

entries.name: DomainCanary
entries.desc_en: DMARC enforcement service that protects your domain from email spoofing. First domain is free with 90 days of report detail and step-by-step policies you publish yourself.
entries.desc_zh: DMARC 执行服务，保护你的域名免受邮件欺骗。首个域名免费，提供 90 天的报告详情，以及由你自行发布的分步策略。

entries.name: Email Spam Tester
entries.desc_en: Tests the technical part, content, link authority and overall score of your email. Also tests where your email will land: inbox, spam or promotions. Inbox tests on Gmail, GMX, Yahoo, AOL and other email providers. Free to use, no card or registration required. Also works via API and MCP.
entries.desc_zh: 测试邮件的技术部分、内容、链接权威性和整体得分。还会测试邮件的落点：收件箱、垃圾邮件还是促销邮件。可在 Gmail、GMX、Yahoo、AOL 等邮件服务商进行收件箱测试。免费使用，无需银行卡或注册。也可通过 API 和 MCP 使用。

entries.name: EmailGuard
entries.desc_en: Block disposable emails, catch typos, and validate MX records via a simple API. 100 free requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过简单的 API 拦截一次性邮箱、捕捉拼写错误并验证 MX 记录。每月免费 100 次请求。

entries.name: EmailJS
entries.desc_en: This is not an entire email server; this is just an email client that you can use to send emails right from the client without exposing your credentials, the free tier has 200 monthly requests, 2 email templates, Requests up to 50Kb, Limited contacts history.
entries.desc_zh: 这不是一个完整的邮件服务器；它只是一个邮件客户端，你可以直接从客户端发送邮件而不暴露你的凭证。免费层包含每月 200 次请求、2 个邮件模板、请求最大 50Kb、有限的联系人历史记录。

entries.name: EmailLabs.io
entries.desc_en: Send up to 9,000 Emails for free every month, up to 300 emails daily.
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费发送最多 9000 封邮件，每天最多 300 封。

entries.name: EmailQo Email Infrastructure Grader
entries.desc_en: Free email infrastructure grader that checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC and mail server configuration. Scores any domain out of 100. No signup required.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的邮件基础设施评估工具，检查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和邮件服务器配置。为任意域名打出满分 100 分的评分。无需注册。

entries.name: EmailOctopus
entries.desc_en: Up to 2,500 subscribers and 10,000 emails per month free
entries.desc_zh: 最多 2500 个订阅者和每月 10000 封邮件免费。

entries.name: Emailvalidation.io
entries.desc_en: 100 free email verifications per month
entries.desc_zh: 每月 100 次免费邮箱验证

entries.name: Emitlo
entries.desc_en: free 12,000 emails/month, Email API and SMTP, SPF/DKIM/DMARC support, No Credit Cards are required.
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费 12,000 封邮件，Email API 和 SMTP，支持 SPF/DKIM/DMARC，无需信用卡。

entries.name: EtherealMail
entries.desc_en: Ethereal is a fake SMTP service, mainly aimed at Nodemailer and EmailEngine users (but not limited to). It's an entirely free anti-transactional email service where messages never get delivered.
entries.desc_zh: Ethereal 是一个假的 SMTP 服务，主要面向 Nodemailer 和 EmailEngine 用户（但不限于此）。这是一个完全免费的反事务性邮件服务，邮件永远不会被真正送达。

entries.name: forwardemail.net
entries.desc_en: Free email forwarding for custom domains. Create and forward an unlimited amount of email addresses with your domain name (**note**: You must pay if you use .casa, .cf, .click, .email, .fit, .ga, .gdn, .gq, .lat, .loan, .london, .men, .ml, .pl, .rest, .ru, .tk, .top, .work TLDs due to spam)
entries.desc_zh: 为自定义域名提供免费邮件转发。使用你的域名创建并转发无限数量的邮箱地址（**注意**：由于垃圾邮件问题，如果使用 .casa、.cf、.click、.email、.fit、.ga、.gdn、.gq、.lat、.loan、.london、.men、.ml、.pl、.rest、.ru、.tk、.top、.work 这些顶级域名则必须付费）

entries.name: Imitate Email
entries.desc_en: Sandbox Email Server for testing email functionality across build/qa and ci/cd. Free accounts get 15 emails a day forever.
entries.desc_zh: 用于在 build/qa 和 ci/cd 中测试邮件功能的沙箱邮件服务器。免费账户永久享有每天 15 封邮件。

entries.name: ImprovMX
entries.desc_en: Free email forwarding.
entries.desc_zh: 免费邮件转发。

entries.name: Inboxes App
entries.desc_en: Create up to 3 temporary emails a day, then delete them when you're done from within a handy Chrome extension. Perfect for testing signup flows.
entries.desc_zh: 每天最多创建 3 个临时邮箱，用完后可通过一个便捷的 Chrome 扩展将其删除。非常适合测试注册流程。

entries.name: inboxkitten.com
entries.desc_en: Free temporary/disposable email inbox, with up to 3-day email auto-deletes. Open source and can be self-hosted.
entries.desc_zh: 免费临时/一次性邮箱收件箱，邮件最长 3 天自动删除。开源且可自托管。

entries.name: Is It Disposable
entries.desc_en: Detect and block disposable email addresses. Free plan of 250 lookups a month and no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 检测并拦截一次性邮箱地址。免费计划每月 250 次查询，无需信用卡。

entries.name: KaiMail
entries.desc_en: Email forwarding for custom domains with ARC/DKIM signing. Free plan includes 1 domain, 1 mailbox, 300 emails/month, and up to 1MB message size. Email receiving webhook also available. Special plans for open-source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 为自定义域名提供带 ARC/DKIM 签名的邮件转发。免费计划包括 1 个域名、1 个邮箱、每月 300 封邮件，邮件大小最多 1MB。还提供邮件接收 webhook。开源项目有特别计划。

entries.name: mail-tester.com
entries.desc_en: Test if the email's DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings are correct, 20 free/month.
entries.desc_zh: 测试邮箱的 DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC 设置是否正确，每月免费 20 次。

entries.name: Maileroo
entries.desc_en: SMTP relay and email API for developers. 5,000 emails per month, unlimited domains, free email verification, blacklist monitoring, mail tester and more.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的 SMTP 中继和邮件 API。每月 5,000 封邮件，不限域名，免费邮箱验证、黑名单监控、邮件测试工具等。

entries.name: mailcatcher.me
entries.desc_en: Catches mail and serves it through a web interface.
entries.desc_zh: 捕获邮件并通过 Web 界面呈现。

entries.name: mailchannels.com
entries.desc_en: Email API with REST API and SMTP integrations, free for upto 3,000 emails/month.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 REST API 和 SMTP 集成的邮件 API，每月最多 3,000 封邮件免费。

entries.name: Mailcheck.ai
entries.desc_en: Prevent users to sign up with temporary email addresses, 120 requests/hour (~86,400 per month)
entries.desc_zh: 防止用户使用临时邮箱地址注册，120 次请求/小时（每月约 86,400 次）

entries.name: Maildroppa
entries.desc_en: Up to 100 subscribers and unlimited emails as well as automations for free.
entries.desc_zh: 免费享有最多 100 个订阅者、不限量邮件以及自动化功能。

entries.name: MailerLite.com
entries.desc_en: 1,000 subscribers/month, 12,000 emails/month free
entries.desc_zh: 每月 1,000 个订阅者，每月 12,000 封邮件免费

entries.name: MailerSend.com
entries.desc_en: Email API, SMTP, 500 emails/month free for transactional emails, 100 API requests/day
entries.desc_zh: Email API、SMTP，事务性邮件每月免费 500 封，每天 100 次 API 请求

entries.name: mailinator.com
entries.desc_en: Free, public email system where you can use any inbox you want
entries.desc_zh: 免费的公共邮件系统，你可以使用任何你想要的收件箱

entries.name: Mailjet
entries.desc_en: 6,000 emails/month free (200 emails daily sending limit)
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费 6,000 封邮件（每日发送上限 200 封）

entries.name: mailsac.com
entries.desc_en: Free API for temporary email testing, free public email hosting, outbound capture, email-to-slack/websocket/webhook (1,500 monthly API limit)
entries.desc_zh: 用于临时邮件测试的免费 API，免费公共邮件托管，出站捕获，邮件转 slack/websocket/webhook（每月 API 限额 1,500 次）

entries.name: Mailtrap.io
entries.desc_en: Email API and SMTP with 4,000 emails/month free, limited to 150 emails/day. Email Marketing includes 500 contacts and 1,500 emails/month. Email Sandbox includes 50 test emails/month, one sandbox, and up to 10 stored emails.
entries.desc_zh: Email API 和 SMTP，每月免费 4,000 封邮件，限制为每天 150 封。电子邮件营销包括 500 个联系人，每月 1,500 封邮件。电子邮件沙箱包括每月 50 封测试邮件，一个沙箱，最多可存储 10 封邮件。

entries.name: Mutant Mail
entries.desc_en: Free 10 Email IDs, 1 Domain, 1 Mailbox. Single Mailbox for All Email IDs.
entries.desc_zh: 免费提供 10 个 Email ID、1 个域名、1 个邮箱。所有 Email ID 共用一个邮箱。

entries.name: OneSignal
entries.desc_en: 10,000 emails/month,No Credit Cards are required.
entries.desc_zh: 每月 10,000 封邮件，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Orbisearch
entries.desc_en: Free bulk email validator, 100 validations per day, no signup required.
entries.desc_zh: 免费批量邮箱验证工具，每天 100 次验证，无需注册。

entries.name: Parsio.io
entries.desc_en: Free email parser (Forward email, extract the data, send it to your server)
entries.desc_zh: 免费邮件解析器（转发邮件、提取数据、发送到你的服务器）

entries.name: Pharos
entries.desc_en: Transactional email API and SMTP relay service for developers. 3,000 emails a month free.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的事务性邮件 API 和 SMTP 中继服务。每月免费 3,000 封邮件。

entries.name: Plunk
entries.desc_en: 3K emails/month for free
entries.desc_zh: 每月 3,000 封邮件免费

entries.name: Postmark
entries.desc_en: 100 emails/month free, unlimited DMARC weekly digests.
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费 100 封邮件，不限量的 DMARC 每周摘要。

entries.name: Proton Mail
entries.desc_en: Free secure email account service provider with built-in end-to-end encryption. Free 1GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 内置端到端加密的免费安全邮箱账户服务提供商。免费 1GB 存储空间。

entries.name: Reloop
entries.desc_en: Transactional email API and SMTP for developers. Free plan: 3,000 emails/month, 200 emails/day, one custom domain and one agent inbox.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的事务性电子邮件 API 和 SMTP。免费计划：每月 3,000 封邮件，每天 200 封邮件，一个自定义域名和一个代理收件箱。

entries.name: Resend
entries.desc_en: Transactional emails API for developers. 3,000 emails/month, 100 emails/day free, one custom domain.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的事务性电子邮件 API。每月免费 3,000 封邮件，每天 100 封邮件，一个自定义域名。

entries.name: SendBridge Mail Tester
entries.desc_en: Free email deliverability test with no signup. Generates a unique inbox address, then analyzes SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Rspamd spam score, 23+ RBL blacklists, reverse DNS, and content quality. Unlimited tests, results in seconds, shareable report pages.
entries.desc_zh: 免费邮箱送达率测试，无需注册。生成一个唯一的收件箱地址，然后分析 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、Rspamd 垃圾邮件评分、23+ 个 RBL 黑名单、反向 DNS 和内容质量。测试次数不限，几秒内出结果，报告页面可分享。

entries.name: Sender
entries.desc_en: Up to 15,000 emails/month, up to 2,500 subscribers
entries.desc_zh: 每月最多 15,000 封邮件，最多 2,500 个订阅者

entries.name: Sendpulse
entries.desc_en: 500 subscribers/month, 15,000 emails/month free
entries.desc_zh: 每月 500 个订阅者，每月 15,000 封邮件免费

entries.name: SendRaven
entries.desc_en: SendRaven provides an email API for transactional email and agent-driven conversations, including inbound replies and threads. The free tier includes 3,000 outbound emails per month, unlimited contacts and inbound replies, card is required.
entries.desc_zh: SendRaven 提供用于事务性邮件和 agent 驱动对话（包括入站回复和会话线程）的邮件 API。免费层包含每月 3,000 封外发邮件、不限量的联系人和入站回复，需要提供信用卡。

entries.name: SendStreak
entries.desc_en: Email framework as a service, that adds templates, automations, history, etc to your own SMTP server (E.g. AWS, Maileroo, Gmail). Free up to 100 emails/day, no time limit.
entries.desc_zh: 邮件框架即服务，为你自己的 SMTP 服务器（例如 AWS、Maileroo、Gmail）添加模板、自动化、历史记录等功能。每天最多 100 封邮件免费，无时间限制。

entries.name: SignupVet
entries.desc_en: An API that checks email, phone and IP of new signups. 250 free checks per month, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 一个用于检查新注册用户邮箱、电话和 IP 的 API。每月 250 次免费检查，无需信用卡。

entries.name: SimpleLogin
entries.desc_en: Open source, self-hostable email alias/forwarding solution. Free 10 Aliases, unlimited bandwidth, unlimited reply/send. Free for educational staff (student, researcher, etc.).
entries.desc_zh: 开源、可自托管的邮箱别名/转发解决方案。免费提供 10 个别名，不限带宽，不限回复/发送。教育人员（学生、研究人员等）免费。

entries.name: SMTPfast
entries.desc_en: SMTPfast is a simple email API for developers with a free tier that includes 3,000 emails/month, 1 domain, and 1,000 contacts, with no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: SMTPfast 是一个面向开发者的简单邮件 API，其免费层包含每月 3,000 封邮件、1 个域名和 1,000 个联系人，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Substack
entries.desc_en: Unlimited free newsletter service. Start paying when you charge for it.
entries.desc_zh: 不限量的免费新闻通讯服务。当你开始对其收费时才需要付费。

entries.name: Suped
entries.desc_en: A user-friendly DMARC monitoring platform. The free plan covers one domain with up to 1,000 emails per month.
entries.desc_zh: 一款用户友好的 DMARC 监控平台。免费计划涵盖一个域名，每月最多 1,000 封邮件。

entries.name: Sweego
entries.desc_en: European transactional emails API for developers. 100 emails/day free.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的欧洲交易邮件 API。每天免费 100 封邮件。

entries.name: temp-mail.io
entries.desc_en: Free disposable temporary email service with multiple emails at once and forwarding
entries.desc_zh: 免费的一次性临时邮箱服务，可同时使用多个邮箱并支持邮件转发

entries.name: Temp-Mail.org
entries.desc_en: Temporary / Disposable Mail Gen Utilizing a range variety of domain. Email Address refreshes every time the page is reloaded. It is entirely free and does not include any pricing for their services.
entries.desc_zh: 临时/一次性邮箱生成器，使用多种不同的域名。每次重新加载页面时邮箱地址都会刷新。完全免费，其服务不收取任何费用。

entries.name: TempMailDetector.com
entries.desc_en: Verify up to 200 emails a month for free and see if an email is temporary or not.
entries.desc_zh: 每月免费验证最多 200 封邮件，并判断邮箱是否为临时邮箱。

entries.name: trashmail.com
entries.desc_en: Free disposable email addresses with forwarding and automatic address expiration
entries.desc_zh: 免费的一次性邮箱地址，支持转发和地址自动过期

entries.name: Tuta
entries.desc_en: Free secure email account service provider with built-in end-to-end encryption, no ads, no tracking. Free 1GB storage, one calendar (Tuta also have an [paid plan](https://tuta.com/pricing).). Tuta is also partially [open source](https://github.com/tutao/tutanota), so you can self-host.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的安全电子邮箱账户服务提供商，内置端到端加密，无广告、无追踪。免费提供 1GB 存储空间和一个日历（Tuta 也提供一个 [paid plan](https://tuta.com/pricing)。）。Tuta 也是部分 [open source](https://github.com/tutao/tutanota) 的，因此你可以自行托管。

entries.name: Verifalia
entries.desc_en: Real-time email verification API with mailbox confirmation and disposable email address detector; 25 free email verifications/day.
entries.desc_zh: 实时邮箱验证 API，支持邮箱确认和一次性邮箱地址检测；每天免费 25 次邮箱验证。

entries.name: verimail.io
entries.desc_en: Bulk and API email verification service. 100 free verifications/month
entries.desc_zh: 批量及 API 邮箱验证服务。每月免费 100 次验证

entries.name: Waitlio
entries.desc_en: Waitlist management software for product launches. Create branded waitlist pages, collect and verify email subscribers, manage signups with tags and analytics. Free plan includes 100 subscribers/month, 1 waitlist, and API access.
entries.desc_zh: 面向产品发布的候补名单（waitlist）管理软件。创建品牌化候补名单页面，收集并验证邮件订阅者，通过标签和分析功能管理注册。免费套餐包含每月 100 位订阅者、1 个候补名单以及 API 访问权限。

entries.name: Wraps
entries.desc_en: Email infrastructure deployed to your own AWS account (SES), with a dashboard. Pay AWS directly for sending. Free plan covers 1 AWS account, unlimited domains and contacts.
entries.desc_zh: 部署到你自己的 AWS 账户（SES）的邮件基础设施，并配有仪表盘。发送费用直接支付给 AWS。免费套餐覆盖 1 个 AWS 账户，域名和联系人数量不限。

entries.name: ZeroSMTP
entries.desc_en: Free SMTP relay on the msgwing.com domain, up to 200 emails/day, no paid tier. Sends from a shared @msgwing.com address only (no custom domain). Ready-to-run code examples in 15 languages plus Windows Server/Linux/network printer setup guides.
entries.desc_zh: msgwing.com 域名上的免费 SMTP 中继，每天最多 200 封邮件，无付费套餐。只能通过共享的 @msgwing.com 地址发送（不支持自定义域名）。提供 15 种语言的开箱即用代码示例，以及 Windows Server/Linux/网络打印机设置指南。

entries.name: Abby
entries.desc_en: Open-Source feature flags & A/B testing. Configuration as Code & Fully Typed Typescript SDKs. Strong integration with Frameworks such as Next.js & React. Generous free tier and cheap scaling options.
entries.desc_zh: 开源的 feature flags 和 A/B 测试工具。支持 Configuration as Code 及完全类型化的 Typescript SDK。与 Next.js、React 等框架深度集成。免费额度慷慨，扩容成本低廉。

entries.name: ConfigCat
entries.desc_en: ConfigCat is a developer-centric feature flag service with unlimited team size, excellent support, and a reasonable price tag. Free plan up to 10 flags, two environments, 1 product, and 5 Million requests per month.
entries.desc_zh: ConfigCat 是一款以开发者为中心的 feature flag 服务，团队规模不限，支持出色，价格合理。免费套餐最多 10 个 flags、两个环境、1 个产品，以及每月 500 万次请求。

entries.name: Flagpool
entries.desc_en: Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.
entries.desc_zh: 注重简洁和易用性的 feature flag 管理平台。免费套餐包含每月最多创建 10 个新 flags，请求数和定向规则不限。

entries.name: Flagsmith
entries.desc_en: Release features with confidence; manage feature flags across web, mobile, and server-side applications. Use our hosted API, deploy to your own private cloud, or run on-premise.
entries.desc_zh: 自信地发布功能；跨 Web、移动端和服务器端应用管理 feature flags。可使用我们的托管 API，部署到你自己的私有云，或在本地（on-premise）运行。

entries.name: GrowthBook
entries.desc_en: Open source feature flag and A/B testing provider with built-in Bayesian statistical analysis engine. Free for up to 3 users, unlimited feature flags and experiments.
entries.desc_zh: 开源的 feature flag 和 A/B 测试服务提供商，内置贝叶斯统计分析引擎。最多 3 个用户免费，feature flags 和实验数量不限。

entries.name: Rollgate
entries.desc_en: EU-hosted feature flag management with scheduled releases, instant rollback, and A/B testing. 12 SDKs included. Free plan up to 500K API requests/month, unlimited flags, 3 team members, no credit card required.
entries.desc_zh: 托管于欧盟的 feature flag 管理，支持定时发布、即时回滚和 A/B 测试。包含 12 个 SDK。免费套餐每月最多 500K 次 API 请求、flags 数量不限、3 名团队成员，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Hypertune
entries.desc_en: Type-safe feature flags, A/B testing, analytics and app configuration, with Git-style version control and synchronous, in-memory, local flag evaluation. Free for up to 5 team members with unlimited feature flags and A/B tests.
entries.desc_zh: 类型安全的 feature flags、A/B 测试、分析和应用配置，具备 Git 风格的版本控制以及同步、内存中的本地 flag 求值。最多 5 名团队成员免费，feature flags 和 A/B 测试数量不限。

entries.name: Statsig
entries.desc_en: A robust platform for feature management, A/B testing, analytics, and more. Its generous free plan offers unlimited seats, flags, experiments, and dynamic configurations, supporting up to 1 million events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 一个用于功能管理、A/B 测试、分析等的强大平台。其慷慨的免费套餐提供不限数量的席位、flags、实验和动态配置，支持每月最多 100 万个事件。

entries.name: Toggled.dev
entries.desc_en: Enterprise-ready, scalable multi-regional feature toggles management platform. Free plan up to 10 flags, two environments, unlimited requests. SDK, analytics dashboard, release calendar, Slack notifications, and all other features are included in the endless free plan.
entries.desc_zh: 面向企业、可扩展的多区域 feature toggle 管理平台。免费套餐最多 10 个 flags、两个环境、请求数不限。SDK、分析仪表盘、发布日历、Slack 通知以及所有其他功能都包含在这个永久的免费套餐中。

entries.name: Befonts
entries.desc_en: Provides several unique fonts for personal or commercial use.
entries.desc_zh: 提供多款可用于个人或商业用途的独特字体。

entries.name: Bunny
entries.desc_en: Privacy oriented Google Fonts
entries.desc_zh: 注重隐私的 Google Fonts

entries.name: dafont
entries.desc_en: The fonts presented on this website are their authors' property and are either freeware, shareware, demo versions, or public domain.
entries.desc_zh: 本网站展示的字体均为其作者所有，属于免费软件、共享软件、演示版本或公共领域作品。

entries.name: Everything Fonts
entries.desc_en: Offers multiple tools; @font-face, Units Converter, Font Hinter and Font Submitter.
entries.desc_zh: 提供多种工具；@font-face、Units Converter、Font Hinter 和 Font Submitter。

entries.name: Font of web
entries.desc_en: Identify all the fonts used on a website and how they are used.
entries.desc_zh: 识别网站上使用的所有字体及其使用方式。

entries.name: Font Squirrel
entries.desc_en: Freeware fonts licensed for commercial work. Hand-selected these typefaces and presented them in an easy-to-use format.
entries.desc_zh: 授权用于商业作品的免费字体。这些字体均经人工精选，并以易于使用的格式呈现。

entries.name: FontGet
entries.desc_en: Has a variety of fonts available to download and sorted neatly with tags.
entries.desc_zh: 提供多种字体可供下载，并按标签整齐分类。

entries.name: fonts.xz.style
entries.desc_en: free and open source service for delivering font families to websites using CSS.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 CSS 向网站交付字体家族的免费开源服务。

entries.name: Fontsensei
entries.desc_en: Opensourced Google fonts tagged by users. With CJK (Chinese,Japanese, Korean) font tags.
entries.desc_zh: 由用户添加标签的开源 Google fonts。包含 CJK（中文、日文、韩文）字体标签。

entries.name: Fontshare
entries.desc_en: is a free fonts service. It’s a growing collection of professional-grade fonts, 100% free for personal and commercial use.
entries.desc_zh: 是一个免费字体服务。它收录了不断增长的专业级字体，100% 免费用于个人和商业用途。

entries.name: Google Fonts
entries.desc_en: Many free fonts are easy and quick to install on a website via a download or a link to Google's CDN.
entries.desc_zh: 许多免费字体可通过下载或链接到 Google 的 CDN 轻松快速地安装到网站上。

entries.name: FabForm
entries.desc_en: Form backend platform for intelligent developers. The free plan allows 250 form submissions per month. Friendly modern GUI. Integrates with Google Sheets, Airtable, Slack, Email, and others.
entries.desc_zh: 面向聪明开发者的表单后端平台。免费套餐允许每月 250 次表单提交。界面友好且现代。可与 Google Sheets、Airtable、Slack、Email 等集成。

entries.name: Feathery
entries.desc_en: Powerful, developer-friendly form builder. Build signup & login, user onboarding, payment flows, complex financial applications, and more. The free plan allows up to 250 submissions/month and five active forms.
entries.desc_zh: 强大、开发者友好的表单构建器。构建注册和登录、用户引导、支付流程、复杂金融应用程序等。免费计划允许每月最多 250 次提交和五个活动表单。

entries.name: feedback.fish
entries.desc_en: Free plan allows collecting 25 total feedback submissions. Easy to integrate with React and Vue components provided.
entries.desc_zh: 免费套餐允许总共收集 25 条反馈提交。提供 React 和 Vue 组件，易于集成。

entries.name: FluidForms
entries.desc_en: Form builder and backend with AI-driven logic. Free plan includes 100 responses per month, unlimited forms (including AI-created forms), webhooks, and embedding.
entries.desc_zh: 具有 AI 驱动逻辑的表单构建器和后端。免费套餐包含每月 100 条回复、不限数量的表单（包括 AI 创建的表单）、webhook 和嵌入功能。

entries.name: Form.taxi
entries.desc_en: Endpoint for HTML forms submissions. With notifications, spam blockers, and GDPR-compliant data processing. Free plan for basic usage.
entries.desc_zh: HTML 表单提交端点。具备通知、垃圾邮件拦截和符合 GDPR 的数据处理。基础用途可使用免费套餐。

entries.name: Formboost.app
entries.desc_en: Developer-first form backend with simple HTTP endpoints, 500 free submissions/month, spam protection, email notifications, and built-in Slack, Discord & Telegram integrations. No backend required.
entries.desc_zh: 以开发者为先的表单后端，提供简单的 HTTP 端点、每月 500 次免费提交、垃圾信息防护、邮件通知，以及内置的 Slack、Discord 和 Telegram 集成。无需后端。

entries.name: Formcarry.com
entries.desc_en: HTTP POST Form endpoint, Free plan allows 100 monthly submissions.
entries.desc_zh: HTTP POST 表单端点，免费套餐允许每月 100 次提交。

entries.name: Formester.com
entries.desc_en: Share and embed unique-looking forms on your website-no limits on the number of forms created or features restricted by the plan. Get up to 100 submissions every month for free.
entries.desc_zh: 在你的网站上分享和嵌入外观独特的表单——创建的表单数量不受限制，也没有受套餐限制的功能。每月可免费获得最多 100 次提交。

entries.name: Formgong
entries.desc_en: Multilingual form backend for generated websites that need contact or other forms. Free tier: 300 submissions/month, email and Telegram notifications.
entries.desc_zh: 面向需要联系表单或其他表单的生成网站的多语言表单后端。免费层：每月 300 次提交，支持邮件和 Telegram 通知。

entries.name: Forminit
entries.desc_en: Headless form backend for developers. The free plan allows 100 form submissions per month including file uploads, server-side field validation, email notifications, spam protection and Zapier.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的无头表单后端。免费计划允许每月 100 次表单提交，包括文件上传、服务端字段验证、邮件通知、垃圾信息防护和 Zapier。

entries.name: FormKeep.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited forms with 50 monthly submissions, spam protection, email notification, and a drag-and-drop designer that can export HTML. Additional features include custom field rules, teams, and integrations to Google Sheets, Slack, ActiveCampaign, and Zapier.
entries.desc_zh: 无限表单，每月 50 次提交，包含垃圾信息防护、邮件通知，以及可导出 HTML 的拖拽式设计器。其他功能包括自定义字段规则、团队协作，以及与 Google Sheets、Slack、ActiveCampaign 和 Zapier 的集成。

entries.name: Form Plume
entries.desc_en: Form Plume is a form backend for HTML and JavaScript forms. One endpoint gets you spam filtering, email notifications, file uploads, webhooks, and a clean inbox. Free for 500 submissions/mo.
entries.desc_zh: Form Plume 是一个面向 HTML 和 JavaScript 表单的表单后端。只需一个端点即可获得垃圾信息过滤、邮件通知、文件上传、webhook 和整洁的收件箱。免费提供每月 500 次提交。

entries.name: formlets.com
entries.desc_en: Online forms, unlimited single page forms/month, 100 submissions/month, email notifications.
entries.desc_zh: 在线表单，每月不限单页表单数量，每月 100 次提交，邮件通知。

entries.name: forms.app
entries.desc_en: Create online forms with powerful features like conditional logic, automatic score calculator, and AI. Collect up to 100 responses with a free plan, embed your forms on a website, or use them with a link.
entries.desc_zh: 创建具备条件逻辑、自动评分计算器和 AI 等强大功能的在线表单。免费计划最多可收集 100 份回复，可将表单嵌入网站，或通过链接使用。

entries.name: formspark.io
entries.desc_en: Form to Email service, free plan allows unlimited forms, 250 submissions per month, support by Customer assistance team.
entries.desc_zh: 表单转邮件（Form to Email）服务，免费计划允许不限数量的表单，每月 250 次提交，由客户支持团队提供支持。

entries.name: Formspree.io
entries.desc_en: Send email using an HTTP POST request. The free tier limits to 50 submissions per form per month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 HTTP POST 请求发送邮件。免费层限制为每个表单每月 50 次提交。

entries.name: Formsubmit.co
entries.desc_en: Easy form endpoints for your HTML forms. Free Forever. No registration is required.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的 HTML 表单提供简单易用的表单端点。永久免费。无需注册。

entries.name: Formware.io
entries.desc_en: Create fully-responsive and captivating forms in seconds, without knowing how to code, and collect unlimited responses for free!
entries.desc_zh: 无需编程知识，几秒钟内即可创建完全响应式且引人注目的表单，并免费收集不限量的回复！

entries.name: HeroTofu.com
entries.desc_en: Forms backend with bot detection and encrypted archive. Forward submissions via UI to email, Slack, or Zapier. Use your own front end. No server code is required. The free plan gives unlimited forms and 100 submissions per month.
entries.desc_zh: 具备机器人检测和加密存档功能的表单后端。可通过 UI 将提交转发至邮件、Slack 或 Zapier。可使用你自己的前端，无需服务器代码。免费计划提供无限表单和每月 100 次提交。

entries.name: HeyForm.net
entries.desc_en: Drag and drop online form builder. The free tier lets you create unlimited forms and collect unlimited submissions. Comes with pre-built templates, anti-spam, and 100MB file storage.
entries.desc_zh: 拖拽式在线表单构建器。免费层可创建无限表单并收集无限提交。附带预置模板、反垃圾功能以及 100MB 文件存储空间。

entries.name: Jotform.com
entries.desc_en: Create online forms for free, collect submissions, accept payments, automate workflows, and get documents signed with built-in e-signatures. Free plan includes 5 forms, 100 monthly submissions, 10 e-sign documents, 10 payment submissions, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 免费创建在线表单、收集提交、接受付款、自动化工作流程，并通过内置电子签名让文档完成签署。免费计划包含 5 个表单、每月 100 次提交、10 份电子签文档、10 次付款提交等。

entries.name: Kwes.io
entries.desc_en: Feature rich form endpoint. Works great with static sites. The free plan includes up to 1 website with up to 50 monthly submissions.
entries.desc_zh: 功能丰富的表单端点。与静态网站配合使用效果极佳。免费计划包含最多 1 个网站，每月最多 50 次提交。

entries.name: Lucid Forms
entries.desc_en: Form endpoint for websites. Add working contact forms to any HTML, JS framework, or no-code site without building a backend. Free plan includes 250 submissions/month, email notifications, smart spam filtering, and Google Sheets integration.
entries.desc_zh: 面向网站的表单端点。无需构建后端，即可为任何 HTML、JS 框架或无代码网站添加可用的联系表单。免费计划包含每月 250 次提交、邮件通知、智能垃圾信息过滤以及 Google Sheets 集成。

entries.name: Makeform
entries.desc_en: Chat-based form builder. The free form builder with unlimited forms and submissions. 99% of the features are free, includes adding logos, conditional logic, file uploads, payments, integrations, and webhooks. Pro Plan ($19/month) enables remove the Makeform Branding, custom domains and team features. Business plan ($59/month) enables RBAC, email verification and single sign on (SSO).
entries.desc_zh: 基于对话的表单构建器。免费表单构建器提供无限表单和无限提交。99% 的功能免费，包括添加 Logo、条件逻辑、文件上传、付款、集成和 webhook。Pro 计划（每月 19 美元）可移除 Makeform 品牌标识、使用自定义域名和团队功能。Business 计划（每月 59 美元）提供 RBAC、邮箱验证和单点登录（SSO）。

entries.name: Pageclip
entries.desc_en: The free plan allows one site, one form, and 1,000 monthly submissions.
entries.desc_zh: 免费计划允许一个站点、一个表单和 1,000 次月度提交。

entries.name: SimplePDF.eu
entries.desc_en: Embed a PDF editor on your website and turn any PDF into a fillable form. The free plan allows unlimited PDFs with three submissions per PDF.
entries.desc_zh: 在网站上嵌入 PDF 编辑器，将任何 PDF 变为可填写的表单。免费计划允许不限数量的 PDF，每个 PDF 可提交三次。

entries.name: smartforms.dev
entries.desc_en: Powerful and easy form backend for your website, forever free plan allows 50 submissions per month, 250MB file storage, Zapier integration, CSV/JSON export, custom redirect, custom response page, Telegram & Slack bot, single email notifications.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的网站提供强大而易用的表单后端，永久免费计划允许每月 50 次提交、250MB 文件存储、Zapier 集成、CSV/JSON 导出、自定义重定向、自定义响应页面、Telegram 和 Slack 机器人、单一邮件通知。

entries.name: staticforms.xyz
entries.desc_en: Integrate HTML forms easily without any server-side code for free. After the user submits the form, an email with the form content will be sent to your registered address.
entries.desc_zh: 免费轻松集成 HTML 表单，无需任何服务端代码。用户提交表单后，包含表单内容的邮件将发送至你注册的地址。

entries.name: Survicate
entries.desc_en: Pull feedback from all sources and send follow-up surveys with one tool. Automatically analyze feedback and extract insights with AI. Free email, website, in-product or mobile surveys, AI survey creator, and 25 monthly responses.
entries.desc_zh: 用一个工具从所有渠道收集反馈并发送后续调查。利用 AI 自动分析反馈并提取洞察。免费提供邮件、网站、产品内或移动端调查、AI 调查创建器，以及每月 25 份回复。

entries.name: Tally.so
entries.desc_en: 99% of all the features are free. The free tier lets you have: unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, email notifications, form logic, collect payments, file upload, custom thank you page, and many more.
entries.desc_zh: 99% 的所有功能都是免费的。免费套餐可让您拥有：无限表单、无限提交、电子邮件通知、表单逻辑、收款、文件上传、自定义感谢页面等等。

entries.name: Typeform.com
entries.desc_en: Include beautifully designed forms on websites.  The free plan allows only ten fields per form and 100 monthly responses.
entries.desc_zh: 在网站上包含设计精美的表单。免费计划每个表单仅允许十个字段和 100 次月度响应。

entries.name: Vidhook
entries.desc_en: Collect feedback using delightful surveys with high response rates. Free plan includes 1 active survey, 25 responses per survey and customizable templates.
entries.desc_zh: 使用高回复率的精美调查收集反馈。免费计划包含 1 个进行中的调查、每个调查 25 份回复以及可自定义的模板。

entries.name: WaiverStevie.com
entries.desc_en: Electronic Signature platform with a REST API. You can receive notifications with webhooks. Free plan watermarks signed documents but allow unlimited envelopes + signatures.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 REST API 的电子签名平台。可通过 webhook 接收通知。免费计划会为已签署文档添加水印，但允许不限量的信封（envelope）和签名。

entries.name: Web3Forms
entries.desc_en: Contact forms for Static & JAMStack Websites without writing backend code. The free plan allows Unlimited Forms, Unlimited Domains & 250 Submissions per month.
entries.desc_zh: 为静态和 JAMStack 网站提供联系表单，无需编写后端代码。免费计划允许无限表单、无限域名和每月 250 次提交。

entries.name: Wufoo
entries.desc_en: Quick forms to use on websites. The free plan has a limit of 100 submissions each month.
entries.desc_zh: 可在网站上使用的快速表单。免费计划每月限制 100 次提交。

entries.name: FormNX
entries.desc_en: Create unlimited forms get unlimited submissions free of cost. Use professionally created 1000+ form templates or create forms from scratch. Get features like email notifications, form logic, collect payments, file upload, custom thank you page, and many more.
entries.desc_zh: 免费创建无限表单，获得无限提交。可使用专业制作的 1000 多个表单模板，或从头创建表单。可获得邮件通知、表单逻辑、收款、文件上传、自定义感谢页面等诸多功能。

entries.name: Arize AX
entries.desc_en: AI observability and evaluation platform that helps teams understand, evaluate, and continuously improve AI agents and applications. Free plan includes unlimited users and evals, 25k spans and 1GB ingestion per month, 15-day retention, and Signal (10 issues per month). No credit card required. Self-hosting open-source option with Arize Phoenix.
entries.desc_zh: AI 可观测性与评估平台，帮助团队理解、评估并持续改进 AI 代理和应用程序。免费计划包含不限量的用户和评估（evals）、每月 25k 个 span 和 1GB 数据摄取、15 天数据保留，以及 Signal（每月 10 个问题）。无需信用卡。可通过 Arize Phoenix 选择自托管开源版本。

entries.name: Audio Enhancer
entries.desc_en: AI-powered audio enhancer SaaS that removes noise and echo while preserving natural vocal clarity. totally Free: unlimited one-click enhancements, no login required, supports MP3/WAV/FLAC
entries.desc_zh: AI 驱动的音频增强 SaaS，可在保持自然人声清晰度的同时消除噪音与回声。完全免费：无限次一键增强，无需登录，支持 MP3/WAV/FLAC

entries.name: Braintrust
entries.desc_en: Evals, prompt playground, and data management for Gen AI. Free plan gives upto 1,000 private eval rows/week.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Gen AI 的评估（evals）、提示词实验场和数据管理。免费计划提供每周最多 1,000 行私有评估数据。

entries.name: Clair
entries.desc_en: Clinical AI Reference. Students have free access to the professional tool suite, which includes Open Search, Clinical Summary, Med Review, Drug Interactions, ICD-10 Codes, and Stewardship. Additionally, a free trial for the professional suite is available.
entries.desc_zh: 临床 AI 参考。学生可免费使用专业工具套件，其中包括 Open Search、Clinical Summary、Med Review、Drug Interactions、ICD-10 Codes 和 Stewardship。此外，专业套件还提供免费试用。

entries.name: Comet Opik
entries.desc_en: Evaluate, test, and ship LLM applications across your dev and production lifecycles. [#opensource](https://github.com/comet-ml/opik/)
entries.desc_zh: 在开发和生产生命周期中评估、测试并发布 LLM 应用程序。[#opensource](https://github.com/comet-ml/opik/)

entries.name: Future AGI
entries.desc_en: Open-source platform to evaluate, observe, and improve LLM and AI agent apps, with tracing, evals, simulations, and guardrails. Free tier includes 50GB storage, 2K eval credits, 100K AI-gateway requests/month, 1M tokens of text agent simulation and 60 min of voice simulation, plus unlimited projects/seats and BYOK LLM-as-judge at $0 platform cost. [#opensource](https://github.com/future-agi/future-agi)
entries.desc_zh: 开源平台，用于评估、观察和改进 LLM 及 AI 代理应用，提供追踪（tracing）、评估（evals）、模拟和安全护栏（guardrails）。免费层包含 50GB 存储、2K 评估积分、每月 100K 次 AI 网关请求、100 万 token 的文本代理模拟和 60 分钟语音模拟，此外还有不限量的项目/席位，以及平台费用为 $0 的 BYOK LLM-as-judge。[#opensource](https://github.com/future-agi/future-agi)

entries.name: Gonka Broker
entries.desc_en: OpenAI-compatible API for open-source models served over the decentralized Gonka.ai GPU network. 1M+ free tokens monthly. Easy integration with many AI tools.
entries.desc_zh: 通过去中心化的 Gonka.ai GPU 网络为开源模型提供 OpenAI 兼容 API。每月 100 万+ 免费 token。可轻松与众多 AI 工具集成。

entries.name: Keywords AI
entries.desc_en: The best LLM monitoring platform. One format to call 200+ LLMs with 2 lines of code. 10,000 free requests every month and $0 for platform features!
entries.desc_zh: 最佳的 LLM 监控平台。用 2 行代码以统一格式调用 200 多个 LLM。每月 10,000 次免费请求，平台功能费用为 $0！

entries.name: Langfuse
entries.desc_en: Open-source LLM engineering platform that helps teams collaboratively debug, analyze, and iterate on their LLM applications. Free forever plan includes 50k observations per month and all platform features. [#opensource](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse)
entries.desc_zh: 开源 LLM 工程平台，帮助团队协作调试、分析并迭代其 LLM 应用。永久免费套餐每月包含 5 万条观测记录及全部平台功能。 [#opensource](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse)

entries.name: LangWatch
entries.desc_en: A LLMOps platform helping AI teams measure, monitor, and optimize LLM applications for reliability, cost-efficiency, and performance. With a powerful DSPy component, we enable seamless collaboration between engineers and non-technical teams to fine-tune and productionize GenAI products. Free plan includes all platform features, 1k traces/month and 1 workflow DSPy optimizers. [#opensource](https://github.com/langwatch/langwatch)
entries.desc_zh: 一个 LLMOps 平台，帮助 AI 团队衡量、监控并优化 LLM 应用，实现可靠性、成本效益与性能优化。凭借强大的 DSPy 组件，我们助力工程师与非技术团队无缝协作，对 GenAI 产品进行微调并投入生产。免费计划包含全部平台功能、每月 1,000 条 traces 和 1 个工作流 DSPy 优化器。[#opensource](https://github.com/langwatch/langwatch)

entries.name: Latitude
entries.desc_en: Open-source (MIT) LLM observability and evaluation platform to trace, monitor, and evaluate AI agents in production. Free Starter plan includes 20K credits/month, 30-day data retention, and unlimited seats. [#opensource](https://github.com/latitude-dev/latitude-llm)
entries.desc_zh: 开源（MIT）LLM 可观测性与评估平台，用于追踪、监控和评估生产环境中的 AI agents。免费 Starter 计划包含每月 2 万 credits、30 天数据保留期和不限席位。[#opensource](https://github.com/latitude-dev/latitude-llm)

entries.name: Lumenfall.ai
entries.desc_en: AI media gateway providing unified access to leading image generation models via an OpenAI-compatible API. The platform itself is free to use with zero markup and no subscription fee. Inference costs for most models are billed at provider price, but FLUX.1 [schnell] FP8 is offered free forever with unlimited usage for registered users. Built-in failover and provider resilience included.
entries.desc_zh: AI 媒体网关，通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 提供对领先图像生成模型的统一访问。平台本身免费使用，零加价且无订阅费。大多数模型的推理成本按提供商价格计费，但 FLUX.1 [schnell] FP8 对注册用户永久免费且不限使用量。内置故障转移和提供商容错能力。

entries.name: Maxim
entries.desc_en: An LLM evaluation and observability platform with agent simulation and prompt playground. Free tier offers 10k monthly logs, access to prompt playground, simulations and evaluations via BYOK.
entries.desc_zh: 一个 LLM 评估与可观测性平台，具备 agent 模拟和 prompt playground。免费层每月提供 10,000 条日志，可通过 BYOK 访问 prompt playground、模拟和评估功能。

entries.name: Mediaworkbench.ai
entries.desc_en: MediaWorkbench.ai offers 100,000 free words for Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Google Gemini models, enabling users to access powerful tools for code generation, deep research, and image creation.
entries.desc_zh: MediaWorkbench.ai 为 Azure OpenAI、DeepSeek 和 Google Gemini 模型提供 10 万个免费字数，使用户能够使用强大的代码生成、深度研究和图像创作工具。

entries.name: onomeo
entries.desc_en: Onomeo gives you one key for dozens of AI models. Plug it right into tools like Cline, SillyTavern, or Open WebUI using standard OpenAI format. 35 models are completely free (60 requests / 5 hrs per user, pooled at 450 / 5 hrs across all users). Daily check-in credits let you use big models like Claude and GPT, up to a daily limit. Extra credits start at $5/month. We’re in open beta, so expect occasional instability. It’s great for casual use, but not ready to be a daily driver. Feedback is always welcome.
entries.desc_zh: Onomeo 让你用一把密钥接入数十种 AI 模型。使用标准 OpenAI 格式即可直接插入 Cline、SillyTavern 或 Open WebUI 等工具。35 个模型完全免费（每位用户每 5 小时 60 次请求，全部用户合计每 5 小时共享 450 次）。每日签到获得的积分可用于使用 Claude 和 GPT 等大模型，设有每日上限。额外积分每月 $5 起。我们正处于公开测试阶段，请谅解偶发的不稳定。它很适合轻度使用，但还不适合作为日常主力工具。欢迎随时反馈。

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.desc_en: Provides various free AI models including DeepSeek R1, V3, Llama, and Moonshot AI. These models excel in natural language processing and are suitable for diverse development needs. Note that while these models are free to use, they are subject to rate limits. Additionally, OpenRouter offers paid models for more advanced requirements, for instance Claude, OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, and Nova.
entries.desc_zh: 提供多种免费 AI 模型，包括 DeepSeek R1、V3、Llama 和 Moonshot AI。这些模型在自然语言处理方面表现出色，适合多样的开发需求。请注意，这些模型虽可免费使用，但受速率限制。此外，OpenRouter 还为更高级的需求提供付费模型，例如 Claude、OpenAI、Grok、Gemini 和 Nova。

entries.name: Pollinations.AI
entries.desc_en: easy-to-use, free image generation AI with free API available. No signups or API keys required, and several option for integrating into a website or workflow. [#opensource](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations)
entries.desc_zh: 易用、免费的图像生成 AI，并提供免费 API。无需注册或 API 密钥，提供多种集成到网站或工作流中的方式。[#opensource](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations)

entries.name: Portkey
entries.desc_en: Control panel for Gen AI apps featuring an observability suite & an AI gateway. Send & log up to 10,000 requests for free every month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Gen AI 应用的控制面板，配备可观测性套件和 AI 网关。每月可免费发送并记录多达 10,000 个请求。

entries.name: ReportGPT
entries.desc_en: AI Powered Writing Assistant. The entire platform is free as long as you bring your own API key.
entries.desc_zh: AI 驱动的写作助手。只要自带 API 密钥，整个平台即可免费使用。

entries.name: telemetry.dev
entries.desc_en: Observability for AI/LLM apps built on OpenTelemetry. Traces model calls and tool steps with tokens, cost, latency and errors; send OTLP over HTTP from any language or use the TypeScript SDKs. Free plan includes 10,000 spans/month, 7-day retention, 1 project and 2 seats, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 OpenTelemetry 构建的 AI/LLM 应用可观测性。追踪模型调用和工具步骤，涵盖 token、成本、延迟和错误；可从任何语言通过 HTTP 发送 OTLP，或使用 TypeScript SDK。免费计划包含每月 10,000 个 span、7 天数据保留、1 个项目和 2 个席位，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Transcript LOL
entries.desc_en: Converts audio or video to text using AI. Generates summaries and other insights using LLMs. The free tier includes 2 transcriptions per day. You can upload files, record voice notes, or use links from YouTube, Instagram etc. The free version also supports WhatsApp, Telegram and importing files directly from cloud storages - Google Drive, Dropbox, Box and OneDrive. No API key needed. Sign up and ready to use. Also has apps for mobiles, desktops and chromebooks.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 AI 将音频或视频转换为文字。利用 LLM 生成摘要和其他洞察。免费层每天包含 2 次转录。你可以上传文件、录制语音笔记，或使用来自 YouTube、Instagram 等的链接。免费版还支持 WhatsApp、Telegram，以及直接从云存储（Google Drive、Dropbox、Box 和 OneDrive）导入文件。无需 API 密钥。注册即可使用。还有适用于手机、桌面和 Chromebook 的应用。

entries.name: Zenable
entries.desc_en: Instantly auto-fix outputs from tools like Cursor, Windsurf, and Copilot to meet your company's quality and compliance standards using guardrails built with Policy as Code. The free tier includes 100 tools calls per day to the MCP server and 25 free automated pull request reviews per day via the GitHub App.
entries.desc_zh: 使用以 Policy as Code 构建的护栏，即时自动修复 Cursor、Windsurf 和 Copilot 等工具的输出，以满足公司的质量和合规标准。免费层包含每天 100 次 MCP 服务器工具调用，以及通过 GitHub App 每天进行 25 次免费自动化 pull request 审查。

entries.name: bootstrapcdn.com
entries.desc_en: CDN for bootstrap, bootswatch and fontawesome.io
entries.desc_zh: 为 bootstrap、bootswatch 和 fontawesome.io 提供的 CDN

entries.name: CacheFly
entries.desc_en: Up to 5 TB per month of Free CDN traffic, 19 Core PoPs , 1 Domain and Universal SSL.
entries.desc_zh: 每月最多 5 TB 免费 CDN 流量、19 个核心 PoP、1 个域名和 Universal SSL。

entries.name: cdnjs.com
entries.desc_en: Simple. Fast. Reliable. Content delivery at its finest. cdnjs is a free and open-source CDN service trusted by over 11% of all websites, powered by Cloudflare.
entries.desc_zh: 简单。快速。可靠。卓越的内容分发。cdnjs 是由 Cloudflare 提供支持的免费开源 CDN 服务，超过 11% 的网站都在使用。

entries.name: developers.google.com
entries.desc_en: The Google Hosted Libraries is a content distribution network for the most popular Open Source JavaScript libraries
entries.desc_zh: Google Hosted Libraries 是一个内容分发网络，收录最流行的开源 JavaScript 库

entries.name: Gcore
entries.desc_en: Global content delivery network, 1 TB and 1 million requests per month free and
entries.desc_zh: 全球内容分发网络，每月免费提供 1 TB 流量和 100 万次请求，以及

entries.name: jsdelivr.com
entries.desc_en: A free, fast, and reliable open-source CDN. Supports npm, GitHub, WordPress, Deno, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 免费、快速、可靠的开源 CDN。支持 npm、GitHub、WordPress、Deno 等。

entries.name: Microsoft Ajax
entries.desc_en: The Microsoft Ajax CDN hosts popular third-party JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and enables you to easily add them to your Web application
entries.desc_zh: Microsoft Ajax CDN 托管 jQuery 等流行的第三方 JavaScript 库，让你能轻松将它们添加到 Web 应用中

entries.name: Namecheap Supersonic
entries.desc_en: Free DDoS protection
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DDoS 防护

entries.name: ovh.ie
entries.desc_en: Free DDoS protection and SSL certificate
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DDoS 防护和 SSL 证书

entries.name: PromoProxy
entries.desc_en: Free cloud Secure Web Gateway. Free plan includes up to 5 users and 1 GB per day.
entries.desc_zh: 免费云端安全 Web 网关。免费计划包含最多 5 个用户和每天 1 GB。

entries.name: raw.githack.com
entries.desc_en: A modern replacement of **rawgit.com** which simply hosts file using Cloudflare
entries.desc_zh: **rawgit.com** 的现代替代品，使用 Cloudflare 简单地托管文件

entries.name: Skypack
entries.desc_en: The 100% Native ES Module JavaScript CDN. Free for 1 million requests per domain per month.
entries.desc_zh: 100% 原生 ES Module JavaScript CDN。每个域名每月免费 100 万次请求。

entries.name: statically.io
entries.desc_en: CDN for Git repos (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), WordPress-related assets, and images
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Git 仓库（GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket）、WordPress 相关资源和图像的 CDN

entries.name: Stellate
entries.desc_en: Stellate is a blazing-fast, reliable CDN for your GraphQL API and free for two services.
entries.desc_zh: Stellate 是为你的 GraphQL API 打造的超快速、可靠的 CDN，两个服务可免费使用。

entries.name: toranproxy.com
entries.desc_en: Proxy for Packagist and GitHub. Never fail CD. Free for personal use, one developer, no support
entries.desc_zh: Packagist 和 GitHub 的代理。让 CD 永不失败。个人使用免费，限一名开发者，不提供支持

entries.name: UNPKG
entries.desc_en: CDN for everything on npm
entries.desc_zh: npm 上所有内容的 CDN

entries.name: weserv
entries.desc_en: An image cache & resize service. Manipulate images on the fly with a worldwide cache.
entries.desc_zh: 图像缓存和调整大小的服务。通过全球缓存即时处理图像。

entries.name: ampt.dev
entries.desc_en: Ampt lets teams build, deploy, and scale JavaScript apps on AWS without complicated configs or managing infrastructure. Free Preview plan includes 500 invocations hourly, 2,500 invocations daily and 50,000 invocations monthly. Custom domains are allowed only in the paid plans.
entries.desc_zh: Ampt 让团队无需复杂配置或管理基础设施，即可在 AWS 上构建、部署和扩展 JavaScript 应用。免费 Preview 计划包含每小时 500 次调用、每天 2,500 次调用和每月 50,000 次调用。自定义域名仅在付费计划中提供。

entries.name: anvil.works
entries.desc_en: Web app development with nothing but Python. Free tier with unlimited apps and 30-second timeouts.
entries.desc_zh: 仅用 Python 进行 Web 应用开发。免费层提供无限应用和 30 秒超时。

entries.name: Apply.build
entries.desc_en: Build and deploy your GitHub app for free with 0.5 vCPUs / 512 MiB RAM, European servers, automatic firewall, real-time performance metrics. Run Node.js, Python, Go, Java, static sites, microservices, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 免费构建和部署你的 GitHub 应用，配备 0.5 vCPU / 512 MiB 内存、欧洲服务器、自动防火墙和实时性能指标。可运行 Node.js、Python、Go、Java、静态网站、微服务等。

entries.name: appwrite
entries.desc_en: Unlimited projects with no project pausing (supports websockets) and authentication service. 1 Database, 3 Buckets, 5 Functions per project in free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 无限项目，项目不会暂停（支持 websockets），并提供身份验证服务。免费层每个项目包含 1 个数据库、3 个存储桶和 5 个函数。

entries.name: Clever Cloud
entries.desc_en: European PaaS with automated deployments, autoscaling, managed databases, and Git-based workflows. Includes €20 free credits at signup, a limited DEV plan with free MySQL and PostgreSQL databases, and free allowances for services like Heptapod and FS Buckets.
entries.desc_zh: 欧洲 PaaS，提供自动化部署、自动扩缩容、托管数据库和基于 Git 的工作流。注册即赠 €20 免费额度，包含有限的 DEV 计划（提供免费 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 数据库），以及 Heptapod 和 FS Buckets 等服务的免费额度。

entries.name: Choreo
entries.desc_en: AI-native internal developer platform as a service. The free tier includes up to 5 components and $100 credits per month.
entries.desc_zh: AI 原生的内部开发者平台即服务。免费层包含最多 5 个组件和每月 $100 额度。

entries.name: codenameone.com
entries.desc_en: Open source, cross-platform, mobile app development toolchain for Java/Kotlin developers. Free for commercial use with an unlimited number of projects
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Java/Kotlin 开发者的开源、跨平台移动应用开发工具链。可免费商用，项目数量不限

entries.name: Cohesivity
entries.desc_en: Headless backend and services, purpose built for AI agents. Includes hosting, databases, storage, LLMs, and third-party APIs. Agentic signup. Free tier includes 10 projects, 100K edge requests, 10 GB object storage, 100 emails, and 5 USD/month in credits for AI and search.
entries.desc_zh: 专为 AI agent 打造的无头（headless）后端与服务。包含托管、数据库、存储、LLM 和第三方 API。支持 agentic 注册。免费层包含 10 个项目、100K 次边缘请求、10 GB 对象存储、100 封邮件，以及每月 5 美元用于 AI 和搜索的额度。

entries.name: Daestro
entries.desc_en: Run compute jobs across Cloud Providers & On-Prem. The free tier includes up to 10 concurrent job runs, 2 compute spawns, self-hosted compute, 1 cloud provider, 1 container registry and 1 cron job.
entries.desc_zh: 跨云服务商和本地环境运行计算任务。免费层包含最多 10 个并发任务运行、2 个 compute spawn、自托管计算、1 个云服务商、1 个容器镜像仓库和 1 个 cron 任务。

entries.name: Deno Deploy
entries.desc_en: Distributed system that runs JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly at the edge worldwide. The free tier includes 100,000 requests per day and 100 GiB data transfers per month.
entries.desc_zh: 在全球边缘运行 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 WebAssembly 的分布式系统。免费层包含每天 100,000 次请求和每月 100 GiB 数据传输。

entries.name: Deplexo
entries.desc_en: Developer-focused PaaS for deploying and hosting applications with Git-based deployments, custom domains, automatic HTTPS, and Dockerfile support. Run Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Rust, PHP, static sites, and more. The free tier includes 1 app with 0.25 vCPU, 128 MB RAM, 250 MB disk, and 100 GB bandwidth.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的 PaaS，用于部署和托管应用，支持基于 Git 的部署、自定义域名、自动 HTTPS 和 Dockerfile。可运行 Node.js、Python、Go、Java、Rust、PHP、静态网站等。免费层包含 1 个应用，配备 0.25 vCPU、128 MB 内存、250 MB 磁盘和 100 GB 带宽。

entries.name: domcloud.co
entries.desc_en: Linux hosting service that provides CI/CD with GitHub, SSH, and MariaDB/Postgres database. The free version has 1 GB storage and 1 GB network/month limit and is limited to a free domain.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 GitHub CI/CD、SSH 和 MariaDB/Postgres 数据库的 Linux 托管服务。免费版有 1 GB 存储和每月 1 GB 网络流量限制，且仅限使用免费域名。

entries.name: encore.dev
entries.desc_en: Backend framework using static analysis to provide automatic infrastructure, boilerplate-free code, and more. Includes free cloud hosting for hobby projects.
entries.desc_zh: 使用静态分析的后端框架，提供自动基础设施、无样板代码等特性。为业余爱好项目提供免费云托管。

entries.name: faable.com
entries.desc_en: Deploy apps with framework auto-detection for Python and Node.js. The free tier includes one 0.5 CPU / 1 GB RAM instance per project, 10 GB bandwidth, 10 successful deploys per day, automatic SSL and a built-in WAF, plus OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authentication. Apps sleep after 2 hours without traffic. European servers.
entries.desc_zh: 使用支持 Python 和 Node.js 框架自动检测的方式部署应用。免费层每个项目包含一个 0.5 CPU / 1 GB 内存实例、10 GB 带宽、每天 10 次成功部署、自动 SSL 和内置 WAF，以及 OAuth 2.0 / OIDC 认证。应用在无流量 2 小时后休眠。服务器位于欧洲。

entries.name: flightcontrol.dev
entries.desc_en: Deploy web services, databases, and more on your own AWS account with a Git push style workflow. Free tier for users with 1 developer on personal GitHub repos. AWS costs are billed through AWS, but you can use credits and the AWS free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 Git push 风格的工作流，在你自己的 AWS 账户上部署 Web 服务、数据库等。免费层面向个人 GitHub 仓库上只有 1 名开发者的用户。AWS 费用通过 AWS 计费，但你可以使用 credits 和 AWS 免费层。

entries.name: gigalixir.com
entries.desc_en: Gigalixir provides one free instance that never sleeps and a free-tier PostgreSQL database limited to 2 connections, 10, 000 rows and no backups for Elixir/Phoenix apps.
entries.desc_zh: Gigalixir 为 Elixir/Phoenix 应用提供一个永不休眠的免费实例，以及一个限制为 2 个连接、10,000 行且无备份的免费层 PostgreSQL 数据库。

entries.name: Northflank
entries.desc_en: Build and deploy microservices, jobs, and managed databases with a powerful UI, API & CLI. Seamlessly scale containers from version control and external Docker registries. The free tier includes two services, two cron jobs and 1 database.
entries.desc_zh: 使用强大的 UI、API 和 CLI 构建并部署微服务、任务和托管数据库。可从版本控制和外部 Docker 镜像仓库无缝扩展容器。免费层包含两个服务、两个 cron 任务和 1 个数据库。

entries.name: Ownkube
entries.desc_en: A cloud for personal software. Deploy apps, workers, jobs and managed databases with your coding agent, on prepaid credit from $5 that never expires. Free tier: the Starter plan runs everything on one instance in your own AWS account, no credit card needed (you pay AWS for the instance).
entries.desc_zh: 面向个人软件的云。使用你的编程智能体部署应用、worker、任务和托管数据库，预付额度从 $5 起，永不过期。免费层：Starter 计划在你自己 AWS 账户中的一个实例上运行所有内容，无需信用卡（实例费用由你支付给 AWS）。

entries.name: pipedream.com
entries.desc_en: An integration platform built for developers. Develop any workflow based on any trigger. Workflows are code you can run [for free](https://docs.pipedream.com/pricing/). No server or cloud resources to manage.
entries.desc_zh: 为开发者打造的集成平台。基于任意触发器开发任意工作流。工作流即代码，你可以 [for free](https://docs.pipedream.com/pricing/) 运行。无需管理任何服务器或云资源。

entries.name: pythonanywhere.com
entries.desc_en: Cloud Python app hosting. Beginner account is free, 1 Python web application at your-username.pythonanywhere.com domain, 512 MB private file storage, one MySQL database
entries.desc_zh: 云端 Python 应用托管。初学者账户免费，包含 1 个 Python Web 应用，域名为 your-username.pythonanywhere.com，512 MB 私有文件存储和一个 MySQL 数据库。

entries.name: Runsite
entries.desc_en: European PaaS with automated deployments from GitHub for web services or static sites (1 web 0.1 vCPU/256 MB free), managed PostgreSQL and Valkey(Redis) (30 days for free), Transactional Email (3,000 emails/month free), S3 compatible storage (5 GB/free), all what you need for start your web site. Servers located in Germany.
entries.desc_zh: 欧洲 PaaS，支持从 GitHub 自动部署 Web 服务或静态站点（免费 1 个 Web，0.1 vCPU/256 MB）、托管的 PostgreSQL 和 Valkey(Redis)（免费 30 天）、事务性邮件（每月免费 3,000 封）、S3 兼容存储（免费 5 GB），启动网站所需的一切应有尽有。服务器位于德国。

entries.name: SnapDeploy
entries.desc_en: Docker containers or GitHub repos, hosted on AWS. Free tier: up to 4 containers, 100 running hours a month, 10 deploys a day. Sleeps after 15 minutes idle and wakes on the next request. No credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 托管在 AWS 上的 Docker 容器或 GitHub 仓库。免费层：最多 4 个容器，每月 100 运行小时，每天 10 次部署。空闲 15 分钟后休眠，收到下一个请求时唤醒。无需信用卡。

entries.name: Staxa
entries.desc_en: Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.
entries.desc_zh: 多租户应用托管：通过 Web 应用或 API 集成，每个租户在隔离的 Kubernetes 命名空间中获得自己的应用、数据库、子域名和 TLS。免费层包含 2 个租户，每个租户最多 2 个服务（0.5 vCPU，512 MB）；免费应用在空闲 24 小时后休眠。

entries.name: The Vibe Hosting
entries.desc_en: Frictionless vibe hosting for coding agents. One curl gets your agent a root Linux box on an HTTPS subdomain within seconds. Free tier: 2-core, 512 MB server 24/7 with a verified phone, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 为编码代理提供无缝体验的托管服务。只需一条 curl 命令，即可在几秒钟内通过 HTTPS 子域为代理获取一台 root Linux 服务器。免费套餐：2 核、512 MB 服务器 24/7 运行，需验证手机号，无需信用卡。

entries.name: Val Town
entries.desc_en: Collaborative TypeScript/JavaScript serverless platform for scripts, HTTP endpoints, and cron jobs. Free plan includes unlimited public vals, 15-minute cron intervals, 1-minute wall-clock time per run, and 3-day log retention. No custom domains on free.
entries.desc_zh: 面向脚本、HTTP 端点和 cron 任务的协作式 TypeScript/JavaScript 无服务器平台。免费计划包含不限量的公开 vals、15 分钟的 cron 间隔、每次运行 1 分钟的墙钟时间以及 3 天的日志保留。免费版不支持自定义域名。

entries.name: velixir
entries.desc_en: EU-hosted PaaS that builds web apps from source in any language (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, Elixir, Rust, .NET and more), no Dockerfile needed. The free tier includes one app (0.25 vCPU, 256 MB RAM) that sleeps when idle, custom domains with TLS, and no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 托管于欧盟的 PaaS，可用任何语言（Node.js、Python、Go、Ruby、PHP、Java、Elixir、Rust、.NET 等）从源码构建 Web 应用，无需 Dockerfile。免费层包含一个应用（0.25 vCPU，256 MB 内存），空闲时休眠；支持带 TLS 的自定义域名，且无需信用卡。

entries.name: WunderGraph
entries.desc_en: An open-source platform that allows you to  quickly build, ship and manage modern APIs. Built-in CI/CD, GitHub integration, and automatic HTTPS. Up to 3 projects, 1GB egress, 300 minutes of build time per month on the [free plan](https://wundergraph.com/pricing)
entries.desc_zh: 一个开源平台，帮助你快速构建、发布和管理现代 API。内置 CI/CD、GitHub 集成和自动 HTTPS。通过 [free plan](https://wundergraph.com/pricing)，每月可获得最多 3 个项目、1GB 出站流量和 300 分钟构建时间。

entries.name: YepCode
entries.desc_en: All-in-one platform to connect APIs and services in a serverless environment. It brings all the agility and benefits of NoCode tools but with all the power of using programming languages. The free tier includes [1.000 yeps](https://yepcode.io/pricing/).
entries.desc_zh: 一体化平台，可在无服务器环境中连接 API 和服务。它兼具 NoCode 工具的全部敏捷性与优势，同时拥有使用编程语言的全部强大能力。免费层包含 [1.000 yeps](https://yepcode.io/pricing/)。

entries.name: Activepieces
entries.desc_en: Build automation flows to connect several apps together in your app's backend. For example, send a Slack message or add a Google Sheet row when an event fires in your app. Free up to 5,000 tasks per month.
entries.desc_zh: 构建自动化流程，在你的应用后端将多个应用连接起来。例如，当你的应用中触发某个事件时，发送 Slack 消息或在 Google Sheet 中添加一行。免费额度为每月最多 5,000 个任务。

entries.name: back4app.com
entries.desc_en: Back4App is an easy-to-use, flexible and scalable backend based on Parse Platform.
entries.desc_zh: Back4App 是一个基于 Parse Platform 的易于使用、灵活且可扩展的后端。

entries.name: backendless.com
entries.desc_en: Mobile and Web Baas, with 1 GB file storage free, push notifications of 50,000/month, and 1000 data objects in the table.
entries.desc_zh: 移动和 Web BaaS，免费提供 1 GB 文件存储、每月 50,000 条推送通知，以及表中 1,000 个数据对象。

entries.name: connectycube.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited chat messages, p2p voice & video calls, files attachments and push notifications. Free for apps up to 1000 users.
entries.desc_zh: 不限量聊天消息、p2p 语音和视频通话、文件附件及推送通知。对最多 1000 名用户的应用免费。

entries.name: convex.dev
entries.desc_en: Reactive backend as a service, hosting your data (documents with relationships & serializable ACID transactions), serverless functions, and WebSockets to stream updates to various clients. Free for small projects - up to 1M records, 5M monthly function calls.
entries.desc_zh: 响应式后端即服务，托管你的数据（带关系的文档和可序列化的 ACID 事务）、无服务器函数，以及向各类客户端流式推送更新的 WebSocket。对小项目免费——最多 100 万条记录、每月 500 万次函数调用。

entries.name: ETLR
entries.desc_en: Define, version, and deploy automation scripts using YAML. A developer-first alternative to drag-and-drop tools. Can be used for scheduled tasks, AI agents, and infrastructure monitoring. Free tier includes 100 credits/month.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 YAML 定义、版本化并部署自动化脚本。以开发者为先的拖拽式工具替代方案。可用于定时任务、AI 智能体和基础设施监控。免费层包含每月 100 个 credits。

entries.name: Flutter Flow
entries.desc_en: Build your Flutter App UI without writing a single line of code. Also has a Firebase integration. The free plan includes full access to UI Builder and Free templates.
entries.desc_zh: 无需编写任何一行代码即可构建你的 Flutter 应用 UI。还提供 Firebase 集成。免费计划包含对 UI Builder 的完全访问权限和免费模板。

entries.name: getstream.io
entries.desc_en: Build scalable In-App Chat, Messaging, Video and audio, and Feeds in a few hours instead of weeks
entries.desc_zh: 用几个小时而非几周，构建可扩展的应用内聊天、消息传递、视频与音频以及信息流。

entries.name: IFTTT
entries.desc_en: Automate your favorite apps and devices. Free 2 Applets
entries.desc_zh: 自动化你喜爱的应用和设备。免费 2 个 Applet。

entries.name: Integrately
entries.desc_en: Automate tedious tasks with a single click. Free 100 Tasks, 15 Minute
entries.desc_zh: 一键自动化繁琐任务。免费 100 个任务、15 分钟。

entries.name: LeanCloud
entries.desc_en: Mobile backend. 1GB of data storage, 256MB instance, 3K API requests/day, and 10K pushes/day are free. (API is very similar to Parse Platform)
entries.desc_zh: 移动后端。免费提供 1GB 数据存储、256MB 实例、每天 3,000 次 API 请求和每天 10,000 次推送。（API 与 Parse Platform 非常相似）

entries.name: nhost.io
entries.desc_en: Serverless backend for web and mobile apps. The free plan includes PostgreSQL, GraphQL (Hasura), Authentication, Storage, and Serverless Functions.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web 和移动应用的无服务器后端。免费计划包含 PostgreSQL、GraphQL (Hasura)、身份认证、存储和无服务器函数。

entries.name: onesignal.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited free push notifications. 10,000 email sends per month, with unlimited contacts and access to Auto Warm Up.
entries.desc_zh: 无限免费推送通知。每月 10,000 封邮件发送，联系人数量不限，并可使用 Auto Warm Up 功能。

entries.name: paraio.com
entries.desc_en: Backend service API with flexible authentication, full-text search and caching. Free for one app, 1GB of app data.
entries.desc_zh: 具备灵活身份认证、全文搜索和缓存的后端服务 API。单个应用免费，含 1GB 应用数据。

entries.name: pubnub.com
entries.desc_en: Free push notifications for up to 1 million messages/month and 100 active daily devices
entries.desc_zh: 免费推送通知，每月最多 100 万条消息，每日 100 台活跃设备。

entries.name: pusher.com
entries.desc_en: Free, unlimited push notifications for 2000 monthly active users. A single API for iOS and Android devices.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 2,000 名月活跃用户的免费无限推送通知。为 iOS 和 Android 设备提供单一 API。

entries.name: simperium.com
entries.desc_en: Move data everywhere instantly and automatically, multi-platform, unlimited sending and storage of structured data, max. 2,500 users/month
entries.desc_zh: 即时、自动地将数据移动到各处，多平台，结构化数据的发送和存储不限量，每月最多 2,500 名用户。

entries.name: snill.ai
entries.desc_en: AI no-code platform that turns a plain-language description into a complete business system with a relational database, dashboards, workflows, REST API and webhooks. Free plan for solo operators includes 2 apps, 1,000 records and 10 AI requests/day.
entries.desc_zh: AI 无代码平台，可将自然语言描述转化为包含关系型数据库、仪表板、工作流、REST API 和 webhook 的完整业务系统。面向单人使用者的免费计划包含 2 个应用、1,000 条记录和每天 10 次 AI 请求。

entries.name: Supabase
entries.desc_en: The Open Source Firebase Alternative to build backends. Free Plan offers Authentication, Realtime Database & Object Storage.
entries.desc_zh: 开源的 Firebase 替代品，用于构建后端。免费计划提供身份认证、实时数据库和对象存储。

entries.name: tyk.io
entries.desc_en: API management with authentication, quotas, monitoring and analytics. Free cloud offering
entries.desc_zh: 具备身份认证、配额、监控和分析功能的 API 管理。提供免费云版本。

entries.name: zapier.com
entries.desc_en: Connect the apps you use to automate tasks. Five zaps every 15 minutes and 100 tasks/month
entries.desc_zh: 连接你常用的应用来自动化任务。每 15 分钟 5 个 zaps，每月 100 个任务。

entries.name: appsmith
entries.desc_en: Low code project to build admin panels, internal tools, and dashboards. Integrates with 15+ databases and any API.
entries.desc_zh: 用于构建管理面板、内部工具和仪表板的低代码项目。可与 15 种以上数据库及任意 API 集成。

entries.name: BudiBase
entries.desc_en: Budibase is an open-source low-code platform for creating internal apps in minutes. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, MongoDB, Rest API, Docker, K8s
entries.desc_zh: Budibase 是一个开源低代码平台，可在几分钟内创建内部应用。支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MSSQL、MongoDB、Rest API、Docker、K8s。

entries.name: Clappia
entries.desc_en: A low-code platform designed for building business process applications with customizable mobile and web apps. Offers a drag-and-drop interface, features like Offline Support, real-time location tracking and integration with various third-party services
entries.desc_zh: 一个专为构建业务流程应用而设计的低代码平台，支持可自定义的移动端和 Web 应用。提供拖放式界面，以及离线支持、实时位置追踪和与各类第三方服务的集成等功能。

entries.name: lil'bots
entries.desc_en: write and run scripts online utilizing free built-in APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Firecrawl and others. Great for building AI agents / internal tooling and sharing with team. Free-tier includes full access to APIs, AI coding assistant and 10,000 execution credits / month.
entries.desc_zh: 在线编写和运行脚本，可使用 OpenAI、Anthropic、Firecrawl 等免费内置 API。非常适合构建 AI 智能体/内部工具并与团队共享。免费层包含对所有 API 的完全访问、AI 编程助手以及每月 10,000 个执行额度。

entries.name: manubes
entries.desc_en: Powerful no-code cloud platform with a focus on industrial production management. Free for one user with 1 million workflow activities a month ([also available in german](https://www.manubes.de)).
entries.desc_zh: 强大的无代码云平台，专注于工业生产管理。单个用户免费，每月 100 万次工作流活动（[also available in german](https://www.manubes.de)）。

entries.name: Mendix
entries.desc_en: Rapid Application Development for Enterprises, unlimited accessible sandbox environments supporting total users, 0.5 GB storage and 1 GB RAM per app. Also, Studio and Studio Pro IDEs are allowed in the free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 面向企业的快速应用开发，提供支持全部用户的、数量不限的可用沙箱环境，每个应用 0.5 GB 存储空间和 1 GB 内存。此外，免费层还允许使用 Studio 和 Studio Pro IDE。

entries.name: outsystems.com
entries.desc_en: Enterprise web development PaaS for on-premise or cloud, free "personal environment" offering allows for unlimited code and up to 1 GB database
entries.desc_zh: 面向本地部署或云端的企业级 Web 开发 PaaS，免费“personal environment”方案允许无限制的代码以及最多 1 GB 的数据库。

entries.name: ReTool
entries.desc_en: Low-code platform for building internal applications. Retool is highly hackable. If you can write it with JavaScript and an API, you can make it in Retool. The free tier allows up to five users per month, unlimited apps and API connections.
entries.desc_zh: 用于构建内部应用的低代码平台。Retool 高度灵活可定制。只要你能用 JavaScript 和 API 写出来，就能在 Retool 中实现。免费层每月最多允许 5 个用户，应用和 API 连接数量不限。

entries.name: ToolJet
entries.desc_en: Extensible low-code framework for building business applications. Connect to databases, cloud storages, GraphQL, API endpoints, Airtable, etc., and build apps using drag-and-drop application builder.
entries.desc_zh: 用于构建业务应用的可扩展低代码框架。可连接数据库、云存储、GraphQL、API 端点、Airtable 等，并使用拖拽式应用构建器来构建应用。

entries.name: UI Bakery
entries.desc_en: Low-code platform that enables faster building of custom web applications. Supports building UI using drag and drop with a high level of customization through JavaScript, Python, and SQL. Available as both cloud and self-hosted solutions. Free for up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 可更快构建自定义 Web 应用的低代码平台。支持通过拖拽方式构建 UI，并可通过 JavaScript、Python 和 SQL 进行高度自定义。同时提供云端和自托管两种方案。最多 5 名用户免费。

entries.name: Alwaysdata
entries.desc_en: 1 GB free web hosting with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, .NET, Deno, Elixir, Go, Java, Lua, Node.js, PHP, Python, Ruby, Rust. Custom web servers, access via FTP, WebDAV and SSH. Mailbox, mailing list and app installer included. No custom domain on free plan.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 1 GB 免费网页托管，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、RabbitMQ、.NET、Deno、Elixir、Go、Java、Lua、Node.js、PHP、Python、Ruby、Rust。可使用自定义 Web 服务器，并通过 FTP、WebDAV 和 SSH 访问。包含邮箱、邮件列表和应用安装器。免费套餐不支持自定义域名。

entries.name: Awardspace.com
entries.desc_en: Free web hosting + a free short domain, PHP, MySQL, App Installer, Email Sending & No Ads.
entries.desc_zh: 免费网页托管 + 免费短域名、PHP、MySQL、应用安装器、邮件发送功能，且无广告。

entries.name: boomurl
entries.desc_en: Publish static sites (HTML/Markdown/images/PDF or a whole folder) to an instant HTTPS URL with no account; free tier shows a small banner. Custom domains supported.
entries.desc_zh: 无需账号即可将静态网站（HTML/Markdown/图片/PDF 或整个文件夹）发布到即时可用的 HTTPS URL；免费层会显示一个小横幅。支持自定义域名。

entries.name: Bubble
entries.desc_en: Visual programming to build web and mobile apps without code, free with Bubble branding.
entries.desc_zh: 无需代码即可通过可视化编程构建 Web 和移动应用，免费使用但带有 Bubble 品牌标识。

entries.name: dAppling Network
entries.desc_en: Decentralized web hosting platform for Web3 frontends focusing on increasing uptime and security and providing an additional access point for users.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web3 前端的去中心化网页托管平台，专注于提升正常运行时间和安全性，并为用户提供额外的访问入口。

entries.name: DigitalOcean
entries.desc_en: Build and deploy three static sites for free on the App Platform Starter tier.
entries.desc_zh: 可在 App Platform Starter 套餐上免费构建并部署三个静态网站。

entries.name: FreeFlarum
entries.desc_en: Community-powered free Flarum hosting for up to 250 users (donate to remove the watermark from the footer).
entries.desc_zh: 由社区支持的免费 Flarum 托管，最多支持 250 名用户（捐赠可去除页脚水印）。

entries.name: Harvis.dev
entries.desc_en: Static site hosting via CLI (`npx harvis`) with no config files or build step. Includes free subdomain, free form submissions collections, GitHub Actions integration, CloudFlare CDN, free SSL.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 CLI（`npx harvis`）进行静态网站托管，无需配置文件或构建步骤。包含免费子域名、免费表单提交收集、GitHub Actions 集成、CloudFlare CDN 和免费 SSL。

entries.name: Koyeb
entries.desc_en: Serverless platform with a free Hobby plan providing 550 free compute hours/month (512 MB RAM Free tier), 1 free PostgreSQL database, and custom domain SSL.
entries.desc_zh: 无服务器平台，其免费 Hobby 计划提供每月 550 小时免费计算时长（免费层为 512 MB 内存）、1 个免费 PostgreSQL 数据库以及自定义域名 SSL。

entries.name: MDB GO
entries.desc_en: Free hosting for one project with two weeks Container TTL, 500 MB RAM per project, SFTP - 1G disk space.
entries.desc_zh: 为一个项目提供免费托管，容器 TTL 为两周，每个项目 500 MB 内存，SFTP - 1G 磁盘空间。

entries.name: Mirin
entries.desc_en: Website platform for developer-built React, Vue, or Svelte component sites with visual editing, forms, analytics, and global CDN hosting. Free tier includes 1 site with unlimited pages and submissions.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者构建 React、Vue 或 Svelte 组件网站的网站平台，提供可视化编辑、表单、分析和全球 CDN 托管。免费层包含 1 个站点，页面和提交数量不限。

entries.name: Neocities
entries.desc_en: Static, 1 GB free storage with 200 GB Bandwidth.
entries.desc_zh: 静态托管，1 GB 免费存储空间和 200 GB 带宽。

entries.name: Netlify
entries.desc_en: Builds, deploys and hosts static site/app free for 300 credits/month (equals 30 GB bandwidth).
entries.desc_zh: 免费构建、部署并托管静态网站/应用，每月 300 积分（相当于 30 GB 带宽）。

entries.name: PandaStack
entries.desc_en: An eco-system for developers includes web hosting in different formats (static web hosting, container based web hosting, wordpress and so many other managed apps available in couple of clicks ). One free web hosting (static or containered) and one free database with 100GB Bandwidth and 300 Build mins/month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的生态系统，包含多种形式的网页托管（静态网页托管、基于容器的网页托管、WordPress 以及许多其他托管应用，点击几下即可使用）。提供一个免费网页托管（静态或容器化）和一个免费数据库，附带 100GB 带宽和每月 300 分钟构建时长。

entries.name: pantheon.io
entries.desc_en: Drupal and WordPress hosting, automated DevOps, and scalable infrastructure. Free for developers and agencies. No custom domain.
entries.desc_zh: Drupal 和 WordPress 托管、自动化 DevOps 以及可扩展的基础设施。对开发者和代理商免费。不支持自定义域名。

entries.name: Qoddi
entries.desc_en: PaaS service similar to Heroku with a developer-centric approach and all-inclusive features. Free tier for static assets, staging, and developer apps.
entries.desc_zh: 类似 Heroku 的 PaaS 服务，以开发者为中心并提供全套功能。免费层适用于静态资源、预发布环境和开发者应用。

entries.name: readthedocs.org
entries.desc_en: Free documentation hosting with versioning, PDF generation, and more
entries.desc_zh: 免费文档托管，支持版本管理、PDF 生成等更多功能。

entries.name: render.com
entries.desc_en: Unified cloud to build and run apps and sites with free SSL, a global CDN, private networks, auto-deploys from Git, and completely free plans for web services, databases, and static web pages.
entries.desc_zh: 统一的云平台，可用于构建和运行应用与网站，提供免费 SSL、全球 CDN、私有网络、从 Git 自动部署，以及针对 Web 服务、数据库和静态网页的完全免费方案。

entries.name: Revdoku
entries.desc_en: Publish files, reports, custom microsites right from ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other AI agents as public or password-protected websites. Free tier: 2GB storage, 2 live sites/apps, 1 database (25 MB), 3 AI connections, 1k files/bucket (100 MB/file), basic analytics.
entries.desc_zh: 可直接从 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex 及其他 AI 智能体发布文件、报告和自定义微型网站，作为公开或受密码保护的网站。免费层：2GB 存储空间、2 个在线站点/应用、1 个数据库（25 MB）、3 个 AI 连接、每个存储桶 1k 个文件（每文件 100 MB）、基础分析功能。

entries.name: ShipStatic
entries.desc_en: Static hosting your AI agent can drive itself: `npx @shipstatic/ship ./dist` and the site is live, with no install, no signup, no repo, no build. MCP, SDK and API too. Free accounts keep sites permanently with automatic HTTPS, global edge delivery and unmetered bandwidth; custom domains are paid.
entries.desc_zh: 静态托管服务，你的 AI agent 可自行操作：运行 `npx @shipstatic/ship ./dist`，网站即可上线，无需安装、无需注册、无需仓库、无需构建。同时提供 MCP、SDK 和 API。免费账户可永久保留网站，并享有自动 HTTPS、全球边缘分发和不限流量带宽；自定义域名需付费。

entries.name: SourceForge
entries.desc_en: Find, Create, and Publish Open Source software for free
entries.desc_zh: 免费查找、创建和发布开源软件

entries.name: surge.sh
entries.desc_en: Static web publishing for Front-End developers. Unlimited sites with custom domain support
entries.desc_zh: 面向前端开发者的静态网页发布服务。站点数量不限，并支持自定义域名。

entries.name: tilda.cc
entries.desc_en: One site, 50 pages, 50 MB storage, only the main pre-defined blocks among 170+ available, no fonts, no favicon, and no custom domain
entries.desc_zh: 一个网站，50 页，50 MB 存储空间，仅限 170+ 个可用预定义区块中的主要区块，无字体、无网站图标、无自定义域名

entries.name: Vercel
entries.desc_en: Build, deploy, and host web apps with free SSL, global CDN, and unique Preview URLs each time you `git push`. Perfect for Next.js and other Static Site Generators.
entries.desc_zh: 构建、部署和托管 Web 应用，提供免费 SSL、全球 CDN，以及每次 `git push` 时生成的唯一预览 URL。非常适合 Next.js 和其他静态网站生成器。

entries.name: Versoly
entries.desc_en: SaaS-focused website builder - unlimited websites, 70+ blocks, five templates, custom CSS, favicon, SEO and forms. No custom domain.
entries.desc_zh: 专注 SaaS 的网站构建工具 - 不限数量的网站、70+ 个区块、五个模板、自定义 CSS、favicon、SEO 和表单。不支持自定义域名。

entries.name: Stormkit
