entries.desc_en: Self-hostable Vercel alternative for building, hosting, and deploying modern frontend and JavaScript applications. Free plan includes 1 app, 50 GB bandwidth, unlimited custom domains, and free SSL.
entries.desc_zh: 可自托管的 Vercel 替代方案，用于构建、托管和部署现代前端及 JavaScript 应用。免费计划包含 1 个应用、50 GB 带宽、不限数量的自定义域名以及免费 SSL。

entries.desc_en: Free public DNS Resolver, which is fast and secure (encrypt your DNS query), provided by Cloudflare. Useful to bypass your internet provider's DNS blocking, prevent DNS query spying, and [to block adult & malware content](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/1.1.1.1-for-families). It can also be used [via API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encrypted-dns/dns-over-https/make-api-requests). Note: Just a DNS resolver, not a DNS hoster.
entries.desc_zh: 由 Cloudflare 提供的免费公共 DNS 解析器，快速且安全（加密你的 DNS 查询）。可用于绕过网络运营商的 DNS 封锁、防止 DNS 查询被窥探，以及 [to block adult & malware content](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/1.1.1.1-for-families)。它还可以 [via API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encrypted-dns/dns-over-https/make-api-requests) 使用。注意：只是一个 DNS 解析器，并非 DNS 托管商。

entries.name: 1984.is
entries.desc_en: Free DNS service with API and lots of other free DNS features included.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 服务，包含 API 以及许多其他免费 DNS 功能。

entries.name: cloudns.net
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting up to 1 domain with 50 records
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 托管，最多支持 1 个域名和 50 条记录。

entries.name: deSEC
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting with API support, designed with security in mind. Runs on open-source software and is supported by [SSE](https://www.securesystems.de/).
entries.desc_zh: 支持 API 的免费 DNS 托管，以安全为设计理念。运行于开源软件之上，并由 [SSE](https://www.securesystems.de/) 支持。

entries.name: dns.he.net
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting service with Dynamic DNS Support
entries.desc_zh: 带动态 DNS 支持的免费 DNS 托管服务。

entries.name: dnspod.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 托管。

entries.name: duckdns.org
entries.desc_en: Free DDNS with up to 5 domains on the free tier. With configuration guides for various setups.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DDNS，免费层最多支持 5 个域名。附带针对各种配置场景的设置指南。

entries.name: Dynv6.com
entries.desc_en: Free DDNS service with [API support](https://dynv6.com/docs/apis) and management of a lot of dns record types (like CNAME, MX, SPF, SRV, TXT and others).
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DDNS 服务，提供 [API support](https://dynv6.com/docs/apis)，支持管理多种 DNS 记录类型（如 CNAME、MX、SPF、SRV、TXT 等）。

entries.name: freedns.afraid.org
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting. Also, provide free subdomains based on numerous public user [contributed domains](https://freedns.afraid.org/domain/registry/). Get free subdomains from the "Subdomains" menu after signing up.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 托管。此外，还基于众多公开的用户 [contributed domains](https://freedns.afraid.org/domain/registry/) 提供免费子域名。注册后可在“Subdomains”菜单中获取免费子域名。

entries.name: Glauca
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting for up to 3 domains and DNSSEC support
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 托管，最多支持 3 个域名，并提供 DNSSEC 支持

entries.name: Hetzner
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting from Hetzner with API support.
entries.desc_zh: Hetzner 提供的免费 DNS 托管，支持 API。

entries.name: huaweicloud.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting by Huawei
entries.desc_zh: Huawei 提供的免费 DNS 托管

entries.name: LocalCert
entries.desc_en: Free `.localcert.net` subdomains compatible with public CAs for use with-in private networks
entries.desc_zh: 免费 `.localcert.net` 子域名，与公共 CA 兼容，适用于私有网络内部使用。

entries.name: luadns.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting, three domains, all features with reasonable limits
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 托管，三个域名，所有功能均设有合理限制

entries.name: namecheap.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS. No limit on the number of domains
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS。域名数量无限制

entries.name: nextdns.io
entries.desc_en: DNS-based firewall, 300K free queries monthly
entries.desc_zh: 基于 DNS 的防火墙，每月 30 万次免费查询

entries.name: noip.at
entries.desc_en: Free DDNS service without registration, tracking, logging or advertising. No limit to domains.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DDNS 服务，无需注册，无跟踪、日志记录或广告。域名数量无限制。

entries.name: noip
entries.desc_en: a dynamic DNS service that allows up to 3 hostnames free with confirmation every 30 days
entries.desc_zh: 一个动态 DNS 服务，免费提供最多 3 个主机名，需每 30 天确认一次

entries.name: sslip.io
entries.desc_en: Free DNS service that when queried with a hostname with an embedded IP address returns that IP address.
entries.desc_zh: 免费 DNS 服务，当查询包含内嵌 IP 地址的主机名时会返回该 IP 地址。

entries.name: zilore.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting for 5 domains.
entries.desc_zh: 5 个域名的免费 DNS 托管。

entries.name: zoneedit.com
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting with Dynamic DNS Support.
entries.desc_zh: 支持动态 DNS 的免费 DNS 托管。

entries.name: Zonomi
entries.desc_en: Free DNS hosting service with instant DNS propagation. Free plan: 1 DNS zone (domain name) with up to 10 DNS records.
entries.desc_zh: 具备即时 DNS 传播的免费 DNS 托管服务。免费套餐：1 个 DNS 区域（域名），最多 10 条 DNS 记录。

entries.name: DigitalPlat
entries.desc_en: Free subdomains.
entries.desc_zh: 免费子域名。

entries.name: DNSHE
entries.desc_en: Free subdomain registration across multiple domain suffixes, with custom nameserver support.
entries.desc_zh: 跨多个域名后缀的免费子域名注册，支持自定义 nameserver。

entries.name: isroot.in
entries.desc_en: Free isroot.in subdomains.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 isroot.in 子域名。

entries.name: pp.ua
entries.desc_en: Free pp.ua subdomains.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的 pp.ua 子域名。

entries.name: 4EVERLAND
entries.desc_en: Compatible with AWS S3 - APIs, interface operations, CLI, and other upload methods, upload and store files from the IPFS and Arweave networks in a safe, convenient, and efficient manner. Registered users can get 6 GB of IPFS storage and 300MB of Arweave storage for free. Any Arweave file uploads smaller than 150 KB are free.
entries.desc_zh: 兼容 AWS S3——支持 API、界面操作、CLI 等上传方式，以安全、便捷、高效的方式上传并存储来自 IPFS 和 Arweave 网络的文件。注册用户可免费获得 6 GB IPFS 存储空间和 300MB Arweave 存储空间。小于 150 KB 的 Arweave 文件上传免费。

entries.name: backblaze.com
entries.desc_en: Backblaze B2 cloud storage. Free 10 GB (Amazon S3-like) object storage for unlimited time
entries.desc_zh: Backblaze B2 云存储。免费提供 10 GB（类似 Amazon S3 的）对象存储，无时间限制

entries.name: filebase.com
entries.desc_en: S3 Compatible Object Storage Powered by Blockchain. 5 GB free storage for an unlimited duration.
entries.desc_zh: 由区块链驱动的 S3 兼容对象存储。免费提供 5 GB 存储空间，时长不限。

entries.name: Modal
entries.desc_en: AI-driven IaaS with generous compute, storage; offers $30 (might be limited to $5 on certain accounts) of free monthly credits
entries.desc_zh: AI 驱动的 IaaS，提供充足的计算和存储资源；每月提供 $30 免费额度（某些账户可能被限制为 $5）

entries.name: 8base.com
entries.desc_en: 8base is a full-stack low-code development platform built for JavaScript developers built on top of MySQL and GraphQL and serverless backend-as-a-service. It allows you to start building web applications quickly using a UI app builder and scale quickly, The Free tier includes rows: 2,500, Storage: 500, Serverless computing: 1Gb/h, and client app users: 5.
entries.desc_zh: 8base 是一个专为 JavaScript 开发者打造的全栈低代码开发平台，构建于 MySQL 和 GraphQL 之上，并提供无服务器后端即服务（serverless backend-as-a-service）。它让你可以通过 UI 应用构建器快速开始构建 Web 应用并快速扩展。免费层包含：行数 2,500、存储 500、无服务器计算 1Gb/h、客户端应用用户 5 个。

entries.name: airtable.com
entries.desc_en: Looks like a spreadsheet, but it's a relational database unlimited bases, 1,200 rows/base, and 1,000 API requests/month
entries.desc_zh: 看起来像电子表格，实际上是关系型数据库——base 数量不限，每个 base 1,200 行，每月 1,000 次 API 请求

entries.name: Aiven
entries.desc_en: Aiven offers free PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey (Redis compatible) plans on its open-source data platform. Single node, 1 CPU, 1GB RAM, and for PostgreSQL and MySQL, 1GB storage. Easy migration to more extensive plans or across clouds.
entries.desc_zh: Aiven 在其开源数据平台上提供免费的 PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 Valkey（兼容 Redis）套餐。单节点，1 CPU，1GB 内存，PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 还包含 1GB 存储。可轻松迁移至更大的套餐或跨云迁移。

entries.name: BackupDrill
entries.desc_en: Backs up Supabase projects to your own S3/R2/B2 bucket, then runs scheduled restore drills to prove backups restore. Provides a free plan with weekly backups for one project and one restore drill on your first backup.
entries.desc_zh: 将 Supabase 项目备份到你自己的 S3/R2/B2 存储桶，然后运行定时恢复演练，以证明备份可以恢复。提供免费套餐：为一个项目提供每周备份，并在首次备份时提供一次恢复演练。

entries.name: CockroachDB Cloud
entries.desc_en: Free tier offers 50 million RUs and 10 GiB of storage (same as 15$ worth) free per month. ([What's the Request Units](https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/cockroachcloud/metrics-request-units.html))
entries.desc_zh: 免费层每月免费提供 5000 万 RUs 和 10 GiB 存储空间（价值相当于 $15）。([What's the Request Units](https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/cockroachcloud/metrics-request-units.html))

entries.name: codehooks.io
entries.desc_en: Easy to use JavaScript serverless API/backend and NoSQL database service with functions, Mongdb-ish queries, key/value lookups, a job system, realtime messages, worker queues, a powerful CLI and a web-based data manager. Free plan has 5GB storage and 60/API calls per minute. 2 developers included. No credit-card required.
entries.desc_zh: 易于使用的 JavaScript 无服务器 API/后端及 NoSQL 数据库服务，具备函数、类 MongoDB 查询、键/值查找、作业系统、实时消息、工作队列、强大的 CLI 以及基于网页的数据管理器。免费套餐包含 5GB 存储空间和每分钟 60 次 API 调用。包含 2 名开发者。无需信用卡。

entries.name: Couchbase Capella
entries.desc_en: deploy a forever free tier fully managed database cluster with 1 node and 8GB storage, built for developers to create the next generation of applications across IoT to AI
entries.desc_zh: 部署永久免费的完全托管数据库集群，含 1 个节点和 8GB 存储，专为开发者打造，用于构建从 IoT 到 AI 的下一代应用

entries.name: CrateDB
entries.desc_en: Distributed Open Source SQL database for real-time analytics. [Free Tier CRFREE](https://crate.io/lp-crfree): One-node with 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, 8 GiB of storage. One cluster per organization, no payment method needed.
entries.desc_zh: 用于实时分析的开源分布式 SQL 数据库。[Free Tier CRFREE](https://crate.io/lp-crfree)：单节点，2 个 CPU，2 GiB 内存，8 GiB 存储。每个组织一个集群，无需提供支付方式。

entries.name: filess.io
entries.desc_en: filess.io is a platform where you can create two databases with up to 10 MB per database of the following DBMS for free: MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
entries.desc_zh: filess.io 是一个平台，你可以免费创建两个数据库（每个数据库最多 10 MB），支持以下 DBMS：MySQL、MariaDB、MongoDB 和 PostgreSQL。

entries.name: InfluxDB
entries.desc_en: Timeseries database, free up to 3MB/5 minutes writes, 30MB/5 minutes reads and 10,000 cardinalities series
entries.desc_zh: 时序数据库，免费提供每 5 分钟最多 3MB 写入、每 5 分钟 30MB 读取以及 10,000 个基数的序列

entries.name: Layerbase
entries.desc_en: 2 free managed databases, pick from: Postgres, MariaDB, Redis, Valkey, DuckDB, SQLite, libSQL, and TypeDB. All with TLS. Branch 7 of 8 free engines, 1 branch per database - 10 GB/day, 50 GB/week, 150 GB/month throughput limits on free. 10 additional engines available on higher tiers with no meters.
entries.desc_zh: 2 个免费托管数据库，可从以下选择：Postgres、MariaDB、Redis、Valkey、DuckDB、SQLite、libSQL 和 TypeDB。全部支持 TLS。8 个免费引擎中有 7 个支持分支（Branch），每个数据库 1 个分支——免费版吞吐量限制为每天 10 GB、每周 50 GB、每月 150 GB。更高级别套餐还提供 10 个额外引擎，且不计使用量。

entries.name: MemCachier
entries.desc_en: Managed Memcache service. Free for up to 25MB, 1 Proxy Server, and basic analytics
entries.desc_zh: 托管 Memcache 服务。免费提供最高 25MB、1 个代理服务器以及基础分析功能

entries.name: MongoDB Atlas
entries.desc_en: free tier gives 512 MB
entries.desc_zh: 免费层提供 512 MB

entries.name: Neo4j Aura
entries.desc_en: Managed native Graph DBMS / analytics platform with a Cypher query language and a REST API. Limits on graph size (200k nodes, 400k relationships).
entries.desc_zh: 托管原生图 DBMS/分析平台，支持 Cypher 查询语言和 REST API。图大小有限制（20 万节点，40 万关系）。

entries.name: Neon
entries.desc_en: Managed Postgres, 0.5 GB of storage per project, 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU, scales to zero after 5 minutes. Includes S3-compatible Object Storage with 5 GB per project that branches with the database. 5 GB of network transfer per project, shared across all products.
entries.desc_zh: 托管 Postgres，每个项目 0.5 GB 存储，100 个项目，每个项目 10 个分支，每个项目每月 100 CU-hours 计算量，自动扩展至最高 2 CU，5 分钟后缩容至零。包含 S3 兼容对象存储，每个项目 5 GB，随数据库一起分支。每个项目 5 GB 网络传输，在所有产品间共享。

entries.name: Nile
entries.desc_en: A Postgres platform for B2B apps. Unlimited databases, Always available with no shutdown, 1GB of storage (total), 50 million query tokens, autoscaling, unlimited vector embeddings
entries.desc_zh: 面向 B2B 应用的 Postgres 平台。数据库数量不限，始终可用、不停机，1GB 存储（总量），5000 万查询令牌，自动扩展，向量嵌入数量不限

entries.name: Prisma Postgres
entries.desc_en: Super fast hosted Postgres (PostgreSQL 17) built on unikernels and running on bare metal, with zero cold starts. Free plan includes 1.01 GB storage, 200k operations per month and 50 databases, no credit card required. Works with any Postgres client or ORM.
entries.desc_zh: 构建于 unikernel 之上、运行在裸金属上的超快托管 Postgres（PostgreSQL 17），零冷启动。免费套餐包含 1.01 GB 存储、每月 20 万次操作和 50 个数据库，无需信用卡。可与任何 Postgres 客户端或 ORM 配合使用。

entries.name: Qdrant
entries.desc_en: Vector Database for embedding data, single node cluster with 0.5 vCPU, 1GB RAM, and 4GB disk.
entries.desc_zh: 用于嵌入数据的向量数据库，单节点集群，配备 0.5 vCPU、1GB 内存和 4GB 磁盘。

entries.name: restdb.io
entries.desc_en: a fast and straightforward NoSQL cloud database service. With restdb.io you get schema, relations, automatic REST API (with MongoDB-like queries), and an efficient multi-user admin UI for working with data. The free plan allows 3 users, 2500 records, and 1 API request per second.
entries.desc_zh: 快速而简洁的 NoSQL 云数据库服务。通过 restdb.io，你可以获得 schema、关系、自动 REST API（支持类 MongoDB 查询），以及用于处理数据的高效多用户管理界面。免费套餐允许 3 个用户、2500 条记录和每秒 1 次 API 请求。

entries.name: ReviveDB
entries.desc_en: A way back for your Supabase app. ReviveDB keeps recovery points of your database and Auth, Storage files, Edge Functions and supported project configuration, and only calls a backup ready once your database has been restored from it and compared. The free plan covers one project with weekly backups and three recovery points.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的 Supabase 应用提供一条退路。ReviveDB 为你的数据库以及 Auth、Storage 文件、Edge Functions 和受支持的项目配置保存恢复点，只有当你的数据库从某个备份中恢复并完成比对后，该备份才会被视为就绪。免费计划覆盖一个项目，提供每周备份和三个恢复点。

entries.name: SeaTable
entries.desc_en: Flexible, Spreadsheet-like Database built by the Seafile team. unlimited tables, 2,000 lines, 1-month versioning, up to 25 team members.
entries.desc_zh: 由 Seafile 团队打造的灵活的类电子表格数据库。不限表数、2,000 行、1 个月版本历史、最多 25 名团队成员。

entries.name: skyvia.com
entries.desc_en: Cloud Data Platform offers a free tier and all plans are completely free while in beta
entries.desc_zh: Cloud Data Platform 提供免费层，且在 beta 阶段所有计划完全免费。

entries.name: StackBy
entries.desc_en: One tool that combines spreadsheets' flexibility, databases' power, and built-in integrations with your favorite business apps. The free plan includes unlimited users, ten stacks, and a 2GB attachment per stack.
entries.desc_zh: 一款结合电子表格灵活性、数据库强大功能和与您喜爱的业务应用程序内置集成的工具。免费计划包括无限用户、十个堆栈和每个堆栈 2GB 的附件。

entries.name: Tinybird
entries.desc_en: A serverless managed ClickHouse with connection-less data ingest over HTTP and lets you publish SQL queries as managed HTTP APIs. There is no time limit on free-tier, 10GB storage + 1000 API requests per day.
entries.desc_zh: 一个无服务器的托管 ClickHouse，支持通过 HTTP 进行无连接数据摄取，并可让你将 SQL 查询发布为托管 HTTP API。免费层没有时间限制，提供 10GB 存储和每天 1000 次 API 请求。

entries.name: Turso by ChiselStrike
entries.desc_en: Turso is SQLite Developer Experience in an Edge Database. Turso provides a Free Forever starter plan, 9 GB of total storage, Up to 500 databases, Up to 3 locations, 1 billion row reads per month, and Local development support with SQLite.
entries.desc_zh: Turso 是边缘数据库中的 SQLite 开发者体验。Turso 提供 Free Forever 入门计划：总存储 9 GB、最多 500 个数据库、最多 3 个位置、每月 10 亿次行读取，并支持使用 SQLite 进行本地开发。

entries.name: Upstash
entries.desc_en: Serverless Redis with free tier up to 500K monthly commands, 256MB max database size, and 20 concurrent connections
entries.desc_zh: 无服务器 Redis，免费层提供每月最多 50 万条命令、最大数据库容量 256MB 和 20 个并发连接。

entries.name: cname.dev
entries.desc_en: Free and secure dynamic reverse proxy service.
entries.desc_zh: 免费且安全的动态反向代理服务。

entries.name: conveyor.cloud
entries.desc_en: Visual Studio extension to expose IIS Express to the local network or over a tunnel to a public URL.
entries.desc_zh: Visual Studio 扩展，可将 IIS Express 暴露到本地网络，或通过隧道暴露到公共 URL。

entries.name: Expose
entries.desc_en: Expose local sites via secure tunnels. The free plan includes an EU Server, Random subdomains, and Single users.
entries.desc_zh: 通过安全隧道公开本地站点。免费套餐包含 EU Server、Random subdomains 和 Single users。

entries.name: Hamachi
entries.desc_en: LogMeIn Hamachi is a hosted VPN service that lets you securely extend LAN-like networks to distributed teams with a free plan that allows unlimited networks with up to 5 people
entries.desc_zh: LogMeIn Hamachi 是一项托管 VPN 服务，可让你安全地将类似局域网的网络扩展到分布式团队；其免费套餐允许创建数量不限的网络，每个网络最多支持 5 人。

entries.name: Hookdeck
entries.desc_en: Develop, test, and monitor your webhooks from anywhere. 100K requests and 100K attempts per month with three days retention.
entries.desc_zh: 随时随地开发、测试和监控你的 webhook。每月 10 万次请求和 10 万次尝试，数据保留三天。

entries.name: localhost.run
entries.desc_en: Expose locally running servers over a tunnel to a public URL.
entries.desc_zh: 通过隧道将本地运行的服务器暴露到公共 URL。

entries.name: localtonet
entries.desc_en: Multi-protocol tunneling for HTTP, TLS, TCP, UDP, File Server (Default, SFTP, WebDAV), and Proxy Tunnel (HTTP, SOCKS5, Shadowsocks, VLESS). Free plan: 1 tunnel, 1GB/month bandwidth, 30 min timeout (excl. HTTP Tunnels).
entries.desc_zh: 多协议隧道服务：支持 HTTP、TLS、TCP、UDP、文件服务器（默认 / SFTP / WebDAV）与代理隧道（HTTP、SOCKS5、Shadowsocks、VLESS）。免费层级：1 条隧道、每月 1GB 流量、30 分钟超时（HTTP 隧道除外）。

entries.name: localtunnel
entries.desc_en: Expose locally running servers over a tunnel to a public URL. Free hosted version, and [open source](https://github.com/localtunnel/localtunnel).
entries.desc_zh: 通过隧道将本地运行的服务器暴露到公网 URL。提供免费托管版本，且 [open source](https://github.com/localtunnel/localtunnel)。

entries.name: LocalXpose
entries.desc_en: Reverse proxy that enables you to expose your localhost servers to the internet. The free plan has 15 minutes tunnel lifetime.
entries.desc_zh: 反向代理，可将你的 localhost 服务器暴露到互联网上。免费版的隧道存续时间为 15 分钟。

entries.name: ngrok.com
entries.desc_en: Expose locally running servers over a tunnel to a public URL.
entries.desc_zh: 通过隧道将本地运行的服务器暴露到公共 URL。

entries.name: Pinggy
entries.desc_en: Public URLs for localhost with a single command, no downloads required. HTTPS / TCP / TLS tunnels. The free plan has 60 minutes tunnel lifetime.
entries.desc_zh: 只需一条命令即可为 localhost 获取公网 URL，无需下载。支持 HTTPS / TCP / TLS 隧道。免费版的隧道存续时间为 60 分钟。

entries.name: Radmin VPN
entries.desc_en: Connect multiple computers together via a VPN-enabling LAN-like network. Unlimited peers. (Hamachi alternative)
entries.desc_zh: 通过支持 VPN 的类局域网网络将多台计算机连接在一起。对等节点数量不限。（Hamachi 的替代方案）

entries.name: serveo
entries.desc_en: Expose local servers to the internet. No installation, no signup. Free subdomain, no limits.
entries.desc_zh: 将本地服务器暴露到互联网。无需安装，无需注册。免费子域名，无任何限制。

entries.name: stun:global.stun.twilio.com:3478?transport=udp
entries.desc_en: Twilio STUN
entries.desc_zh: Twilio STUN

entries.name: stun:stun.l.google.com:19302
entries.desc_en: Google STUN
entries.desc_zh: Google STUN

entries.name: Tailscale
entries.desc_en: Zero config VPN, using the open-source WireGuard protocol. Installs on MacOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, and Android devices. Free plan for personal use with 100 devices and three users.
entries.desc_zh: 零配置 VPN，采用开源 WireGuard 协议。可安装在 MacOS、iOS、Windows、Linux 和 Android 设备上。个人使用免费计划，支持 100 台设备和三个用户。

entries.name: webhookrelay.com
entries.desc_en: Manage, debug, fan-out, and proxy all your webhooks to public or internal (i.e. localhost) destinations. Also, expose servers running in a private network over a tunnel by getting a public HTTP endpoint (`https://yoursubdomain.webrelay.io <----> http://localhost:8080`).
entries.desc_zh: 管理、调试、扇出并将你的所有 webhook 代理到公共或内部（即 localhost）目的地。此外，还可以通过获取一个公共 HTTP 端点（`https://yoursubdomain.webrelay.io <----> http://localhost:8080`），把运行在私有网络中的服务器经隧道暴露出来。

entries.name: Xirsys
entries.desc_en: Unlimited STUN usage + 500 MB monthly TURN bandwidth, capped bandwidth, single geographic region.
entries.desc_zh: 不限量的 STUN 使用量 + 每月 500 MB TURN 带宽，带宽设有上限，仅限单一地理区域。

entries.name: ZeroTier
entries.desc_en: FOSS managed virtual Ethernet as a service. Unlimited end-to-end encrypted networks of 25 clients on the free plan. Clients for desktop/mobile/NA; web interface for configuration of custom routing rules and approval of new client nodes on private networks
entries.desc_zh: 以服务形式提供的 FOSS 托管虚拟以太网。免费计划支持不限数量的端到端加密网络，每个网络可容纳 25 个客户端。提供桌面/移动/NA 客户端；并提供 Web 界面，用于配置自定义路由规则以及批准私有网络上的新客户端节点。

entries.name: acunote.com
entries.desc_en: Free project management and SCRUM software for up to 5 team members
entries.desc_zh: 面向最多 5 名团队成员的免费项目管理和 SCRUM 软件

entries.name: AgileHero
entries.desc_en: All-in-one project management tool. Free plan includes kanban board, backlog, epics, estimation poker, MCP server, REST API and webhooks for 2 users.
entries.desc_zh: 一体化项目管理工具。免费计划面向 2 名用户，包含看板、待办列表（backlog）、史诗（epics）、估算扑克（estimation poker）、MCP server、REST API 和 webhook。

entries.name: asana.com
entries.desc_en: Free for private project with collaborators
entries.desc_zh: 私有项目（含协作者）免费

entries.name: Backlog
entries.desc_en: Everything your team needs to release great projects in one platform. The free plan offers 1 Project with ten users & 100MB of storage.
entries.desc_zh: 您的团队在一个平台上发布出色项目所需的一切。免费计划提供 1 个项目、十名用户和 100MB 存储空间。

entries.name: Basecamp
entries.desc_en: To-do lists, milestone management, forum-like messaging, file sharing, and time tracking. Up to 3 projects, 20 users, and 1GB of storage space.
entries.desc_zh: 待办事项列表、里程碑管理、类似论坛的消息功能、文件共享和时间跟踪。最多支持 3 个项目、20 名用户和 1GB 存储空间。

entries.name: bitrix24.com
entries.desc_en: Intranet and project management tool. The free plan has 5GB for unlimited users.
entries.desc_zh: 内网和项目管理工具。免费计划为不限数量的用户提供 5GB 存储空间。

entries.name: cacoo.com
entries.desc_en: Online real-time diagrams: flowchart, UML, network. Free max. 15 users/diagram, 25 sheets
entries.desc_zh: 在线实时图表：流程图、UML、网络图。免费版每张图表最多 15 名用户、25 个工作表

entries.name: clickup.com
entries.desc_en: Project management. Free, premium version with cloud storage. Mobile applications and Git integrations are available.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理。免费，高级版本附带云存储。提供移动应用和 Git 集成。

entries.name: Clockify
entries.desc_en: Time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects. Unlimited users, free forever.
entries.desc_zh: 时间跟踪和工时表应用，让您可以跨项目跟踪工作时间。用户数量不限，永久免费。

entries.name: Cloudcraft
entries.desc_en: Design a professional architecture diagram in minutes with the Cloudcraft visual designer, optimized for AWS with intelligent components that show live data too. Free plan has unlimited private diagrams for single user.
entries.desc_zh: 使用 Cloudcraft 可视化设计器，几分钟内即可设计出专业的架构图，针对 AWS 优化，智能组件还能显示实时数据。免费计划为单个用户提供不限数量的私有图表。

entries.name: Confluence
entries.desc_en: Atlassian's content collaboration tool is used to help teams collaborate and share knowledge efficiently. Free plan for up to 10 users.
entries.desc_zh: Atlassian 的内容协作工具，用于帮助团队高效协作和共享知识。免费计划最多支持 10 名用户。

entries.name: Crosswork
entries.desc_en: Versatile project management platform. Free for up to 3 projects, unlimited users, 1 GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 多功能项目管理平台。免费版支持最多 3 个项目、不限用户数、1 GB 存储空间。

entries.name: diagrams.net
entries.desc_en: Online diagrams stored locally in Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox. Free for all features and storage levels
entries.desc_zh: 在线图表，本地存储于 Google Drive、OneDrive 或 Dropbox。所有功能和存储级别均免费

entries.name: easyretro.io
entries.desc_en: Simple and intuitive sprint retrospective tool. The free plan has three public boards and one survey per board per month.
entries.desc_zh: 简单直观的冲刺回顾工具。免费计划包含三个公开看板，每个看板每月一次调查。

entries.name: freedcamp.com
entries.desc_en: tasks, discussions, milestones, time tracking, calendar, files and password manager. Free plan with unlimited projects, users, and file storage.
entries.desc_zh: 任务、讨论、里程碑、时间跟踪、日历、文件和密码管理器。免费计划支持不限数量的项目、用户和文件存储。

entries.name: GForge
entries.desc_en: Project Management and issue Tracking toolset for complex projects with self-premises and SaaS options. SaaS free plan offers the first five users free & free for Open Source Projects.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于复杂项目的项目管理与问题跟踪工具集，提供本地部署和 SaaS 选项。SaaS 免费计划为前五位用户提供免费服务，并为开源项目提供免费服务。

entries.name: gleek.io
entries.desc_en: Free description-to-diagrams tool for developers. Create informal UML class, object, or entity-relationship diagrams using your keyword.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的免费描述生成图表工具。使用你的关键词创建非正式的 UML 类图、对象图或实体关系图。

entries.name: GraphQL Inspector
entries.desc_en: GraphQL Inspector outputs a list of changes between two GraphQL schemas. Every difference is precisely explained and marked as breaking, non-breaking, or dangerous.
entries.desc_zh: GraphQL Inspector 输出两个 GraphQL schema 之间的变更列表。每个差异都会被精确解释，并标记为破坏性、非破坏性或危险。

entries.name: Helploom
entries.desc_en: Customer support software that offers a live chat on the free forever plan. Simple, lightweight and beautiful. Setup is a simple copy-paste script. Built by a developer.
entries.desc_zh: 客户支持软件，永久免费计划提供在线聊天功能。简单、轻量且美观。设置只需简单的复制粘贴脚本。由开发者打造。

entries.name: HeyRetro
entries.desc_en: Real-time sprint retrospective platform with voting, timers, surveys, guest collaboration, and ice-breaker games. The forever-free plan includes one board per month, anonymous surveys, and guest link sharing.
entries.desc_zh: 实时冲刺回顾平台，具备投票、计时器、调查、访客协作和破冰游戏功能。永久免费计划包含每月一个看板、匿名调查和访客链接分享。

entries.name: Hygger
entries.desc_en: Project management platform. The free plan offers unlimited users, projects & boards with 100 MB of Storage.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理平台。免费计划提供无限用户、项目和看板，以及 100 MB 存储空间。

entries.name: Ilograph
entries.desc_en: interactive diagrams that allow users to see their infrastructure from multiple perspectives and levels of detail. Charts can be expressed in code. The free tier has unlimited private diagrams with up to 3 viewers.
entries.desc_zh: 交互式图表，让用户可以从多个视角和不同详细程度查看其基础设施。图表可用代码表达。免费层级提供不限数量的私有图表，最多支持 3 名查看者。

entries.name: Jira
entries.desc_en: Advanced software development project management tool used in many corporate environments. Free plan for up to 10 users.
entries.desc_zh: 在众多企业环境中使用的先进软件开发项目管理工具。免费计划最多支持 10 名用户。

entries.name: kan.bn
entries.desc_en: A powerful, flexible kanban app that helps you organise work, track progress, and deliver results-all in one place. Free plan up to 1 user for unlimited boards, unlimited lists, unlimited cards.
entries.desc_zh: 一款强大而灵活的看板应用，帮助你组织工作、跟踪进度并交付成果——尽在一处。免费计划支持 1 名用户，提供无限看板、无限列表、无限卡片。

entries.name: kanbanflow.com
entries.desc_en: Board-based project management. Free, premium version with more options
entries.desc_zh: 基于看板的项目管理。免费，高级版本提供更多选项

entries.name: kanbantool.com
entries.desc_en: Kanban board-based project management. The free plan has two boards and two users, without attachments or files.
entries.desc_zh: 基于看板的项目管理。免费计划有两块白板和两个用户，不支持附件或文件。

entries.name: Kitemaker.co
entries.desc_en: Collaborate through all phases of the product development process and keep track of work across Slack, Discord, Figma, and Github. Unlimited users, unlimited spaces. Free plan up to 250 work items.
entries.desc_zh: 在产品开发流程的所有阶段进行协作，并通过 Slack、Discord、Figma 和 Github 跟踪工作。无限用户、无限空间。免费计划最多支持 250 个工作项。

entries.name: Kiter.app
entries.desc_en: Let anyone organize their job search and track interviews, opportunities, and connections. Powerful web app and Chrome extension. Completely free.
entries.desc_zh: 让任何人都能整理自己的求职过程，跟踪面试、机会和人脉。强大的 Web 应用和 Chrome 扩展。完全免费。

entries.name: Kumu.io
entries.desc_en: Relationship maps with animation, decorations, filters, clustering, spreadsheet imports, etc. The free tier allows unlimited public projects. Graph size unlimited. Free private projects for students. Sandbox mode is available if you prefer not to leave your file publicly online (upload, edit, download, discard).
entries.desc_zh: 关系图谱，支持动画、装饰、筛选、聚类、电子表格导入等功能。免费层级允许不限数量的公开项目。图形大小无限制。学生可免费使用私有项目。如果你不希望将文件公开留存在网上，可使用沙盒模式（上传、编辑、下载、丢弃）。

entries.name: leiga.com
entries.desc_en: Leiga is a SaaS product that uses AI to automatically manage your projects, helping your team stay focused and unleash immense potential, ensuring your projects progress as planned. Free for up to 10 users, 20 custom fields, 2GB of storage space, Video Recording with AI limited to 5 mins/video, Automation Runs at 20/user/month.
entries.desc_zh: Leiga 是一款利用 AI 自动管理项目的 SaaS 产品，帮助你的团队保持专注、释放巨大潜力，确保项目按计划推进。免费版支持最多 10 名用户、20 个自定义字段、2GB 存储空间，AI 视频录制限制为每个视频 5 分钟，自动化运行次数为每用户每月 20 次。

entries.name: Linear
entries.desc_en: Issue tracker with a streamlined interface. Free for unlimited members, up to 10MB file upload size, 250 issues (excluding Archive)
entries.desc_zh: 界面简洁的问题跟踪器。免费版支持无限成员，文件上传大小最高 10MB，250 个问题（不包括归档）

entries.name: Lucidchart
entries.desc_en: An online diagram tool with collaboration features. Free plan with three editable documents, 100 professional templates, and basic collaboration features.
entries.desc_zh: 一款具有协作功能的在线图表工具。免费计划包含三个可编辑文档、100 个专业模板以及基础协作功能。

entries.name: MeisterTask
entries.desc_en: Online task management for teams. Free up to 3 projects and unlimited project members.
entries.desc_zh: 面向团队的在线任务管理。免费版支持最多 3 个项目和无限项目成员。

entries.name: MeuScrum
entries.desc_en: Free online scrum tool with kanban board
entries.desc_zh: 带看板的免费在线 Scrum 工具

entries.name: myspec.dev
entries.desc_en: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) architect tool that interviews developers and generates structured 4-file spec bundles with MCP server integration. Free tier covers 20 projects and 100 spec files.
entries.desc_zh: 规范驱动开发（SDD）架构工具，通过访谈开发者生成结构化的 4 文件规范包，并集成 MCP server。免费层级涵盖 20 个项目和 100 个规范文件。

entries.name: nTask
entries.desc_en: Project management software that enables your teams to collaborate, plan, analyze, and manage everyday tasks. The essential plan is free forever with 100 MB storage and five users/teams. Unlimited workspaces, meetings, assignments, timesheets, and issue tracking.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理软件，使您的团队能够协作、规划、分析和日常任务管理。基础计划永久免费，提供 100 MB 存储空间和五个用户/团队。无限工作空间、会议、任务分配、工时表和问题跟踪。

entries.name: Plane
entries.desc_en: Plane is a simple, extensible, open-source project and product management tool. Free for unlimited members, up to 5MB file upload size, 1000 issues.
entries.desc_zh: Plane 是一款简单、可扩展的开源项目和产品管理工具。免费版支持无限成员，文件上传大小最高 5MB，1000 个问题。

entries.name: planitpoker.com
entries.desc_en: Free online planning poker (estimation tool)
entries.desc_zh: 免费在线规划扑克（估算工具）

entries.name: point.poker
entries.desc_en: Online Planning Poker (consensus-based estimation tool). Free for unlimited users, teams, sessions, rounds, and votes. You don't need to register.
entries.desc_zh: 在线规划扑克（基于共识的估算工具）。不限用户、团队、会议、轮次和投票数量，全部免费。无需注册。

entries.name: Pulse.red
entries.desc_en: Free Minimalistic Time Tracker and Timesheet app for projects.
entries.desc_zh: 面向项目的免费极简时间跟踪与工时表应用。

entries.name: ScrumFast
entries.desc_en: Scrum board with a very intuitive interface, free up to 5 users.
entries.desc_zh: 界面非常直观的 Scrum 看板，免费版最多支持 5 名用户。

entries.name: Sflow
entries.desc_en: sflow.io is a project management tool built for agile software development, marketing, sales, and customer support, especially for outsourcing and cross-organization collaboration projects. Free plan up to 3 projects and five members.
entries.desc_zh: sflow.io 是一款为敏捷软件开发、营销、销售和客户支持而打造的项目管理工具，尤其适用于外包和跨组织协作项目。免费版最多支持 3 个项目和 5 名成员。

entries.name: Shake
entries.desc_en: In-app bug reporting and feedback tool for mobile apps. Free plan, ten bug reports per app/month.
entries.desc_zh: 移动应用的应用内错误报告和反馈工具。免费计划，每款应用每月十个错误报告。

entries.name: Shortcut
entries.desc_en: Project management platform. Free for up to 10 users forever.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理平台。最多 10 名用户永久免费。

entries.name: taiga.io
entries.desc_en: Project management platform for startups and agile developers, free for Open Source
entries.desc_zh: 面向初创企业和敏捷开发者的项目管理平台，对开源免费

entries.name: taskade.com
entries.desc_en: Real-time collaborative task lists and team outlines. The free plan has one workspace with unlimited tasks and projects; 1GB file storage; 1-week project history; and five attendees per video meeting.
entries.desc_zh: 实时协作任务列表和团队大纲。免费计划包含一个工作空间，具有无限任务和项目；1GB 文件存储；1周项目历史；每个视频会议五名参与者。

entries.name: Teaminal
entries.desc_en: Standup, retro, and sprint planning tool for remote teams. Free for up to 15 users.
entries.desc_zh: 面向远程团队的站会、回顾和冲刺规划工具。最多 15 名用户免费。

entries.name: teamwork.com
entries.desc_en: Project management & Team Chat. Free for five users and two projects. Premium plans are available.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理和团队聊天。免费支持五个用户和两个项目。提供高级计划。

entries.name: teleretro.com
entries.desc_en: Simple and fun retrospective tool with icebreakers, gifs and emojis. The free plan includes three retros and unlimited members.
entries.desc_zh: 简单有趣的回顾工具，包含破冰活动、GIF 和表情符号。免费计划包括三个回顾和无限成员。

entries.name: Tenzu
entries.desc_en: Lightweight project management tool for agile teams. The SaaS relies on free contributions; users can always choose to give 0 and there is no features paywall {[more details](https://tenzu.net/pricing/)}
entries.desc_zh: 面向敏捷团队的轻量级项目管理工具。该 SaaS 依靠自由捐赠运作；用户可以随时选择支付 0，且没有任何功能付费墙 {[more details](https://tenzu.net/pricing/)}

entries.name: titanapps.io
entries.desc_en: productivity tools for Jira and monday.com offering structured checklists, templates, and approvals inside issues/tasks. Free plan available for small teams.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Jira 和 monday.com 的生产力工具，在问题/任务内提供结构化清单、模板和审批功能。小团队可使用免费计划。

entries.name: todoist.com
entries.desc_en: Collaborative and individual task management. The free plan has: 5 active projects, five users in the project, file uploading up to 5MB, three filters, and one week of activity history.
entries.desc_zh: 协作和个人任务管理。免费计划包括：5 个活跃项目，每个项目五名用户，最大 5MB 文件上传，三个过滤器，一周活动历史。

entries.name: Toggl
entries.desc_en: Provides two free productivity tools. [Toggl Track](https://toggl.com/track/) for time management and tracking app with a free plan provides seamless time tracking and reporting designed with freelancers in mind. It has unlimited tracking records, projects, clients, tags, reporting, and more. And [Toggl Plan](https://toggl.com/plan/) for task planning with a free plan for solo developers with unlimited tasks, milestones, and timelines.
entries.desc_zh: 提供两款免费生产力工具。[Toggl Track](https://toggl.com/track/) 是一款时间管理与跟踪应用，其免费计划提供无缝的时间跟踪和报告，专为自由职业者设计。它拥有无限的跟踪记录、项目、客户、标签、报告等。而 [Toggl Plan](https://toggl.com/plan/) 是一款任务规划工具，为独立开发者提供免费计划，包含无限任务、里程碑和时间线。

entries.name: trello.com
entries.desc_en: Board-based project management. Unlimited Personal Boards, 10 Team Boards.
entries.desc_zh: 基于看板的项目管理。无限个人看板，10 个团队看板。

entries.name: Tweek
entries.desc_en: Simple Weekly To-Do Calendar & Task Management.
entries.desc_zh: 简单的每周待办日历与任务管理。

entries.name: Wikifactory
entries.desc_en: Product designing Service with Projects, VCS & Issues. The free plan offers unlimited projects & collaborators and 3GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 提供 Projects、VCS 与 Issues 的产品设计服务。免费计划提供无限项目与协作者以及 3GB 存储。

entries.name: Yodiz
entries.desc_en: Agile development and issue tracking. Free up to 3 users, unlimited projects.
entries.desc_zh: 敏捷开发与问题跟踪。最多 3 名用户免费，项目数量不限。

entries.name: YouTrack
entries.desc_en: Free hosted YouTrack (InCloud) for FOSS projects and private projects (free for three users). Includes time tracking and agile boards
entries.desc_zh: 为 FOSS 项目和私有项目提供免费托管的 YouTrack (InCloud)（三名用户内免费）。包含时间跟踪和敏捷看板

entries.name: zenhub.com
entries.desc_en: The only project management solution inside GitHub. Free for public repos, OSS, and nonprofit organizations
entries.desc_zh: 唯一内置于 GitHub 的项目管理解决方案。对公开仓库、OSS 和非营利组织免费

entries.name: zenkit.com
entries.desc_en: Project management and collaboration tool. Free for up to 5 members, 5 GB attachments.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理与协作工具。最多 5 名成员免费，5 GB 附件。

entries.name: Zube
entries.desc_en: Project management with free plan for 4 Projects & 4 users. GitHub integration is available.
entries.desc_zh: 项目管理服务，免费计划支持 4 个项目与 4 名用户。提供 GitHub 集成。

entries.name: AndroidFileHost
entries.desc_en: Free file-sharing platform with unlimited speed, bandwidth, file count, download count, etc. It is mainly aimed for Android dev-related files like APK build, custom ROM & modifications, etc. But seems to accept any other files as well.
entries.desc_zh: 免费文件共享平台，速度、带宽、文件数量、下载次数等均不限。主要面向 Android 开发相关文件，如 APK 构建、自定义 ROM 和修改等，但似乎也接受其他任何文件。

entries.name: anon.li Drop
entries.desc_en: Zero-knowledge E2EE file sharing with client-side AES-256-GCM encryption and zero server-side data access. Free uploads for files up to 5GB with max expiry up to 3 days through the website, CLI or API.
entries.desc_zh: 零知识端到端加密（E2EE）文件共享，采用客户端 AES-256-GCM 加密，服务端零数据访问。通过网站、CLI 或 API 可免费上传最大 5GB 的文件，最长有效期 3 天。

entries.name: borgbase.com
entries.desc_en: Simple and secure offsite backup hosting for Borg Backup. 10 GB free backup space and two repositories.
entries.desc_zh: 为 Borg Backup 提供简单安全的异地备份托管。10 GB 免费备份空间和两个仓库。

entries.name: cloudinary.com
entries.desc_en: Image upload, powerful manipulations, storage, and delivery for sites and apps, with Ruby, Python, Java, PHP, Objective-C, and more libraries. The free tier includes 25 monthly credits. One credit equals 1,000 image transformations, 1 GB of storage, or 1 GB of CDN usage.
entries.desc_zh: 为网站和应用程序提供图片上传、强大处理、存储和交付服务，支持 Ruby、Python、Java、PHP、Objective-C 等多种库。免费套餐包含每月 25 次积分。一次积分等于 1,000 次图片转换、1 GB 存储空间或 1 GB CDN 使用量。

entries.name: degoo.com
entries.desc_en: AI based cloud storage with free up to 20 GB, three devices, 5 GB referral bonus (90 days account inactivity).
entries.desc_zh: 基于 AI 的云存储，免费提供最多 20 GB、三台设备、5 GB 邀请奖励（账户 90 天不活跃）。

entries.name: dlvr.sh
entries.desc_en: Temporary file delivery for agents and automation. Free tier includes 10 deliveries every 24 hours with API, MCP, and CLI access.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 agent 与自动化的临时文件投递。免费层每 24 小时包含 10 次投递，并提供 API、MCP 和 CLI 访问。

entries.name: Dropshare
entries.desc_en: Zero-knowledge file sharing. End-to-end encrypted file sharing with AES-256-GCM encryption, client-side processing, and zero server-side data access. Free uploads for files up to 1GB with no data collection.
entries.desc_zh: 零知识文件共享。端到端加密文件共享，采用 AES-256-GCM 加密、客户端处理，服务端零数据访问。可免费上传最大 1GB 的文件，不收集任何数据。

entries.name: embed.ly
entries.desc_en: Provides APIs for embedding media in a webpage, responsive image scaling, and extracting elements from a webpage. Free for up to 5,000 URLs/month at 15 requests/second
entries.desc_zh: 提供用于在网页中嵌入媒体、响应式图片缩放以及从网页中提取元素的 API。每月最多 5,000 个 URL、每秒 15 次请求内免费

entries.name: Ente
entries.desc_en: Ente is an end-to-end encrypted cloud for photos, videos and 2FA secrets. Can also be self-hosted along with a generous forever free-tier of 10GB. For free tier users, only single replica of data is kept.
entries.desc_zh: Ente 是一个端到端加密的云服务，用于存储照片、视频和 2FA 密钥。也可自托管，并拥有慷慨的 10GB 永久免费层。对于免费层用户，数据仅保留单个副本。

entries.name: FileShot.io
entries.desc_en: Zero-knowledge encrypted file sharing. AES-256-GCM browser-side encryption ensures files are encrypted in-browser before upload. No account required for sender or recipient. Self-hostable (MIT open-source). Free tier includes unlimited uploads with no file size restrictions.
entries.desc_zh: 零知识加密文件共享。AES-256-GCM 浏览器端加密确保文件在上传前即在浏览器中完成加密。发送方和接收方均无需账户。可自托管（MIT 开源）。免费层包含无限次上传，无文件大小限制。

entries.name: file.io
entries.desc_en: 2 GB storage of files. A file is auto-deleted after one download. REST API to interact with the storage. Rate limit one request/minute.
entries.desc_zh: 2 GB 文件存储空间。文件在下载一次后自动删除。提供 REST API 与存储交互。速率限制为每分钟一次请求。

entries.name: freetools.site
entries.desc_en: Free online tools. Convert or edit documents, images, audio, video, and more.
entries.desc_zh: 免费在线工具。转换或编辑文档、图片、音频、视频等。

entries.name: getpantry.cloud
entries.desc_en: A simple JSON data storage API perfect for personal projects, hackathons, and mobile apps!
entries.desc_zh: 一个简单的 JSON 数据存储 API，非常适合个人项目、黑客马拉松和移动应用！

entries.name: GoFile.io
entries.desc_en: Free file sharing and storage platform can be used via web-based UI & also API. unlimited file size, bandwidth, download count, etc. But it will be deleted when a file becomes inactive (no download for more than ten days).
entries.desc_zh: 免费文件共享与存储平台，可通过网页 UI 和 API 使用。文件大小、带宽、下载次数等均不限。但文件一旦不活跃（超过十天无下载）就会被删除。

entries.name: gumlet.com
entries.desc_en: Image and video hosting, processing and streaming via CDN. Provides generous free tier of 250 GB / month for videos and 30 GB  / month for images.
entries.desc_zh: 通过 CDN 提供图片和视频托管、处理与流媒体服务。提供慷慨的免费层：视频每月 250 GB、图片每月 30 GB。

entries.name: hyperserve.io
entries.desc_en: Video backend API for developers: accept any format your users upload, transcode to MP4, and deliver globally via CDN. The free tier includes 50 videos, 1 GB per file, and 250 GB bandwidth per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的视频后端 API：接受用户上传的任何格式，转码为 MP4，并通过 CDN 全球分发。免费层包含 50 个视频、每个文件 1 GB、每月 250 GB 带宽。

entries.name: icedrive.net
entries.desc_en: Simple cloud storage service. 10 GB free storage
entries.desc_zh: 简单的云存储服务。10 GB 免费存储

entries.name: image-charts.com
entries.desc_en: Unlimited image chart generation with a watermark
entries.desc_zh: 不限量生成带水印的图表图片

entries.name: ImageEngine
entries.desc_en: ImageEngine is an easy to use global image CDN. Sub 60 sec setup. AVIF and JPEGXL support, WordPress-, Magento-, React-, Vue- plugins and more. Claim your free developer account [here](https://imageengine.io/developer-program/).
entries.desc_zh: ImageEngine 是一个易于使用的全球图片 CDN。60 秒内即可完成设置。支持 AVIF 和 JPEGXL，提供 WordPress、Magento、React、Vue 等插件。在[here](https://imageengine.io/developer-program/)领取你的免费开发者账户。

entries.name: imagekit.io
entries.desc_en: Image CDN with automatic optimization, real-time transformation, and storage that you can integrate with existing setup in minutes. The free plan includes up to 20GB of bandwidth per month.
entries.desc_zh: 图片 CDN，具备自动优化、实时转换和存储功能，几分钟内即可集成到现有环境。免费计划包含每月最多 20GB 带宽。

entries.name: ImgBB
entries.desc_en: ImgBB is an unlimited image hosting service. Drag and drop your image anywhere on the screen. 32 MB / image limit. Receive Direct image links, BBCode and HTML thumbnails after uploading image. Login to see the upload history.
entries.desc_zh: ImgBB 是一个无限量图片托管服务。将图片拖放到屏幕任意位置即可上传。单张图片限制 32 MB。上传图片后可获得图片直链、BBCode 和 HTML 缩略图。登录后可查看上传历史。

entries.name: Imgbot
entries.desc_en: Imgbot is a friendly robot that optimizes your images and saves you time. Optimized images mean smaller file sizes without sacrificing quality. It's free for open source.
entries.desc_zh: Imgbot 是一个友好的机器人，可优化你的图片并节省时间。优化后的图片文件更小，且不损失画质。对开源项目免费。

entries.name: imgen
entries.desc_en: On the fly image generation API (text over background, logo) for opengraph images, free, no watermark, CDN
entries.desc_zh: 实时图片生成 API（在背景上叠加文字、Logo），用于生成 opengraph 图片，免费、无水印、支持 CDN

entries.name: imgix
entries.desc_en: Image Caching, management and CDN. Free plan includes 1000 origin images, infinite transformations and 100 GB bandwidth
entries.desc_zh: 图片缓存、管理与 CDN。免费计划包含 1000 张源图片、无限次转换和 100 GB 带宽

entries.name: imgduck.com
entries.desc_en: Minimalist and fast image hosting service with direct link and API support. Free tier offers 1GB storage and unlimited requests per month
entries.desc_zh: 简约快速的图片托管服务，支持直接链接和 API。免费套餐提供 1GB 存储空间和每月无限请求

entries.name: internxt.com
entries.desc_en: Internxt Drive is a zero-knowledge file storage service based on absolute privacy and uncompromising security. Sign up and get 10 GB for free, forever!
entries.desc_zh: Internxt Drive 是一项基于绝对隐私与极致安全的零知识文件存储服务。注册即可永久免费获得 10 GB！

entries.name: kraken.io
entries.desc_en: Image optimization for website performance as a service, free plan up to 1 MB file size
entries.desc_zh: 以服务形式提供的网站性能图片优化，免费计划支持最大 1 MB 文件

entries.name: LibreQR
entries.desc_en: Free QR code generator focused on privacy and no tracking. Free to use with no data collection.
entries.desc_zh: 专注于隐私、无跟踪的免费二维码生成器。免费使用，不收集数据。

entries.name: MConverter
entries.desc_en: Convert files in bulk. Supports many formats, including [AVIF](https://mconverter.eu/convert/to/avif/) and JXL. Extract image frames from videos. Compress PDFs. Free for 15 files per 24h, up to 100 MB each, processed in batches of eight.
entries.desc_zh: 批量转换文件。支持多种格式，包括 [AVIF](https://mconverter.eu/convert/to/avif/) 和 JXL。可从视频中提取图像帧。可压缩 PDF。每 24 小时免费处理 15 个文件，每个文件最大 100 MB，按每批 8 个文件分批处理。

entries.name: nitropack.io
entries.desc_en: Accelerate your site's speed on autopilot with complete front-end optimization (caching, images and code optimization, CDN). Free for up to 5,000 pageviews/month
entries.desc_zh: 通过完整的前端优化（缓存、图片与代码优化、CDN）自动加速你的网站。每月最多 5,000 次页面浏览免费

entries.name: npoint.io
entries.desc_en: JSON store with collaborative schema editing
entries.desc_zh: 支持协作式模式编辑的 JSON 存储

entries.name: MantleDB
entries.desc_en: Anonymous JSON storage for scripts and tiny apps. No signup required; uses Master AID for updates and Read-Only RID for public fetching. Free tier includes 1 bucket (1MB limit) with a 72h inactivity scavenger policy.
entries.desc_zh: 面向脚本和小型应用的匿名 JSON 存储。无需注册；使用 Master AID 进行更新、只读 RID 进行公开读取。免费层包含 1 个 bucket（上限 1MB），并采用 72 小时不活跃清理策略。

entries.name: otixo.com
entries.desc_en: Encrypt, share, copy, and move all your cloud storage files from one place. The basic plan provides unlimited file transfer with 250 MB max. file size and allows five encrypted files
entries.desc_zh: 在一个地方加密、共享、复制和移动您所有的云存储文件。基础套餐提供无限文件传输，最大文件大小为 250 MB，并允许加密五个文件

entries.name: packagecloud.io
entries.desc_en: Hosted Package Repositories for YUM, APT, RubyGem and PyPI.  Limited free plans and open-source plans are available via request
entries.desc_zh: 为 YUM、APT、RubyGem 和 PyPI 提供托管软件包仓库。可通过申请获得有限的免费计划和开源计划

entries.name: pcloud.com
entries.desc_en: Cloud storage service. Up to 10 GB of free storage
entries.desc_zh: 云存储服务。最高 10 GB 免费存储空间。

entries.name: Pinata IPFS
entries.desc_en: Pinata is the simplest way to upload and manage files on IPFS. Our friendly user interface and IPFS API make Pinata the easiest IPFS pinning service for platforms, creators, and collectors. 1 GB storage free, along with access to API.
entries.desc_zh: Pinata 是在 IPFS 上上传和管理文件的最简单方式。我们友好的用户界面和 IPFS API 使 Pinata 成为面向平台、创作者和收藏者的最易用的 IPFS pinning 服务。免费提供 1 GB 存储空间，并可访问 API。

entries.name: plot.ly
entries.desc_en: Graph and share your data. The free tier includes unlimited public files and ten private files
entries.desc_zh: 将数据绘制成图表并分享。免费套餐包含不限量的公开文件和十个私有文件。

entries.name: podio.com
entries.desc_en: You can use Podio with a team of up to five people and try out the features of the Basic Plan, except user management
entries.desc_zh: 你可以与最多五人的团队一起使用 Podio，并试用 Basic 计划的各项功能（用户管理除外）。

entries.name: Proton Drive
entries.desc_en: Ultra-secure cloud storage for files and key documents. Free plan offers 5gb of storage space.
entries.desc_zh: 面向文件和重要文档的超安全云存储。免费计划提供 5 GB 存储空间。

entries.name: QRtracer
entries.desc_en: Free QR code generator with built-in scan analytics, bulk generation & brand customisation, focused on reliability without any ads.
entries.desc_zh: 免费二维码生成器，内置扫描分析、批量生成与品牌定制功能，专注于可靠性，无任何广告。

entries.name: QuickChart
entries.desc_en: Generate embeddable image charts, graphs, and QR codes
entries.desc_zh: 生成可嵌入的图像图表、图形和二维码

entries.name: redbooth.com
entries.desc_en: P2P file syncing, free for up to 2 users
entries.desc_zh: P2P 文件同步，最多 2 个用户免费。

entries.name: resmush.it
entries.desc_en: reSmush.it is a FREE API that provides image optimization. reSmush.it has been implemented on the most common CMS such as WordPress, Drupal, or Magento. reSmush.it is the most used image optimization API with more than seven billion images already treated, and it is still Free of charge.
entries.desc_zh: reSmush.it 是一个提供图片优化的免费 API。reSmush.it 已被应用于最常见的 CMS，如 WordPress、Drupal 或 Magento。reSmush.it 是使用最广泛的图片优化 API，已处理超过 70 亿张图片，且至今仍然免费。

entries.name: sirv.com
entries.desc_en: Smart Image CDN with on-the-fly image optimization and resizing. The free tier includes 500 MB of storage and 2 GB of bandwidth.
entries.desc_zh: 智能图片 CDN，支持即时图片优化和调整大小。免费套餐包含 500 MB 存储空间和 2 GB 带宽。

entries.name: SlingSite
entries.desc_en: Create all the optimized versions of your images and videos. For Free. In bulk. For each image, you get the following formats: AVIF, WEBP and JPG in the three selected resolutions (desktop, tablet, mobile) For videos, you get: WebM (codec VP9), MP4 (codec HEVC aka H.265) and MP4 (codec AVC aka H.264) plus the cover image with the first frame.
