entries.name: Codeground
entries.desc_en: Free browser IDE and playgrounds for 15+ languages plus Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis. Shareable snippets, coding interviews, and cloud workspaces. Free playgrounds need no install.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 15 种以上语言以及 Postgres、MySQL、MongoDB 和 Redis 的免费浏览器 IDE 和演练场。支持可分享的代码片段、编程面试和云端工作区。免费演练场无需安装。

entries.name: codiga.io
entries.desc_en: Coding Assistant that lets you search, define, and reuse code snippets directly in your IDE. Free for individual and small organizations.
entries.desc_zh: 编码助手，让你可以直接在 IDE 中搜索、定义和复用代码片段。对个人和小型组织免费。

entries.name: Components.studio
entries.desc_en: Code components in isolation, visualize them in stories, test them, and publish them on npm.
entries.desc_zh: 独立编写组件代码，在 stories 中对其进行可视化、测试，并将其发布到 npm。

entries.name: Eclipse Che
entries.desc_en: Web-based and Kubernetes-Native IDE for Developer Teams with multi-language support. Open Source and community-driven. An online instance hosted by Red Hat is available at [workspaces.openshift.com](https://workspaces.openshift.com/).
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者团队、支持多语言的基于 Web 的 Kubernetes 原生 IDE。开源且由社区驱动。Red Hat 托管的在线实例可访问 [workspaces.openshift.com](https://workspaces.openshift.com/)。

entries.name: ForgeCode
entries.desc_en: AI-enabled pair programmer for Claude, GPT4 Series, Grok, Deepseek, Gemini and all frontier models. Works natively with your CLI and integrates seamlessly with any IDE. Free tier includes basic AI model access with local processing.
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Claude、GPT4 系列、Grok、Deepseek、Gemini 及所有前沿模型的 AI 结对编程助手。原生适配你的 CLI，并可与任何 IDE 无缝集成。免费层级包含基础 AI 模型访问和本地处理。

entries.name: GetVM
entries.desc_en: Instant free Linux and IDEs chrome sidebar. The free tier includes 5 VMs per day.
entries.desc_zh: 即时可用的免费 Linux 和 IDE Chrome 侧边栏。免费层级每天包含 5 台虚拟机（VMs）。

entries.name: JDoodle
entries.desc_en: Online compiler and editor for more than 60 programming languages with a free plan for REST API code compiling up to 200 credits per day.
entries.desc_zh: 支持 60 多种编程语言的在线编译器和编辑器，免费计划支持通过 REST API 编译代码，每天最多 200 credits。

entries.name: jetbrains.com
entries.desc_en: Productivity tools, IDEs and deploy tools (aka [IntelliJ IDEA](https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/), [PyCharm](https://www.jetbrains.com/pycharm/), etc). Free license for students, teachers, Open Source and user groups.
entries.desc_zh: 生产力工具、IDE 和部署工具（又名 [IntelliJ IDEA](https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/)、[PyCharm](https://www.jetbrains.com/pycharm/) 等）。为学生、教师、开源项目和用户组提供免费许可。

entries.name: JSONPlaceholder
entries.desc_en: Some REST API endpoints that return some fake data in JSON format. The source code is also available if you would like to run the server locally.
entries.desc_zh: 一些以 JSON 格式返回模拟数据的 REST API 端点。如果你想本地运行该服务器，源代码也可供获取。

entries.name: Lazarus
entries.desc_en: Lazarus is a Delphi-compatible cross-platform IDE for Rapid Application Development.
entries.desc_zh: Lazarus 是一款与 Delphi 兼容、用于快速应用程序开发的跨平台 IDE。

entries.name: LiveCodes
entries.desc_en: An open-source client-side code playground that supports 90+ languages/frameworks. Projects can be saved, exported, shared, synced, deployed (to GitHub Pages) and embedded in web pages. Mobile-friendly. Can be self-hosted. Free for unlimited usage. No account required.
entries.desc_zh: 一款开源的客户端代码演练场，支持 90 多种语言/框架。项目可以保存、导出、分享、同步、部署（到 GitHub Pages）并嵌入网页。对移动端友好。可自托管。免费无限量使用。无需账号。

entries.name: MarsCode
entries.desc_en: A free AI-powered cloud-based IDE.
entries.desc_zh: 一款免费的 AI 驱动云端 IDE。

entries.name: micro-jaymock
entries.desc_en: Tiny API mocking microservice for generating fake JSON data.
entries.desc_zh: 用于生成模拟 JSON 数据的轻量级 API 模拟微服务。

entries.name: mockaroo
entries.desc_en: Mockaroo lets you generate realistic test data in CSV, JSON, SQL, and Excel formats. You can also create mocks for back-end API.
entries.desc_zh: Mockaroo 让你生成 CSV、JSON、SQL 和 Excel 格式的真实测试数据。你还可以为后端 API 创建 mock。

entries.name: Mocklets
entries.desc_en: an HTTP-based mock API simulator that helps simulate APIs for faster parallel development and more comprehensive testing, with a lifetime free tier.
entries.desc_zh: 一款基于 HTTP 的模拟 API 模拟器，帮助模拟 API 以加快并行开发并实现更全面的测试，提供终身免费层级。

entries.name: OneCompiler
entries.desc_en: Free online compiler supporting 70+ languages including Java, Python, C++, JavaScript.
entries.desc_zh: 免费在线编译器，支持 70 多种语言，包括 Java、Python、C++、JavaScript。

entries.name: OnlineGDB
entries.desc_en: A free online ide thats supports 40+ languages and is pre installed with tons of libraries; and also has a debugging option, flags, tutorials, and a QNA page!
entries.desc_zh: 一款免费在线 IDE，支持 40 多种语言，预装了海量库；还带有调试选项、flags、教程和问答页面！

entries.name: pterocos
entries.desc_en: a free opensource browser-based coding environment for front-end developers. write html, css and js with a vs code-grade editor (monaco), live preview, scss/typeScript/babel support, and an ai chat assistant for debugging and suggestions. all projects save to local storage. free forever – no account needed.
entries.desc_zh: 一款面向前端开发者的免费开源、基于浏览器的编码环境。使用 VS Code 级别的编辑器（Monaco）编写 HTML、CSS 和 JS，支持实时预览、SCSS/TypeScript/Babel，以及一个用于调试和建议的 AI 聊天助手。所有项目保存至本地存储。永久免费——无需账号。

entries.name: Paiza
entries.desc_en: Develop Web apps in Browser without needing to set up anything. Free Plan offers one server with 24 24-hour lifetime and 4 hours of running time per day with 2 CPU cores, 2 GB RAM, and 1 GB storage.
entries.desc_zh: 在浏览器中开发 Web 应用，无需进行任何设置。免费版提供一台服务器，生命周期为 24 小时，每天 4 小时运行时间，配备 2 个 CPU 核心、2 GB 内存和 1 GB 存储空间。

entries.name: PHPSandbox
entries.desc_en: Online development environment for PHP
entries.desc_zh: 面向 PHP 的在线开发环境。

entries.name: Replit
entries.desc_en: A cloud coding environment for various program languages.
entries.desc_zh: 支持多种编程语言的云端编码环境。

entries.name: RunMat
entries.desc_en: GPU-accelerated numerical computing IDE in the browser. Write and run MATLAB-syntax .m files with automatic GPU acceleration via WebAssembly and WebGPU. No install, no account, no license fees. Open source runtime with CLI, NPM package, and Jupyter kernel support.
entries.desc_zh: 浏览器中的 GPU 加速数值计算 IDE。编写并运行 MATLAB 语法的 .m 文件，通过 WebAssembly 和 WebGPU 自动实现 GPU 加速。无需安装、无需账号、无许可费用。开源运行时，支持 CLI、NPM 包和 Jupyter kernel。

entries.name: SoloLearn
entries.desc_en: A cloud programming playground well-suited for running code snippets. Supports various programming languages. No registration is required for running code, but it is necessary when saving code on their platform. Also offers free courses for beginners and intermediate-level coders.
entries.desc_zh: 一个非常适合运行代码片段的云端编程演练场。支持多种编程语言。运行代码无需注册，但在其平台上保存代码时则需要注册。还为初学者和中级程序员提供免费课程。

entries.name: stackblitz.com
entries.desc_en: Online/Cloud Code IDE to create, edit, & deploy full-stack apps. Support any popular NodeJs-based frontend & backend frameworks. Shortlink to create a new project: [https://node.new](https://node.new).
entries.desc_zh: 用于创建、编辑和部署全栈应用的在线/云端代码 IDE。支持任何流行的基于 NodeJs 的前端和后端框架。创建新项目的短链接：[https://node.new](https://node.new)。

entries.name: Sublime Text
entries.desc_en: Sublime Text is a popular, versatile, and highly customizable text editor used for coding and text editing tasks.
entries.desc_zh: Sublime Text 是一款流行、多功能且高度可定制的文本编辑器，用于编码和文本编辑任务。

entries.name: Visual Studio Code
entries.desc_en: Code editor redefined and optimized for building and debugging modern web and cloud applications. Developed by Microsoft.
entries.desc_zh: 为构建和调试现代 Web 与云应用而重新定义并优化的代码编辑器。由 Microsoft 开发。

entries.name: Visual Studio Community
entries.desc_en: Fully-featured IDE with thousands of extensions, cross-platform app development (Microsoft extensions available for download for iOS and Android), desktop, web and cloud development, multi-language support (C#, C++, JavaScript, Python, PHP and more).
entries.desc_zh: 功能齐全的 IDE，拥有数千个扩展，支持跨平台应用开发（Microsoft 为 iOS 和 Android 提供可下载的扩展）、桌面、Web 和云开发，以及多语言支持（C#、C++、JavaScript、Python、PHP 等）。

entries.name: VSCodium
entries.desc_en: Community-driven, without telemetry/tracking, and freely-licensed binary distribution of Microsoft’s editor VSCode
entries.desc_zh: 社区驱动、无遥测/跟踪、采用自由许可的 Microsoft 编辑器 VSCode 二进制发行版。

entries.name: wakatime.com
entries.desc_en: Quantified self-metrics about your coding activity using text editor plugins, limited plan for free.
entries.desc_zh: 通过文本编辑器插件获取关于你编码活动的量化自我指标，免费提供有限计划。

entries.name: Wave Terminal
entries.desc_en: Wave is an open-source, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows. Render anything inline. Save sessions and history. Powered by open web standards. MacOS and Linux.
entries.desc_zh: Wave 是一款开源、跨平台的终端，助你实现无缝工作流。可内联渲染任何内容。可保存会话和历史记录。基于开放的 Web 标准。支持 MacOS 和 Linux。

entries.name: amplitude.com
entries.desc_en: 1 million monthly events, up to 2 apps
entries.desc_zh: 每月 100 万个事件，最多 2 个应用。

entries.name: AppFit
entries.desc_en: AppFit is a comprehensive analytics and product management tool designed to facilitate seamless, cross-platform management of analytics and product updates. Free plan includes 10,000 events per month, product journal and weekly insights.
entries.desc_zh: AppFit 是一款全面的分析和产品管理工具，旨在实现跨平台的无缝分析管理与产品更新管理。免费计划包含每月 10,000 个事件、产品日志和每周洞察。

entries.name: Aptabase
entries.desc_en: Open Source, Privacy-Friendly, and Simple Analytics for Mobile and Desktop Apps. SDKs for Swift, Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, Electron, and many others. Free for up to 20,000 events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向移动和桌面应用的开源、注重隐私且简单的分析工具。提供适用于 Swift、Kotlin、React Native、Flutter、Electron 等多种平台的 SDK。每月最多 20,000 个事件免费。

entries.name: Avo
entries.desc_en: Simplified analytics release workflow. Single-source-of-truth tracking plan, type-safe analytics tracking library, in-app debuggers, and data observability to catch all data issues before you release. Free for two workspace members and 1 hour data observability lookback.
entries.desc_zh: 简化的分析发布工作流程。单一真实来源的跟踪计划、类型安全的分析跟踪库、应用内调试器和数据可观察性，可在发布前捕获所有数据问题。免费支持两名工作区成员和 1 小时的数据可观察性回溯。

entries.name: Beampipe.io
entries.desc_en: Beampipe is simple, privacy-focussed web analytics. free for up to 5 domains & 10k monthly page views.
entries.desc_zh: Beampipe 是一款简单、注重隐私的网站分析工具。最多 5 个域名和每月 1 万次页面浏览量免费。

entries.name: Cabin
entries.desc_en: Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics with per-page carbon estimates and an MCP server for AI assistants. Free plan: 1 site, 10k pageviews/month.
entries.desc_zh: 隐私优先、无 Cookie 的网站分析，提供逐页碳排放估算和面向 AI 助手的 MCP 服务器。免费计划：1 个站点，每月 1 万次页面浏览量。

entries.name: Census
entries.desc_en: Reverse ETL & Operational Analytics Platform. Sync 10 fields from your data warehouse to 60+ SaaS like Salesforce, Zendesk, or Amplitude.
entries.desc_zh: Reverse ETL 与运营分析平台。将 10 个字段从数据仓库同步到 Salesforce、Zendesk 或 Amplitude 等 60 多个 SaaS。

entries.name: Clicky
entries.desc_en: Website Analytics Platform. Free Plan for one website with 3000 views analytics.
entries.desc_zh: 网站分析平台。免费计划适用于一个网站，提供 3000 次浏览量分析。

entries.name: counter.dev
entries.desc_en: Web analytics made simple and therefore privacy friendly. Free or pay what you want by donation.
entries.desc_zh: 让网站分析变得简单，因而对隐私友好。免费，或按你的意愿捐赠付费。

entries.name: DevDome
entries.desc_en: Cookieless web analytics for WordPress that counts human visitors separately from bots and AI crawlers. Free plan: unlimited sites, 50,000 human pageviews per month, 90 days of data retention.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于 WordPress 的无 Cookie 网站分析，将真人访客与机器人和 AI 爬虫分开统计。免费计划：站点数量不限，每月 5 万次真人页面浏览量，数据保留 90 天。

entries.name: DocBeacon
entries.desc_en: Secure document sharing with document tracking and engagement Analytics. Free plan supports up to 20 PDF documents (10 MB max), 10 contacts, and 2 shares per document with basic analytics for views downloads, time and engagement.
entries.desc_zh: 安全的文档共享，带文档跟踪和互动分析。免费计划支持最多 20 个 PDF 文档（单个最大 10 MB）、10 个联系人，每个文档可分享 2 次，并提供关于浏览、下载、时间和互动的基础分析。

entries.name: Dwh.dev
entries.desc_en: Data Cloud Observability Solution (Snowflake). Free for personal use.
entries.desc_zh: 数据云可观测性解决方案（Snowflake）。个人使用免费。

entries.name: Expensify
entries.desc_en: Expense reporting, free personal reporting approval workflow
entries.desc_zh: 费用报告，免费的个人报告审批工作流程

entries.name: getinsights.io
entries.desc_en: Privacy-focused, cookie-free analytics, free for up to 3k events/month.
entries.desc_zh: 注重隐私、无 Cookie 的分析工具，每月最多 3000 个事件免费。

entries.name: Gizmo Analytics
entries.desc_en: Simple analytics for people managing lots of sites. Install manually or let Claude/Cursor do it for you. Free for up to 10k events/month.
entries.desc_zh: 为管理大量站点的人打造的简单分析工具。可手动安装，或让 Claude/Cursor 代劳。每月最多 1 万个事件免费。

entries.name: GoatCounter
entries.desc_en: GoatCounter is an open-source web analytics platform available as a hosted service (free for non-commercial use) or self-hosted app. It aims to offer easy-to-use and meaningful privacy-friendly web analytics as an alternative to Google Analytics or Matomo. The free tier is for non-commercial use and includes unlimited sites, six months of data retention, and 100k pageviews/month.
entries.desc_zh: GoatCounter 是一个开源网站分析平台，提供托管服务（非商业用途免费）或自托管应用。它旨在提供易用、有意义且对隐私友好的网站分析，作为 Google Analytics 或 Matomo 的替代品。免费层仅限非商业用途，包括不限站点数量、数据保留六个月，以及每月 10 万次页面浏览量。

entries.name: Google Analytics
entries.desc_en: Google Analytics
entries.desc_zh: Google Analytics

entries.name: heap.io
entries.desc_en: Automatically captures every user action in iOS or web apps. Free for up to 10K monthly sessions.
entries.desc_zh: 自动捕获 iOS 或网页应用中的每一个用户操作。每月最多 1 万个会话免费。

entries.name: Hightouch
entries.desc_en: Hightouch is a Reverse ETL platform that helps you sync customer data from your data warehouse to your CRM, marketing, and support tools. The free tier offers you one destination to sync data to.
entries.desc_zh: Hightouch 是一个 Reverse ETL 平台，帮助你将客户数据从数据仓库同步到 CRM、营销和客服支持工具。免费层提供一个可同步数据的目标端。

entries.name: HitKeep
entries.desc_en: Privacy-focused, open-source web and product analytics platform with a free cloud plan for 3 websites, 3 team members, 60-day data retention, AI analytics, goals, funnels, events, and hits.
entries.desc_zh: 注重隐私的开源网站和产品分析平台，免费云计划包含 3 个网站、3 名团队成员、60 天数据保留，以及 AI 分析、目标、漏斗、事件和命中数。

entries.name: Hotjar
entries.desc_en: Website Analytics and Reports . Free Plan allows 2000 pageviews/day. One hundred snapshots/day (max capacity: 300). Three snapshot heatmaps can be stored for 365 days. Unlimited Team Members. Also in App and standalone surveys, feedback widgets with screenshots. Free tier allows creating 3 surveys & 3 feedback widgets and collecting 20 responses per month.
entries.desc_zh: 网站分析与报告。免费版每天允许 2000 次页面浏览量。每天 100 个快照（最大容量：300 个）。三个快照热图可存储 365 天。团队成员数量不限。此外还有应用内及独立调查问卷、带截图的反馈小组件。免费层可创建 3 个调查问卷和 3 个反馈小组件，每月收集 20 条回复。

entries.name: LogSpot
entries.desc_en: Full unified web and product analytics platform, including embeddable analytics widgets and automated robots (slack, telegram, and webhooks). Free plan includes 10,000 events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 完整的统一网站和产品分析平台，包括可嵌入的分析组件和自动化机器人（slack、telegram 和 webhooks）。免费计划包含每月 1 万个事件。

entries.name: Mixpanel
entries.desc_en: 100,000 monthly tracked users, unlimited data history and seats, US or EU data residency
entries.desc_zh: 10 万名月度追踪用户，数据历史和席位不限，数据驻留地可选美国或欧盟

entries.name: Moesif
entries.desc_en: API analytics for REST and GraphQL. (Free up to 500,000 API calls/mo)
entries.desc_zh: 面向 REST 和 GraphQL 的 API 分析。（每月最多 50 万次 API 调用免费）

entries.name: PostHog
entries.desc_en: Full Product Analytics suite free for up to 1m tracked events per month. Also provides unlimited in-App Surveys with 250/month responses.
entries.desc_zh: 完整的产品分析套件，每月最多 100 万个追踪事件免费。还提供不限量的应用内问卷，每月 250 条回复。

entries.name: Repohistory
entries.desc_en: Beautiful dashboard for tracking GitHub repo traffic history longer than 14 days. Free Plan allows users to monitor traffic for a single repository.
entries.desc_zh: 美观的仪表板，可追踪超过 14 天的 GitHub 仓库流量历史。免费计划允许用户监控单个仓库的流量。

entries.name: Row Zero
entries.desc_en: Blazingly fast, connected spreadsheet. Connect directly to data databases, S3, and APIs. Import, analyze, graph, and share millions of rows instantly. Three free (forever) workbooks.
entries.desc_zh: 极速连接电子表格。直接连接到数据数据库、S3 和 API。即时导入、分析、图表化和分享数百万行数据。三个免费（永久）工作簿。

entries.name: Rybbit
entries.desc_en: Open-source and cookieless alternative to Google Analytics that is 10x more intuitive. Free plans has 3,000 monthly events.
entries.desc_zh: 开源、无 Cookie 的 Google Analytics 替代品，直观程度是其 10 倍。免费计划提供每月 3000 个事件。

entries.name: Seline
entries.desc_en: Seline is a simple & private website and product analytics. Cookieless, lightweight, independent. Free plan includes 3,000 events per month and provides access to all our features, such as the dashboard, user journeys, funnels, and more.
entries.desc_zh: Seline 是一款简单且注重隐私的网站和产品分析工具。无 Cookie、轻量、独立。免费计划包含每月 3000 个事件，并可使用所有功能，例如仪表板、用户旅程、漏斗等。

entries.name: StatCounter
entries.desc_en: Website Viewer Analytics. Free plan for analytics of 500 most recent visitors.
entries.desc_zh: 网站访客分析。免费计划可分析最近 500 位访客。

entries.name: Stats4U
entries.desc_en: A visitor counter and web stats service operated from Poland, since 2006. Website owners choose a counter design copy the code and paste it into their site; no account is required. Free without paid plans. Privacy First: Stats4U does not set cookies and Counter data is processed on the operator's own server in the EU.
entries.desc_zh: 自 2006 年起由波兰运营的访客计数器和网站统计服务。网站所有者选择计数器样式，复制代码并粘贴到自己的网站即可，无需注册账户。完全免费，无付费计划。隐私优先：Stats4U 不设置 Cookie，计数器数据在运营者自己位于欧盟的服务器上处理。

entries.name: Statsig
entries.desc_en: All-in-one platform spanning across analytics, feature flagging, and A/B testing. Free for up to 1m metered events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 涵盖分析、功能开关和 A/B 测试的一体化平台。每月最多 100 万个计量事件免费。

entries.name: TraceLog
entries.desc_en: AI Analytics for E-commerce. Ask questions in natural language about your analytics, get actionable recommendations and grow your revenue with AI-powered insights. Free for up to 10k events per month.
entries.desc_zh: 面向电子商务的 AI 分析。用自然语言就你的分析数据提问，获得可执行的建议，并通过 AI 洞察提升收入。每月最多 1 万个事件免费。

entries.name: Trackingplan
entries.desc_en: Automatically detect digital analytics, marketing data and pixels issues, maintain up-to-date tracking plans, and foster seamless collaboration. Deploy it to your production environment with real traffic or add analytics coverage to your regression tests without writing code.
entries.desc_zh: 自动检测数字分析、营销数据和像素（pixels）问题，维护最新的跟踪计划，并促进无缝协作。可将其部署到有真实流量的生产环境，或无需编写代码即可为回归测试添加分析覆盖。

entries.name: TrackWith Dicloud
entries.desc_en: Free lightweight privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics. Unlimited pageviews, unlimited visitor, unlimited page heatmaps & goal tracking. Free for up to 3 domains and 600 session replay per domain.
entries.desc_zh: 免费、轻量、注重隐私的 Google Analytics 替代品。页面浏览量、访客数、页面热图和目标跟踪均不限量。免费支持最多 3 个域名，每个域名 600 次会话回放。

entries.name: Umami
entries.desc_en: Simple, fast, privacy-focused, open-source alternative to Google Analytics.
entries.desc_zh: 简单、快速、注重隐私的开源 Google Analytics 替代品。

entries.name: usabilityhub.com
entries.desc_en: Test designs and mockups on real people and track visitors. Free for one user, unlimited tests
entries.desc_zh: 在真实用户身上测试设计和模型，并跟踪访客。一个用户免费，无限测试

entries.name: FullStory.com
entries.desc_en: 1,000 sessions/month with one month data retention and three user seats. More information [here](https://help.fullstory.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020623354-FullStory-Free-Edition).
entries.desc_zh: 每月 1,000 个会话，数据保留一个月，共 3 个用户席位。更多信息请见 [here](https://help.fullstory.com/hc/en-us/articles/360020623354-FullStory-Free-Edition)。

entries.name: howuku.com
entries.desc_en: Track user interaction, engagement, and event. Free for up to 5,000 visits/month
entries.desc_zh: 跟踪用户互动、参与度和事件。每月最多 5000 次访问免费

entries.name: inspectlet.com
entries.desc_en: 2,500 sessions/month free for one website
entries.desc_zh: 一个网站每月 2500 个会话免费

entries.name: LogRocket.com
entries.desc_en: 1,000 sessions/month with 30-day retention, error tracking, live mode
entries.desc_zh: 每月 1000 个会话，含 30 天数据保留、错误跟踪和实时模式

entries.name: Microsoft Clarity
entries.desc_en: Session recording completely free with "no traffic limits", no project limits, and no sampling
entries.desc_zh: 会话录制完全免费，"无流量限制"、无项目数量限制、无抽样

entries.name: mouseflow.com
entries.desc_en: 500 sessions/month free for one website
entries.desc_zh: 一个网站每月 500 个会话免费

entries.name: OpenReplay.com
entries.desc_en: Open-source session replay with dev tools for bug reproduction, live session for real-time support, and product analytics suite. One thousand sessions/month with access to all features and 7-day retention.
entries.desc_zh: 开源会话回放，附带用于复现 bug 的开发工具、用于实时支持的实时会话，以及产品分析套件。每月 1,000 个会话，可使用所有功能，数据保留 7 天。

entries.name: Reactflow.com
entries.desc_en: Per site: 1,000 pages views/day, three heatmaps, three widgets, free bug tracking
entries.desc_zh: 每个站点：每天 1,000 次页面浏览，三个热力图，三个小部件，免费错误跟踪

entries.name: smartlook.com
entries.desc_en: free packages for web and mobile apps (1500 sessions/month), three heatmaps, one funnel, 1-month data history
entries.desc_zh: 面向 Web 和移动应用的免费套餐（每月 1500 个会话）、三个热力图、一个漏斗、1 个月数据历史

entries.name: UXtweak.com
entries.desc_en: Record and watch how visitors use your website or app. Free unlimited time for small projects
entries.desc_zh: 录制并观看访客如何使用你的网站或应用。小型项目可免费无限时使用

entries.name: numverify
entries.desc_en: Global phone number validation and lookup JSON API. 100 API requests/month
entries.desc_zh: 全球电话号码验证和查询 JSON API。每月 100 次 API 请求

entries.name: veriphone
entries.desc_en: Global phone number verification in a free, fast, reliable JSON API. 1000 requests/month
entries.desc_zh: 通过免费、快速、可靠的 JSON API 进行全球电话号码验证。每月 1000 次请求

entries.name: Adapty.io
entries.desc_en: One-stop solution with open-source SDK for mobile in-app subscription integration to iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, or web app. Free up to $10k monthly revenue.
entries.desc_zh: 一站式解决方案，提供开源 SDK，用于 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Unity 或 Web 应用的移动端应用内订阅集成。月收入 $10k 以内免费。

entries.name: AllRatesToday
entries.desc_en: Real-time mid-market exchange rates for 150+ currencies with official JavaScript, Python, and PHP SDKs. Free tier includes 300 requests/month over HTTPS.
entries.desc_zh: 为 150+ 种货币提供实时中间市场汇率，附带官方 JavaScript、Python 和 PHP SDK。免费层包含每月 300 次 HTTPS 请求。

entries.name: Churnkey
entries.desc_en: Cancel flows (open-sourced), churn metrics, and revenue analytics for subscription businesses. Free forever.
entries.desc_zh: 面向订阅制业务的取消流程（开源）、流失指标和收入分析。永久免费。

entries.name: Currencyapi
entries.desc_en: Free currency conversion and exchange rate data API. Free 300 requests per month, 10 requests per minute for private use.
entries.desc_zh: 免费的货币兑换和汇率数据 API。私人使用每月免费 300 次请求，每分钟 10 次请求。

entries.name: CurrencyApi
entries.desc_en: Live Currency Rates for Physical and Cryptocurrencies, delivered in JSON and XML. The free tier offers 1,250 API requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 以 JSON 和 XML 格式提供的法币和加密货币实时汇率。免费层提供每月 1,250 次 API 请求。

entries.name: CurrencyFreaks
entries.desc_en: Provides current and historical currency exchange rates. Free DEVELOPER plan available with 1000 requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 提供当前和历史的货币汇率。提供免费 DEVELOPER 计划，每月 1000 次请求。

entries.name: currencylayer
entries.desc_en: Reliable Exchange Rates and Currency Conversion for your Business, 100 API requests/month free.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的企业提供可靠的汇率和货币兑换，每月免费 100 次 API 请求。

entries.name: exchangerate-api.com
entries.desc_en: An easy-to-use currency conversion JSON API. The free tier updates once per day with a limit of 1,500 requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 易于使用的货币兑换 JSON API。免费层每天更新一次，限额为每月 1,500 次请求。

entries.name: Exchange Rate API
entries.desc_en: Real-time currency rates for 160+ currencies with 60-second updates and official SDKs. Free tier includes 300 requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 为 160+ 种货币提供实时汇率，60 秒更新，附带官方 SDK。免费层包含每月 300 次请求。

entries.name: FraudLabsPRO
entries.desc_en: Help merchants to prevent payment fraud and chargebacks. Free Micro Plan available with 500 queries/month.
entries.desc_zh: 帮助商户防止支付欺诈和拒付。提供免费 Micro 计划，每月 500 次查询。

entries.name: FxRatesAPI
entries.desc_en: Provides real-time and historical exchange rates. The free tier requires attribution.
entries.desc_zh: 提供实时和历史汇率。免费层要求注明来源。

entries.name: Moesif API Monetization
entries.desc_en: Generate revenue from APIs via usage-based billing. Connect to Stripe, Chargebee, etc. The free tier offers 30,000 events/month.
entries.desc_zh: 通过基于用量的计费从 API 获取收入。可连接 Stripe、Chargebee 等。免费层提供每月 30,000 个事件。

entries.name: ParityVend
entries.desc_en: Automatically adjust pricing based on visitor location to expand your business globally and reach new markets (purchasing power parity). The free plan includes 7,500 API requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 根据访客所在地自动调整定价，在全球拓展业务并触达新市场（购买力平价）。免费计划包含每月 7,500 次 API 请求。

entries.name: Qonversion
entries.desc_en: All-in-one cross-platform subscription management platform offering analytics, A/B testing, Apple Search Ads, remote configs, and growth tools for optimizing in-app purchases and monetization. Compatible with iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, Cordova, Stripe, and web. Free up to $10k in monthly tracked revenue.
entries.desc_zh: 一体化跨平台订阅管理平台，提供分析、A/B 测试、Apple Search Ads、远程配置和增长工具，用于优化应用内购买和变现。兼容 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Unity、Cordova、Stripe 和 Web。每月追踪收入 $10k 以内免费。

entries.name: RevenueCat
entries.desc_en: Hosted backend for in-app purchases and subscriptions (iOS and Android). Free up to $2.5k/mo in tracked revenue.
entries.desc_zh: 应用内购买和订阅的托管后端（iOS 和 Android）。每月追踪收入 $2.5k 以内免费。

entries.name: vatlayer
entries.desc_en: Instant VAT number validation and EU VAT rates API, free 100 API requests/month
entries.desc_zh: 即时 VAT 号码验证和欧盟 VAT 税率 API，每月免费 100 次 API 请求

entries.name: Appish
entries.desc_en: Host Docker containers for demos with just a docker push. Free tier includes 1 slot with 2-hour sessions.
entries.desc_zh: 只需一个 docker push 即可托管用于演示的 Docker 容器。免费层包含 1 个槽位，会话时长 2 小时。

entries.name: Container Registry Service
entries.desc_en: Harbor based Container Management Solution. The free tier offers 1 GB of storage for private repositories.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 Harbor 的容器管理解决方案。免费层为私有仓库提供 1 GB 存储空间。

entries.name: Docker Hub
entries.desc_en: One free private repository and unlimited public repositories to build and store Docker images
entries.desc_zh: 一个免费的私有仓库和无限公共仓库，用于构建和存储 Docker 镜像

entries.name: quay.io
entries.desc_en: Build and store container images with unlimited free public repositories
entries.desc_zh: 构建并存储容器镜像，免费公共仓库数量不限

entries.name: ttl.sh
entries.desc_en: Anonymous & ephemeral Docker image registry
entries.desc_zh: 匿名且临时的 Docker 镜像仓库

entries.name: AyeDot
entries.desc_en: Share your ideas, knowledge, and stories with the world for Free in the form of Modern multimedia short-format Miniblogs.
entries.desc_zh: 以现代多媒体短篇 Miniblogs 的形式，免费与世界分享你的想法、知识和故事。

entries.name: BearBlog
entries.desc_en: Minimalist, Markdown-powered blog and website builder.
entries.desc_zh: 极简的、基于 Markdown 的博客和网站构建器。

entries.name: Dev.to
entries.desc_en: Where programmers share ideas and help each other grow.
entries.desc_zh: 程序员分享想法、互相帮助成长的地方。

entries.name: Hashnode
entries.desc_en: Hassle-free Blogging Software for Developers!.
entries.desc_zh: 为开发者打造的无烦恼博客软件！

entries.name: Medium
entries.desc_en: Get more thoughtful about what matters to you.
entries.desc_zh: 对自己在意的事情进行更用心的思考。

entries.name: JustBlogged
entries.desc_en: Free blogging platform with custom domain support, and fast global performance.
entries.desc_zh: 支持自定义域名的免费博客平台，具有快速全球性能。

entries.name: GraphComment
entries.desc_en: GraphComment is a comments platform that helps you build an active community from the website’s audience.
entries.desc_zh: GraphComment 是一个评论平台，帮助你从网站受众中建立活跃的社区。

entries.name: IntenseDebate
entries.desc_en: A feature-rich comment system for WordPress, Tumblr, Blogger, and many other website platforms.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于 WordPress、Tumblr、Blogger 以及许多其他网站平台的功能丰富的评论系统。

entries.name: Remarkbox
entries.desc_en: Open source hosted comments platform, pay what you can for "One moderator on a few domains with complete control over behavior & appearance"
entries.desc_zh: 开源的托管评论平台，按你的能力付费，即可获得"在几个域名上拥有一个版主，并可完全控制行为与外观"的服务。

entries.name: Utterances
entries.desc_en: A lightweight comments widget built on GitHub issues. Use GitHub issues for blog comments, wiki pages, and more!
entries.desc_zh: 基于 GitHub issues 构建的轻量级评论小部件。将 GitHub issues 用于博客评论、Wiki 页面等！

entries.name: ApiFlash
entries.desc_en: A screenshot API based on Aws Lambda and Chrome. Handles full page, captures timing, and viewport dimensions.
entries.desc_zh: 基于 Aws Lambda 和 Chrome 的截图 API。支持整页截图、捕获时序和视口尺寸。

entries.name: microlink.io
entries.desc_en: It turns any website into data such as metatags normalization, beauty link previews, scraping capabilities, or screenshots as a service. 50 requests/day every day free.
entries.desc_zh: 它可将任何网站转换为数据，例如 metatags 规范化、美观的链接预览、抓取功能或截图即服务。每天免费 50 次请求，天天可用。

entries.name: PhantomJsCloud
entries.desc_en: Browser automation and page rendering.  Free Tier offers up to 500 pages/day.  Free Tier since 2017.
entries.desc_zh: 浏览器自动化和页面渲染。免费层提供每天最多 500 页。自 2017 年起提供免费层。

entries.name: Ironfang Render
entries.desc_en: UK-based screenshot, PDF, image, QR code and clip rendering API with reusable templates and signed URLs. 250 free renders a month with no payment details needed to get started.
entries.desc_zh: 总部位于英国的截图、PDF、图像、二维码和剪辑渲染 API，提供可复用模板和签名 URL。每月免费 250 次渲染，无需付款信息即可开始使用。

entries.name: screenshotbase.com
entries.desc_en: 300 free screenshots / month. Take screenshots from any url. Fast, free & scalable.
entries.desc_zh: 每月 300 张免费截图。从任何 URL 截取屏幕截图。快速、免费且可扩展。

entries.name: screenshotlayer.com
entries.desc_en: Capture highly customizable snapshots of any website. Free 100 snapshots/month
entries.desc_zh: 为任何网站捕获高度可自定义的快照。每月免费 100 张快照。

entries.name: screenshotmachine.com
entries.desc_en: Capture 100 snapshots/month, png, gif and jpg, including full-length captures, not only home page
entries.desc_zh: 每月捕获 100 张快照，支持 png、gif 和 jpg 格式，包括整页截图，而不仅仅是首页。

entries.name: Screenshot Scout
entries.desc_en: Screenshot API for developers. Clean, production-ready screenshots from any URL in one request. Free plan includes 200 screenshots per month, forever.
entries.desc_zh: 面向开发者的截图 API。一次请求即可从任何 URL 生成干净、可用于生产环境的截图。免费计划每月包含 200 张截图，永久有效。

entries.name: Shotpipe
entries.desc_en: Screenshot and Open Graph image API built for static sites. Free tier includes 100 renders/month, no card required. cached renders are free.
entries.desc_zh: 专为静态网站打造的截图和 Open Graph 图片 API。免费层包含每月 100 次渲染，无需信用卡。缓存渲染免费。

entries.name: SnapAPI
entries.desc_en: Screenshot, video recording, PDF generation, and web data extraction API. Free plan includes 200 screenshots/month.
entries.desc_zh: 截图、视频录制、PDF 生成和网页数据提取 API。免费计划包含每月 200 张截图。

entries.name: thumbnail.ws
entries.desc_en: API for generating thumbnails of websites. Free 1,000 requests/month.
entries.desc_zh: 用于生成网站缩略图的 API。每月免费 1,000 次请求。

entries.name: localscreenshot
entries.desc_en: Screenshot API that turns any public page into an image or a PDF, from 227 countries, with cookie banners, ads and chat widgets hidden. Also runs as an MCP server, so AI agents take screenshots on their own. Free plan includes 50 screenshots every month, no card required.
entries.desc_zh: 截图 API，可将任何公开页面转换为图片或 PDF，覆盖 227 个国家/地区，并隐藏 cookie 横幅、广告和聊天组件。还可作为 MCP 服务器运行，让 AI 智能体自行截图。免费计划每月包含 50 张截图，无需信用卡。

entries.name: CodeMagic
entries.desc_en: Codemagic is a fully hosted and managed CI/CD for mobile apps. You can build, test, and deploy with a GUI-based CI/CD tool. The free tier offers 500 free minutes/month and a Mac Mini instance with 2.3 GHz and 8 GB of RAM.
entries.desc_zh: Codemagic 是面向移动应用的完全托管式 CI/CD。你可以使用基于 GUI 的 CI/CD 工具进行构建、测试和部署。免费层提供每月 500 分钟的免费时长，以及一台 2.3 GHz、8 GB 内存的 Mac Mini 实例。

entries.name: FlutLab
entries.desc_en: FlutLab is a modern Flutter online IDE and the best place to create, debug, and build cross-platform projects. Build iOS (Without a Mac) and Android apps with Flutter.
entries.desc_zh: FlutLab 是一款现代化的 Flutter 在线 IDE，也是创建、调试和构建跨平台项目的最佳场所。使用 Flutter 构建 iOS（无需 Mac）和 Android 应用。

entries.name: FlutterFlow
entries.desc_en: FlutterFlow is a browser-based drag-and-drop interface to build mobile app using flutter.
entries.desc_zh: FlutterFlow 是一个基于浏览器的拖放式界面，用于使用 Flutter 构建移动应用。

entries.name: Bearer
entries.desc_en: Helps implement privacy by design via audits and continuous workflows so that organizations comply with GDPR and other regulations. The free tier is limited to smaller teams and the SaaS version only.
entries.desc_zh: 通过审计和持续的工作流帮助落实 privacy by design，使组织符合 GDPR 及其他法规。免费层仅限较小的团队，且仅限 SaaS 版本。

entries.name: Concord
entries.desc_en: Full data privacy platform, including consent management, privacy request handling (DSARs), and data mapping. Free tier includes core consent management features and they also provide a more advanced plan for free to verified open source projects.
entries.desc_zh: 完整的数据隐私平台，包括同意管理、隐私请求处理（DSARs）和数据映射。免费套餐包含核心同意管理功能，他们还为经过验证的开源项目提供更高级的免费计划。

entries.name: Cookiefirst
entries.desc_en: Cookie banners, auditing, and multi-language consent management solution. The free tier offers a one-time scan and a single banner.
entries.desc_zh: Cookie 横幅、审计和多语言同意管理解决方案。免费层提供一次性扫描和单个横幅。

entries.name: Iubenda
entries.desc_en: Privacy and cookie policies and consent management. The free tier offers limited privacy and cookie policy as well as cookie banners.
entries.desc_zh: 隐私政策、Cookie 政策和同意管理。免费层提供有限的隐私和 Cookie 政策以及 Cookie 横幅。

entries.name: Ketch
entries.desc_en: Consent management and privacy framework tool. The free tier offers most features with a limited visitor count.
entries.desc_zh: 同意管理和隐私框架工具。免费套餐提供大多数功能，但访问者数量有限制。

entries.name: BinShare.net
entries.desc_en: Create & share code or binaries. Available to share as a beautiful image e.g. for Twitter / Facebook post or as a link e.g. for chats or forums.
entries.desc_zh: 创建并分享代码或二进制文件。可作为精美图片分享（例如用于 Twitter / Facebook 帖子），也可作为链接分享（例如用于聊天或论坛）。

entries.name: Blynk
entries.desc_en: A SaaS with API to control, build & evaluate IoT devices. Free Developer Plan with 5 devices, Free Cloud & data storage. Mobile Apps are also available.
entries.desc_zh: 一款带 API 的 SaaS，用于控制、构建和评估 IoT 设备。免费 Developer Plan 包含 5 台设备，以及免费的云端和数据存储。也提供移动应用。

entries.name: cron-job.org
entries.desc_en: Online cronjobs service. Unlimited jobs are free of charge.
entries.desc_zh: 在线 cron 任务服务。不限数量的任务均可免费使用。

entries.name: Cronhooks
entries.desc_en: Schedule on-time or recurring webhooks. The free plan allows 5 ad-hoc schedules.
entries.desc_zh: 安排定时或周期性触发的 webhook。免费计划允许 5 个临时调度。

entries.name: datelist.io
entries.desc_en: Online booking / appointment scheduling system. Free up to 5 bookings per month, includes 1 calendar
entries.desc_zh: 在线预订/预约排期系统。每月最多 5 次预订免费，包含 1 个日历。

entries.name: FOSSA
entries.desc_en: Scalable, end-to-end management for third-party code, license compliance and vulnerabilities.
entries.desc_zh: 为第三方代码、许可证合规和漏洞提供可扩展的端到端管理。

entries.name: Hook Relay
entries.desc_en: Add webhook support to your app without the hassles: done-for-you queueing, retries with backoff, and logging. The free plan has 100 deliveries per day, 14-day retention, and 3 hook endpoints.
entries.desc_zh: 为你的应用添加 webhook 支持，免去各种麻烦：代办的排队处理、带退避机制的重试以及日志记录。免费计划提供每天 100 次投递、14 天保留期和 3 个 hook 端点。

entries.name: Hosting Checker
entries.desc_en: Check hosting information such as ASN, ISP, location and more for any domain, website or IP address. Also includes multiple hosting and DNS-related tools.
entries.desc_zh: 查询任何域名、网站或 IP 地址的托管信息，如 ASN、ISP、位置等。还包含多种托管和 DNS 相关工具。

entries.name: newreleases.io
entries.desc_en: Receive notifications on email, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and custom webhooks for new releases from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Python PyPI, Java Maven, Node.js NPM, Node.js Yarn, Ruby Gems, PHP Packagist, .NET NuGet, Rust Cargo and Docker Hub.
entries.desc_zh: 通过电子邮件、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和自定义 webhook，接收来自 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Python PyPI、Java Maven、Node.js NPM、Node.js Yarn、Ruby Gems、PHP Packagist、.NET NuGet、Rust Cargo 和 Docker Hub 的新版本发布通知。

entries.name: PDFMonkey
entries.desc_en: Manage PDF templates in a dashboard, call the API with dynamic data, and download your PDF. Offers 300 free documents per month.
entries.desc_zh: 在仪表板中管理 PDF 模板，使用动态数据调用 API，然后下载你的 PDF。每月提供 300 份免费文档。

entries.name: Pika Code Screenshots
entries.desc_en: Create beautiful, customizable screenshots from code snippets and VSCode using the extension.
entries.desc_zh: 使用该扩展，从代码片段和 VSCode 创建美观、可自定义的截图。

entries.name: QuickType.io
entries.desc_en: Quickly auto-generate models/class/type/interface and serializers from JSON, schema, and GraphQL for working with data quickly & safely in any programming language. Convert JSON into gorgeous, typesafe code in any language.
entries.desc_zh: 从 JSON、schema 和 GraphQL 快速自动生成模型/类/类型/接口和序列化器，以便在任何编程语言中快速且安全地处理数据。将 JSON 转换为任何语言的精美类型安全代码。

entries.name: readme.com
entries.desc_en: Beautiful documentation made easy, free for Open Source.
entries.desc_zh: 轻松创建精美的文档，对开源项目免费。

entries.name: redirect.pizza
entries.desc_en: Easily manage redirects with HTTPS support. The free plan includes 10 sources and 100,000 hits per month.
entries.desc_zh: 轻松管理重定向，支持 HTTPS。免费计划包含 10 个源和每月 100,000 次访问。

entries.name: redirection.io
entries.desc_en: SaaS tool for managing HTTP redirections for businesses, marketing and SEO.
entries.desc_zh: 面向企业、营销和 SEO 的 HTTP 重定向管理 SaaS 工具。

entries.name: redirs.com
entries.desc_en: Easy domain redirects with auto-SSL, analytics, and URL path forwarding. Free for basic use (up to 5 domains).
entries.desc_zh: 轻松实现域名重定向，支持自动 SSL、分析和 URL 路径转发。基础用途免费（最多 5 个域名）。

entries.name: RedirHub
entries.desc_en: API-first URL redirect infrastructure with custom nameservers, edge network, HTTPS, and proactive link monitoring. Free plan includes 2 hostnames, 100K requests per month, auto-SSL, path forwarding, and REST API access.
entries.desc_zh: API 优先的 URL 重定向基础设施，具备自定义域名服务器、边缘网络、HTTPS 和主动链接监控。免费计划包含 2 个主机名、每月 100,000 次请求、自动 SSL、路径转发和 REST API 访问。

entries.name: ReqBin
entries.desc_en: Post HTTP Requests Online. Popular Request Methods include GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and HEAD. Supports Headers and Token Authentication. Includes a basic login system for saving your requests.
entries.desc_zh: 在线发送 HTTP 请求。常用请求方法包括 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE 和 HEAD。支持 Headers 和 Token 认证。包含一个用于保存你所发请求的基础登录系统。

entries.name: Smartcar API
entries.desc_en: An API for cars to locate, get fuel tank, battery levels, odometer, unlock/lock doors, etc.
entries.desc_zh: 一个面向汽车的 API，可实现定位、获取油箱油量、电池电量、里程表读数、解锁/锁定车门等功能。

entries.name: Splainly
entries.desc_en: Create product explainer videos for sales and marketing needs. Videos are free to create and can be downloaded or remain hosted on Splainly. A small watermark will be applied and can be removed with a $5 purchase.
entries.desc_zh: 为销售和营销需求创建产品讲解视频。视频可免费创建，并可下载或继续托管在 Splainly 上。会添加一个小水印，支付 5 美元即可移除。

entries.name: Sunrise and Sunset
entries.desc_en: Get sunrise and sunset times for a given longitude and latitude.
entries.desc_zh: 获取指定经纬度的日出和日落时间。

entries.name: superfeedr.com
entries.desc_en: Real-time PubSubHubbub compliant feeds, export, analytics. Free with less customization
entries.desc_zh: 兼容 PubSubHubbub 的实时 feed、导出和分析。免费，但自定义程度较低。

entries.name: SurveyMonkey.com
entries.desc_en: Create online surveys. Analyze the results online. The free plan allows only 10 questions and 100 responses per survey.
entries.desc_zh: 创建在线调查问卷，在线分析结果。免费计划每个调查仅允许 10 个问题和 100 份回答。

entries.name: SYNCDATE
entries.desc_en: Two-way Google Calendar sync. Free tier: 2 accounts, unlimited events.
entries.desc_zh: Google Calendar 双向同步。免费层：2 个账户，事件数量不限。

entries.name: UUID Generator
entries.desc_en: Generate UUID v1, UUID v4, UUID v7, GUID, Nil UUIDs, CUID v1/v2, NanoID, and ULID instantly with enterprise-grade
entries.desc_zh: 即时生成 UUID v1、UUID v4、UUID v7、GUID、Nil UUIDs、CUID v1/v2、NanoID 和 ULID，企业级品质。

entries.name: Versionfeeds
entries.desc_en: Custom RSS feeds for releases of your favorite software. Have the latest versions of your programming languages, libraries, or loved tools in one feed. (The first 3 feeds are free)
entries.desc_zh: 为您喜爱的软件的发布版本提供自定义 RSS 订阅源。在一个订阅源中获取您的编程语言、库或喜爱工具的最新版本。（前 3 个订阅源免费）

entries.name: Parsec
entries.desc_en: Free for installation on unlimited number of devices(for personal use) and allows up to 20 connections to a single device at once. (great for gaming/low latency work)
entries.desc_zh: 可免费安装在无限数量的设备上（供个人使用），并允许最多 20 个连接同时连接到单台设备。（非常适合游戏/低延迟工作）

entries.name: AnyDesk
entries.desc_en: Free for 3 devices, no limits on the number and duration of sessions
entries.desc_zh: 免费支持 3 台设备，无会话数量和时长限制

entries.name: Getscreen.me
entries.desc_en: Free for 2 devices, no limits on the number and duration of sessions
entries.desc_zh: 免费支持 2 台设备，无会话数量和时长限制

entries.name: RemSupp
entries.desc_en: On-demand support and permanent access to devices (2 sessions/day for free)
entries.desc_zh: 按需支持以及设备的永久访问权限（每天免费 2 次会话）

entries.name: RustDesk
entries.desc_en: Open source virtual/remote desktop infrastructure for everyone!
entries.desc_zh: 面向所有人的开源虚拟/远程桌面基础设施！

entries.name: StarDesk
entries.desc_en: Free remote desktop for work and gaming with 4K HDR/144fps streaming across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
entries.desc_zh: 用于工作和游戏的免费远程桌面，可在 Windows、macOS、iOS 和 Android 上进行 4K HDR/144fps 串流。

entries.name: get.localhost.direct
entries.desc_en: A better `*.localhost.direct` Wildcard public CA signed SSL cert for localhost development with sub-domain support
entries.desc_zh: 为 localhost 开发提供更好的 `*.localhost.direct` 通配符公共 CA 签发 SSL 证书，支持子域名

entries.name: GitHub Education
entries.desc_en: Collection of free services for students. Registration required.
entries.desc_zh: 面向学生的免费服务合集。需要注册。

entries.name: Glob tester
entries.desc_en: A website that allows you to design and test glob patterns. It also provides resources to learn glob patterns.
entries.desc_zh: 一个允许您设计和测试 glob 模式的网站。它还提供了学习 glob 模式的资源。

entries.name: Killer Coda
entries.desc_en: Interactive playground in your browser to study Linux, Kubernetes, Containers, Programming, DevOps, Networking
entries.desc_zh: 浏览器中的交互式演练场，用于学习 Linux、Kubernetes、容器、编程、DevOps 和网络

entries.name: Microsoft 365 Developer Program
entries.desc_en: Get a free sandbox, tools, and other resources you need to build solutions for the Microsoft 365 platform. The subscription is a 90-day [Microsoft 365 E5 Subscription](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/enterprise/e5) (Windows excluded) which is renewable. It is renewed if you're active in development(measured using telemetry data & algorithms).
entries.desc_zh: 获取免费的沙盒、工具以及为 Microsoft 365 平台构建解决方案所需的其他资源。该订阅是一个 90 天的 [Microsoft 365 E5 Subscription](https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/enterprise/e5)（不含 Windows），可续订。如果您在开发方面保持活跃（通过遥测数据和算法衡量），订阅将会续期。

entries.name: MySQL Visual Explain
entries.desc_en: Easy-to-understand and free MySQL EXPLAIN output visualizer to optimize slow queries.
entries.desc_zh: 易于理解且免费的 MySQL EXPLAIN 输出可视化工具，用于优化慢查询。

entries.name: RedHat for Developers
entries.desc_en: Free access to Red Hat products including RHEL, OpenShift, CodeReady, etc. exclusively for developers. Individual plan only. Free e-books are also offered for reference.
entries.desc_zh: 免费访问 Red Hat 产品，包括 RHEL、OpenShift、CodeReady 等，专供开发者使用。仅限个人计划。还提供免费电子书供参考。

entries.name: sandbox.httpsms.com
entries.desc_en: Send and receive test SMS messages for free.
entries.desc_zh: 免费发送和接收测试短信。

entries.name: SimpleBackups.com
entries.desc_en: Backup automation service for servers and databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) stored directly into cloud storage providers (AWS, DigitalOcean, and Backblaze). Provides a free plan for 1 backup.
entries.desc_zh: 面向服务器和数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、MongoDB）的备份自动化服务，可直接存储到云存储提供商（AWS、DigitalOcean 和 Backblaze）。提供包含 1 次备份的免费计划。

entries.name: SimpleRestore
entries.desc_en: Hassle-free MySQL backup restoration. Restore MySQL backups to any remote database without code or a server.
entries.desc_zh: 轻松无忧的 MySQL 备份恢复。无需代码或服务器，即可将 MySQL 备份恢复到任何远程数据库。

entries.name: SnapShooter
entries.desc_en: Backup solution for DigitalOcean, AWS, LightSail, Hetzner, and Exoscale, with support for direct database, file system and application backups to s3 based storage. Provides a free plan with daily backups for one resource.
entries.desc_zh: 适用于 DigitalOcean、AWS、LightSail、Hetzner 和 Exoscale 的备份解决方案，支持直接将数据库、文件系统和应用程序备份到基于 s3 的存储。提供免费计划，可为一个资源提供每日备份。

entries.name: VPS Snaps
entries.desc_en: Automated server backups and snapshots across 8 cloud providers, stored in your own bucket or Google Drive. Free plan: 1 server, daily backups, no credit card.
entries.desc_zh: 跨 8 个云提供商的自动化服务器备份和快照，存储在您自己的存储桶或 Google Drive 中。免费计划：1 台服务器，每日备份，无需信用卡。
